jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who Are We?**


At Parry Labs we believe the modern combat advantage relies on the speed and scale of open systems. We’re redefining the edge of the ever\-changing and increasingly ever\-changing battlespace by delivering game changing capabilities to our warfighters through digital engineering, software, and hardware solutions that are essential to our core of being a Digital Systems Integrator.


Born digital and agile, Parry Labs is building a winning team to be the premier provider for Next Generation Mission Systems Integration across air, land, sea, space and cyber.


Are you ready to be an instrumental part of experts in the industry? Join us in the innovation of integration at Parry and apply to help develop the technologies of tomorrow while reaching new heights in your career today.

**About the Job**


You will build and test Rust software for distributed mission systems under senior engineer guidance. You will develop defined components, investigate defects and learn systems programming through code reviews and integration work. You will report to a functional software engineering manager, with technical direction from the Chief Engineer.


The target start is November 2026\.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Implement defined Rust components and fixes from agreed requirements with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write unit and integration tests for expected behavior, error handling and boundary conditions.
* Debug software issues using logs, tests and development tools. Document steps to reproduce defects.
* Build simple interfaces, message handling and telemetry features using established team designs.
* Use Cargo, Git and automated checks to build, test and submit changes for review.
* Participate in code reviews and apply feedback on correctness, readability and memory safety.
* Support laboratory integration and test activities with software, systems and security engineers.
* Maintain setup instructions and component documentation. Communicate progress and raise technical blockers early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field, or equivalent training and practical experience.
* Hands\-on programming experience through coursework, internships, personal projects or employment. Prior full\-time engineering experience is not required.
* Working knowledge of Rust ownership, borrowing, basic types and error handling, plus Cargo build and test workflows.
* Understanding of basic data structures, functions and software testing. Ability to explain and debug your own code.
* Familiarity with Linux development tools and Git version control.
* Ability to work from defined requirements, ask focused questions and incorporate code\-review feedback.
* U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust coursework, internship work, open\-source contributions or a personal project with automated tests.
* Exposure to network programming, asynchronous code or concurrency.
* Experience with C/C\+\+, Python, embedded devices or hardware interfaces.
* Familiarity with continuous integration, distributed systems or positioning, navigation and timing (PNT).

**Why Join Parry Labs?**
At Parry Labs, we foster a culture of curiosity and collaboration. Employees are given the autonomy to leverage their skills in creating state\-of\-the\-art tech solutions that aid in the protection of the American Warfighter. We encourage new and bold ideas that push the status quo. It is this entrepreneurial spirit that drives us.  

Parry Labs will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well\-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives with benefits such as education assistance and unlimited paid time off, just to name a few. **No One Has Time for Long Job Applications!**
We completely understand, that is why we have made the application process easy. We promise. This will be simple. **Accessibility/Accommodation:**
If because of a medical condition or disability you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e\-mail to HR@parrylabs.com or call (256\) 682\-7145 to let us know the nature of your request and contact information.

At Parry Labs, you will lead software development for resilient timing and synchronization. The target start is November 2026\.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Define timing software architecture, interfaces, error budgets and acceptance criteria with systems engineers.
* Implement and validate time\-source fusion, clock discipline and holdover algorithms with the software team.
* Develop synchronization services with defined behavior for clock drift, conflicting sources and reference loss.
* Integrate GNSS receivers, oscillators and hardware timestamping through testable software interfaces.
* Measure and improve PTP and NTP performance under latency, packet loss and asymmetric network delay.
* Build automated tests for timing accuracy, uncertainty and recovery under degraded conditions.
* Lead design and code reviews. Mentor engineers on timing algorithms, concurrency and numerical correctness.

* Proficiency in a systems programming language such as C or C\+\+, with experience implementing and debugging timing software.
* Experience with estimation or filtering algorithms and PTP, NTP, GNSS timing or hardware timestamping.
* Experience defining software interfaces, reviewing code and validating performance through automated tests and measured data.
* U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust experience is strongly preferred. Candidates with strong PNT expertise qualify without prior Rust experience.
* Experience with embedded software, Linux or real\-time operating systems.
* Experience characterizing oscillators or atomic clocks, including phase error, frequency error and Allan deviation.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R-EGI Program
jobs.description:
**Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R\-EGI Program**

  


**Position Overview**


IS4S is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test software for the R\-EGI program. R\-EGI brings together GPS/GNSS, inertial sensors, and other navigation capabilities to support resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) for military aircraft.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable developing C/C\+\+ software on embedded Linux systems, bringing up software on hardware, and solving problems at the boundary between software, sensors, and avionics. The engineer will work closely with systems, navigation, hardware, and test teams through integration and qualification.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ software for navigation processing, device interfaces, middleware, and system control.
* Develop and debug software on embedded Linux platforms, including interactions with device drivers, operating system services, and hardware interfaces.
* Integrate GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, and other navigation inputs; work with navigation engineers to implement and evaluate sensor\-fusion and estimation functions.
* Diagnose system\-level issues involving software timing, sensor data, electrical interfaces, and hardware behavior.
* Support hardware bring\-up and software integration in laboratory and system integration lab environments.
* Develop automated tests, diagnostic tools, and scripts that improve software integration, regression testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including evaluation of performance when GPS is degraded or unavailable.
* Translate system and interface requirements into software designs, test procedures, and verification evidence.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect resolution, and software releases.
* Support technical reviews and program milestones, including PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification activities.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help the team resolve complex embedded software issues.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 8 or more years of embedded software engineering experience.
* Strong C and C\+\+ proficiency for embedded or real\-time applications.
* Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on embedded Linux systems.
* Experience working with hardware interfaces, device drivers, or low\-level software and diagnosing hardware/software integration issues.
* Experience using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or debuggers to troubleshoot embedded systems.
* Experience with software requirements, interface definitions, verification, and configuration management.
* Experience with Git, cross\-compilation toolchains, and automated builds.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with military aviation PNT systems, GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, inertial navigation systems, or integrated GPS/INS solutions.
* Experience with navigation estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, or operation in GPS\-degraded and GPS\-denied environments.
* Experience with aircraft avionics interfaces such as MIL\-STD\-1553 or ARINC 429\.
* Experience developing and integrating systems that use modern embedded processing platforms, such as the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+ MPSoC.
* Experience with real\-time Linux, VxWorks, INTEGRITY, or another real\-time operating system.
* Experience with software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system integration labs.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis, or diagnostic tools.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, interface diagrams, and hardware documentation.
* Experience supporting formal software qualification or airworthiness activities.
* Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.


**Benefits**


Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits


Dynamic and collaborative work environment


Employee ownership


Medical, dental, and vision care plans


Paid time\-off and parental leave programs


Group term life insurance


401(k) retirement plan


Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

**Description**


At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

  

Leidos Defense provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions.

  

Within the Defense Sector, Leidos currently has a special opening for a talented Lead Software Engineer to work onsite in our Huntsville, AL office in support of the IFPC program, developing software for critical counter\-UAS and missile defense solutions. This position focuses on the complete software lifecycle of complex defense systems in a Linux environment using languages such as C\+\+ and Python, developed within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.

  

This is a special, high\-impact leadership role. Beyond delivering mission software, you will serve as the team’s technical lead and the driving force for AI\-assisted software engineering – bringing modern, agentic AI coding practices to the program and coaching the team so that every engineer becomes measurably more productive. The ideal candidate has built real production software with current\-generation agentic AI coding assistants and can adapt those practices to a secure environment where the newest commercial tooling is often restricted. You will start as the technical lead for the software team, with a defined growth path into a people\-management role as the team scales.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the technical lead and design authority for the IFPC Agentic AI software development improvement software team, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and driving quality and delivery, with a defined growth path into a people\-management role as the team scales.
* Champion and operationalize agentic AI\-assisted software development across the team: establish the workflows, agent/prompt patterns, custom tooling, and guardrails that measurably multiply the team’s throughput and code quality.
* Coach and upskill engineers in the effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants through hands\-on pairing, enablement sessions, code reviews, and reusable playbooks, acting as a force multiplier for the entire team.
* Adapt commercial agentic\-AI coding practices to a secure, restricted, or air\-gapped environment; evaluate, pilot, and shepherd AI tooling through the security\-approval process, including on\-prem / self\-hosted model options.
* Develop production software in C\+\+ and Python in a Linux environment for counter\-UAS and missile defense systems.
* Develop within a SAFe environment using Jira and GitLab; apply software best practices such as peer reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD automation – integrating AI responsibly into the software development lifecycle.
* Debug and troubleshoot software in a Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HWIL) and Software\-in\-the\-loop (SWIL) setting.
* Establish and enforce engineering and coding standards, and drive standardized, reusable, well\-documented solutions.
* Collaborate across systems, electrical, test, and cybersecurity teams, and interface with program leadership and the customer to align software delivery with program needs.

 **Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 12\+ years of professional software development experience (or Master’s degree \+ 10 years / PhD \+ 7 years).
* Recent, substantial, hands\-on experience building real software with current\-generation agentic AI coding assistants and AI\-assisted development workflows, not just experimentation.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor engineers and to lead a software team as a technical lead.
* Strong, current proficiency in C\+\+ and Python.
* Experience across the full software lifecycle, including peer reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Experience working within an Agile / SAFe environment (or equivalent).
* Experience with tools such as Jira and GitLab (or equivalent).
* Experience developing in a Linux environment.
* Ability to adapt modern AI\-assisted development workflows to security\-constrained, restricted, or disconnected environments (or a clear, demonstrated capacity to do so).
* Currently living in Huntsville, AL or willing to relocate.
* U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance (interim and final).

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Deep, hands\-on expertise with specific agentic AI coding tools – e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot / Copilot Workspace, Windsurf, Aider – and with Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-based agent and tool workflows.
* Experience building AI enablement assets: prompt/agent libraries, custom skills/agents, and automated code\-review and test\-generation pipelines that scale across a team.
* Experience measuring and driving AI developer\-productivity impact (e.g., DORA metrics, cycle time, review latency) and leading tool adoption at team or organization scale.
* Experience with self\-hosted / on\-prem large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over codebases (e.g., vLLM, Ollama, Amazon Bedrock / GovCloud), including deployment in disconnected environments.

jobs.description:
**Software Engineer, Entry\-Level**

 **Overview**


SimTech, Inc., recognized as one of the **2026 Best Places for Working Parents**, is seeking a **Software Engineer, Entry\-Level** to join our dynamic and diverse team in Huntsville, AL. This is an immediate opening with opportunities for growth and professional development.

  



SimTech offers a market leading compensation package with excellent benefits, work/life balance, outstanding retirement plan, career advancement and much more.

  



The Software Engineer, Entry\-Level role supports the development and maintenance of real\-time lab control applications. This position assists with testing, analysis, and implementation efforts that support system design and evaluation, while collaborating with internal and external teams to ensure successful program execution.

 **Responsibilities**

Assist in executing programming assignments using established programming procedures and data processing requirements.

  

Support efforts to maintain data integrity and improve code efficiency for distributive and/or parallel processing.

  

Contribute to the design, development, and implementation of software in C\+\+, CUDA, and Python based on defined architectural guidance, ensuring code is efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

  

Provide documentation and modeling support using tools such as doxygen and UML.

  

Assist in implementing mathematical and analytical solutions for calculations, transformations, and processes as defined by specifications.

  

Apply foundational software engineering principles to support design, development, testing, and deployment activities, including exposure to CI/CD processes and tools.

  

Work under guidance to evaluate assignments, apply appropriate programming techniques, and develop effective solutions.

  

Support the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and briefings for internal teams.

  

Meet assigned deadlines, follow compliance standards, and deliver quality work products.

  

Perform other duties as assigned.

 **Minimum Qualifications \& Education Requirements and Desired Skillsets**


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer, Mechanical, or Aerospace), Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.

  

0–3 years of experience in software engineering, modeling \& simulation, or application development (internships and academic projects may be considered).

  



Basic proficiency in C\+\+ and/or Python, with willingness and ability to learn CUDA.

  



Familiarity with development in a Linux environment (RedHat and/or Debian preferred).

  



Exposure to mathematical or analytical problem\-solving concepts.

  



Familiarity with software development lifecycle concepts (e.g., version control, testing, CI/CD) is a plus.

  



Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  



Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and support interactions with government and contractor stakeholders.

  



Work will be performed in a government\-owned, contractor\-operated lab environment.

  



U.S. Citizenship with Active Secret Security clearance and ability to maintain the designated security clearance level is required.

 **Physical Description**


Employees in these positions will function in a general office/cubicle setting environment, and laboratory/testing setting using standard office equipment and various electronic testing equipment, including a computer, telephone, printers, video equipment, computer software, and testing equipment. Will interact in a general office setting environment with various personnel; participate in meetings and contribute to team success; deliver timely results and produce reports; receive and communicate information; may include telework. May function in a specialized laboratory/testing environment using electronic testing equipment, computer software, and complex systems. May move and test equipment of various weights. Laboratory environment may require use of protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to safety glasses and protective hearing and footwear. May be expected to work varying shifts and hours to ensure successful operation of activities in the organization due to business demands; travel occasionally for assigned work.

 **About SimTech, Inc.**


SimTech's mission is to be the most reliable and cost\-effective provider of Signature Models, Simulations, Hardware, Software, Cyber solutions, and Test \& Evaluation services. jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join BAE Systems' Infrastructure Management Center (IMC) and help shape National Security. We are seeking a motivated Systems Engineer to join our dynamic, cross\-functional team. In this role, you will support the planning, design, and integration of complex technical challenges that support critical national security missions, including nuclear missions, production facilities, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and ammunition plant infrastructure.
  

This is an ideal role for an early\-career engineer looking to grow within a matrix\-type organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate across multiple departments, leveraging digital engineering tools and Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices to deliver cutting\-edge solutions for the warfighter.
  

  

The Role
  

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the systems integration and analysis of hardware and software systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:
* Systems Integration: Assist in the integration and analysis of military hardware and software systems/processes (or commercial equivalents).
* Technical Analysis: Support the design and analytical efforts required to optimize the management of critical infrastructure programs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work within a multi\-disciplinary team of engineers and program managers to understand customer requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Digital Tool Utilization: Utilize project management software and digital engineering tools, (CAMEO, DOORS, Etc…).
* Documentation: Assist in the creation of technical documentation, system specifications, and reports to ensure program milestones are met.
* Process Improvement: Support the implementation of Agile methodologies and continuous process improvement initiatives within the IMC.
* Requirements Management: Manage the full requirements lifecycle, including the derivation, analysis, and development of comprehensive technical requirements documents to ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and system design.
  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM field (e.g., Mathematics, Physics).
* 2 yrs technical experience 0yrs with MS) with an emphasis in Systems engineering
* Technical Aptitude: Fundamental understanding of systems design, integration, and analytical efforts.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with team members, stakeholders, and customers in a professional environment.
* Secret Security Clearance
  

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Familiarity with Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or other digital engineering tools
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and their application in a technical environment.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret.
* Any foundational certifications in Systems Engineering or Project Management.
  

  

  

**Pay Information**
  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $107359 \- $182510
  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  

  

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  

  

  

  

**About BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security**  

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  

  

Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  

  

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: TAK Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner
jobs.description:
COLSA Corporation is seeking a **Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner** to support the U.S. Army's Threat Systems Management Office (TSMO). This position will design, develop, integrate, test, and troubleshoot software solutions involving the Team Awareness Kit (TAK), including the integration of clients, servers, data pipelines, and other systems to deliver capabilities that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.



Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential functions)



* Design and orchestrate systems of systems, including clients, servers, data pipelines, and other integrated components.
* Design, develop, test, and implement software programs using Java, C\+\+, Python, React, Go, or similar technologies.
* Support software development and delivery using Jira and Kanban\-based continuous flow processes.
* Set up and maintain development environments for Windows and Linux, including containerized environments.
* Perform merge request and pull request reviews to support software quality assurance.
* Develop and implement user\-friendly interface requirements for software clients.
* Collaborate with team members and end users to analyze requirements, troubleshoot software issues, and deliver solutions that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.
* Perform systems modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Perform data analysis and provide input for reports and dashboards, as needed.
* Develop or oversee user training, troubleshooting materials, and step\-by\-step guides.
* Advise hardware design engineers on system characteristics that may affect software systems, as needed.
* Provide input for documentation of new and existing software programs, as needed.


*At COLSA, people are our most valuable resource and centered at our core value. We invite you to unite your talents with opportunity and be a part of our “Family of Professionals!” Learn about our employee\-centric culture and benefits here:* *https://www.colsa.com/culture\_benefits*

  

  

Required Experience  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Minimum of 8\-12 years of related experience.
* Hands\-on experience supporting systems integration efforts.
* Experience configuring and maintaining development environments, including Git\-based version control, Linux operating systems, and Docker containerization.
* Experience with version control software and the Driessen branching model (Gitflow).
* Practical experience with front\-end application development, including the implementation of responsive, user\-focused interfaces.
* Experience designing, developing, and integrating custom interfaces, extensions, or plugins within existing software frameworks.
* Active Secret security clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.


**Preferred Qualifications**



* Previous experience leading software development teams.
* Experience with web development technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP) experience using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Computer vision experience with object detection or gait recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and YOLO models.


Applicant selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. COLSA Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

The **Hardware Engineering Directorate** is seeking a **Principal Digital Hardware Engineer** with digital electronics design and analysis skills to join our team.

  



We are looking for candidates willing to collaborate, innovate, and team with our engineers to generate and utilize today’s cutting\-edge technology to design digital electronics circuits that implement missile guidance, video and digital signal processing. Our technology base includes high\-speed digital electronics, configurable logic, and homogeneous / heterogeneous multiprocessor designs.

The **Effector Guidance Electronics Department** designs digital electronic circuit cards and electronic units which are supported from proposal through transition to production. Our systems are subject to environments ranging from the frigid, sub\-zero vacuum of space to the blistering heat of the desert floor, to the high pressures of the ocean depths.

* Typically requires a Bachelor's Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience
* Minimum of **eight (8\) years** engineering digital circuit design experience
* Experience in the development and design of electronic circuit designs, and/or multi\-assembly system/unit design

  



**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience in taking design concepts from block diagram or requirements level to development of complete hardware designs, with verification via test and integration
* Experience with PCB design process and expertise with design tools (schematic capture) to analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution
* Experience using Mentor Graphics Design Creation (Siemens EDA) tools: DxDesigner, xDX Designer VX, and/or Expedition
* Experience using PCB electronic circuit design software: HyperLynx signal integrity, power integrity and analog simulation, and/or Xpedition Enterprise (xPCB)

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Associate-Mid)
jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking Software Engineers to join tour team in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design, develop, integrate, test, and sustain mission‑critical command and control (C2\) software used by our warfighters and customers around the world.  

In this role, you will support Agile Software Teams, working closely with systems and test engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands‑on development, solving complex technical problems, and collaborating in a highly integrated, Agile environment.
Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications and software systems that implement logical and mathematical solutions that are aligned with program objectives.
* Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Scrum teams to develop and maintain software products across multiple software baselines for the IBCS program.
* Work in a fast\-paced environment with high expectations, diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels of the organization.
* Perform software development and upgrades in multiple programming languages/versions while minimizing changes to the operational behavior of tactical software.
* Support documentation creation and updates using Markdown and other collaboration tools.
* Support testing activities including unit and functional testing, code coverage analysis, and static code analysis; contribute to continuous improvement of test effectiveness and automation.
* Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Education, Experience and Required skills:* This role can be filled at mulitple levels
	+ Associate Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 1 year of relevant experience
	+ Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant experience, Master's degree in STEM field and 0 years of relevant experience
* Strong object\-oriented software development experience with Java and C\+\+
* Proficiency in Linux\-based development and runtime environments.
* Experience with scripting languages and tools including Bash and Python.
* Experience with modern configuration management and source control tools (Git / GitLab).
* Experience with Agile SAFe and Atlassian Agile tools including Jira and Confluence.
* Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain a clearance required.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.


Preferred Qualifications:* Experience with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including Cameo or similar tools.
* Experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to build, integrate, test and deliver software.
* Experience supporting real\-time or distributed systems using RTI/DDS publish/subscribe middleware.
* Engagement: Experience with US Army Systems including PATRIOT, LTAMDS, SENTINEL A3/A4, IFF devices, and M\_SHORAD.
* Experience with Engagement Planning and Execution, PAC2/PAC3, and AIM9x, and Indirect Fires.
* Track Management: Experience with track management including sensors, composite track, IFF devices, and Combat Identification.
* CompTIA Security\+


Physical Demands:* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. \- 5:00 p.m. Monday\-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required.


About i3:

Founded in 2007, Integration Innovation, Inc. (i3\) is headquartered in Huntsville, AL, with additional offices in Orlando, FL, and the National Capital Region. We are a 100% team member\-owned mid\-tier integrator with over 800 employee\-owners, and our culture speaks for itself: we've earned ten Best Places to Work® awards, driven by strong employee engagement, transparent leadership, and a genuine commitment to communication.  

i3 team members operate at the leading edge of national defense across a broad range of technical disciplines, from systems and software engineering to modeling, simulation, and training solutions to cybersecurity, digital engineering, and enterprise IT. We also take products from prototype through production, bringing that same engineering rigor to manufacturing and delivering hardware at scale. For candidates, that means a rare opportunity: the innovation and mission focus of an engineering services company paired with the hands\-on impact of building and delivering real solutions that benefit the Warfighter, all inside an employee\-owned company where your contributions directly shape both the mission and your ownership stake in the business.

jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time**Description**
---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real\-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today.

  

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a Staff Systems Engineer to join our team. This position will be located at Huntsville, AL to support Special Programs \& Futures in the Strategic Deterrent Systems (SDS) Division.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide systems engineering support across the TMRR phase, guiding requirements development, functional analysis, interface definition, and verification and validation for cruise missile subsystems.
* Decompose and allocate complex system and customer requirements into detailed hardware and software specifications, maintaining rigorous end to end traceability and ensuring compliance with technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
* Develop and oversee functional architectures, concepts of operations (CONOPS), and use cases using MBSE tools such as CAMEO and DOORS, and drive adoption of advanced systems engineering practices across the program.
* Support planning and execution of hardware in the loop, developmental flight, and operational test integration, overseeing verification and validation strategies for software and hardware components and resolving unusually complex technical issues.
* Create, own, and manage technical maturation roadmaps and integration plans for the TMRR phase, identifying, analyzing, and mitigating technical and program risks and advising management on risk posture and trade decisions.
* Support or lead cross functional working groups and model capability reviews, ensuring adherence to systems engineering standards, processes, and quality expectations, and driving consensus on key technical decisions.
* Produce and guide the development of key systems engineering deliverables such as design reviews, trade studies, interface control documents (ICDs), requirements baselines, and supportability and effectiveness analyses.
* Perform and direct advanced trade studies and timeline analyses across concept, design, test, and integration to optimize system solutions and influence program strategy and critical organizational objectives.
* Support systems engineering contributions to proposal development, RFP/RFS responses, and Bases of Estimate for TMRR efforts, developing advanced technological ideas and guiding their maturation into executable plans.

 **Basic Qualifications**

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/**

Department: Engineering

Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer

Employment type: Full\-time

Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)

Position Summary

Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building.

As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast.

Key Duties \& Responsibilities

Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works.

What You’ll Work With

* Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant.

Required Qualifications

* 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

*This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.*

Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

**Senior Thermal Systems Engineer**



Advantest Test Solutions, Inc. (ATS) is seeking a Senior Thermal Systems Engineer to serve as a thermal technical lead on our team in Lake Forest, CA. ATS is a leading provider of massively parallel electronic test systems, including System Level Test (SLT), burn\-in, and semiconductor/module testing. We offer an exciting portfolio of high\-performance test systems that support the semiconductor industry worldwide.



This individual will act as the thermal lead on assigned programs, taking ownership of technical decisions and drafting thermal requirements with minimal supervision. The role covers the full range of thermal and mechanical engineering functions related to the design, testing, and evaluation of thermal systems for electronic systems, including semiconductors, photonics, and embedded devices, from early concept through mass production. Responsibilities include directing thermal system design and validation, mentoring junior engineers, and serving as the primary technical point of contact for thermal scope on their programs.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the thermal lead on assigned programs, making independent technical decisions and drafting thermal system requirements.
* Own thermal system design and validation for liquid\-cooled and refrigerant\-based systems, from architecture through release.
* Lead thermal system design and validation across the full product lifecycle, including prototyping, design validation, and transition to mass production.
* Design and develop thermal components such as cold plates (liquid\-cooling and two\-phase), ceramic heaters, heat sinks, chillers, and condensing units.
* Design and support high power, high temperature active thermal control systems.
* Perform hands\-on thermal system testing and design validation to confirm designs meet specifications and performance requirements.
* Conduct thermal analyses to evaluate component and system\-level performance.
* Collaborate with and provide technical direction to design and development teams to integrate thermal solutions into product designs.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers on the team.
* Optimize thermal designs to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance.
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation of designs, analyses, and testing results.
* Stay current with advancements in thermal management technologies and methodologies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to thermal design and performance.
* Work with procurement, manufacturing, quality assurance, and technical support teams to establish specifications, and assist in vendor/supplier selection for parts, materials, and assemblies.
* Provide hands\-on support during product installation and commissioning at customer sites, and guidance to the field service team.
* Identify risk areas and opportunities for optimization, and drive resolution of field issues in collaboration with the field team.
* Act as a technical point of contact for customers on thermal\-related issues for their programs.
* Conduct hands\-on evaluation of prototype and sub\-assembly builds, including thorough performance assessments.
* Perform additional duties as required.

Requirements:
**Requirements, Education \& Skills**


* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or Physics required; Master's degree preferred.
* 8\+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a demonstrated track record of leading thermal scope on programs independently, including drafting technical requirements and making design decisions with minimal oversight.
* Active thermal control experience in the semiconductor industry required.
* Expertise in thermal system design and validation for liquid\-cooled and refrigerant\-based systems.
* Proven experience across the end\-to\-end product lifecycle: prototyping, design validation, and mass production.
* Hands\-on capability performing thermal system testing and design validation.
* Deep knowledge of cold plates (liquid\-cooling, two\-phase), ceramic heaters, heat sinks, chillers, and condensing units.
* Experience with high power, high temperature active thermal control systems.
* Experience with PID control and tuning for closed\-loop thermal systems.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to lead technical decisions on ambiguous problems.

jobs.title: Senior Network and Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Application close date:


Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space\-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi\-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise\-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.
**About This Role**

Blue Origin is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Software Engineering team supporting TeraWave in the Greater Seattle Area. In this role, you build the foundational platform infrastructure, the operating nervous system, deployed across TeraWave satellites, user terminals, and gateways. This position focuses on embedded Linux and low\-level platform infrastructure, spanning fleet management, operating\-system services, hardware integration, security, observability, and networking performance. You will shape reliable, high\-performance systems that operate aboard LEO satellites. Responsibilities


**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Design core Linux platform infrastructure, including process management, custom initialization systems, and inter\-process communication frameworks.
* Develop and maintain Linux kernel modules and device drivers to support custom hardware and platform requirements.
* Modify kernel subsystems to improve scheduling, memory management, and I/O performance for embedded satellite systems.
* Work with silicon, electrical, and RF teams to bring up hardware prototypes and optimize kernels for custom SoCs.
* Debug system\-level performance issues, minimize context switching, and tune the networking stack for satellite links.
* Implement secure boot, runtime security monitoring, and hardware\-backed credential management across embedded platforms.
* Own the complete software lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment aboard LEO satellites.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related STEM discipline, or 10\+ years software development experience.
* At least 8 years of C or C\+\+ experience in Linux or embedded environments.
* Deep Linux kernel knowledge, including driver development, memory management, and system\-level debugging.
* Experience with system\-level debugging tools such as GDB, perf, and eBPF.
* Experience with Buildroot, Yocto, Bazel, or comparable build systems.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Infrastructure experience supporting large distributed systems or device fleets at scale.
* Proficiency with Rust or Python for systems tooling and automation.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, Ethernet, Linux networking, and custom routing protocols.
* Experience with mission\-critical aerospace, automotive, medical, or similarly high\-reliability systems.
Ability to troubleshoot down to assembly code and hardware\-level diagnostics.  
*

CA applicants is $248,830\.00 \- $348,361\.65\&\#xa;WA applicants is $248,830\.00 \- $348,361\.65

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
* 5 years of experience working with embedded operating systems.
* 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience with C and C\+\+.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects.
* Experience with Kernel and Kernel Drivers.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of low\-level software to lead product development within our Server portfolio. This team is responsible for the platform software (Firmware, Basic Input/Output System (BIOS), Drivers) for all Google servers, including compute servers and ML headnodes. You will also contribute to initiatives like Far Memory and other innovative, currently need\-to\-know products shaping our future solutions.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

* Influence, mentor, and coach a distributed team of engineers, fostering a collaborative culture of continuous innovation, technical excellence, and professional growth.

Proven track record of solving complex problems in multi\-functional teams

* Work with AI, simulation, hardware, platform, and partner teams to bring up, validate, and harden robotic systems for real\-world deployment.

**What we need to see:**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


Strategic Defense protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air\-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid\-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software\-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale.
### **ABOUT THE JOB**



We're seeking a Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Irvine, CA or Huntsville, AL. As a Software Engineer on the Strategic Defense team, you will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way. Your efforts will ensure that Anduril products seamlessly work together to achieve a variety of critical outcomes. Above all, Software Engineers are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset—executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes correctly, on\-time, and with high quality. This role will focus on the Guam Defense System Battle Manager product. Experience with mid and upper tier Air Defense Command and Control programs is a plus. You will be helping to create a new strategic business line and will work closely with the other strategic Command and Control programs within Anduril.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the software solutions that are deployed to customers

* Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform — Maritime Autonomy
jobs.description:
Help turn streams of maritime sensor data into dependable datasets for machine\-learning and perception systems. You will build the data platform that lets engineers process live signals, revisit historical recordings and understand exactly which data informed a model or evaluation. The work spans software infrastructure, dataset quality and close collaboration with teams building autonomous systems.


Location: Torrance, California  

Employment: Full\-time  

Base salary range in the matching recruiter posting: $200,000–$240,000, plus equity

### **Responsibilities**

* Build pipelines that ingest and process high\-volume sensor and telemetry data for ML and analytics.
* Align and calibrate data from different sensors; support both near\-real\-time processing and repeatable historical reprocessing.
* Make datasets traceable through versioning, metadata and lineage so experiments can be reproduced.
* Create data\-discovery interfaces and access patterns that help ML and perception teams find fit\-for\-purpose datasets.
* Measure data completeness and quality, investigate failures and improve reliability as data volume grows.
* Work with ML, hardware and product colleagues to translate changing model needs into durable data contracts.

### **Requirements**


Must\-haves

* Experience building and operating substantial data platforms, ML data infrastructure or large\-scale processing pipelines.
* Strong Python skills and practical use of data\-processing tools or libraries such as PyArrow, Polars, Pandas or NumPy.
* Experience working with sensor, time\-series, audio, vision or similarly complex data.
* Understanding of dataset quality, reproducibility and access patterns for downstream users.
* Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate across software and ML teams.


Nice\-to\-haves

* Experience with sonar, maritime systems, robotics, autonomy or other sensor\-rich environments.
* Experience with orchestration, metadata or experiment\-tracking tools.
* Experience with backfills, labeling workflows, data APIs/SDKs or storage optimization at scale.

  

Interested? Apply now and we will be in touch within 3 workdays.

jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Satellites
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next\-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware\-rich, and low\-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high\-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.



Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long\-term space economy.



Vast is looking for a **Senior Avionics Systems Engineer**, reporting to the **Senior Manager, Avionics and Power Systems**, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of high power satellites.



This will be a **full\-time, exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location.


**Responsibilities:**


* Function as responsible engineer for avionics systems across design, integration, test, launch, and operations
* Define detailed systems design, including system interfaces, consumable budgets, harness and channel capabilities, hardware capabilities, reliability and fault tolerance compliance, vehicle risk assessments, and configuration change management
* Collaborate with a cross\-functional engineering team to define requirements, lead systems trades, and scope designs as they move from concept to flight production
* Architect and inform autonomous behaviors, vehicle modes, and fault responses to comply with vehicle mission requirements
* Develop system\-level verification plans for integrated flight hardware to verify test coverage and vehicle flight readiness
* Evaluate vehicle health and perform real\-time troubleshooting to drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions
* Create and maintain system designs, processes, and validation techniques to improve reliability and streamline production
* Support process improvement by identifying recurring issues, implementing design feedback, and enabling higher system reliability
* Travel to launch sites or test facilities as needed to support operational activities
* Mentor and support fellow engineers, fostering strong technical development across the team


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline
* 5\+ years of professional or project experience with avionics design, analysis, system level integration, and/or unit level testing
* Experience with systems engineering principles and processes as they relate to spacecraft development
* Experience with lifecycle development as it relates to space systems, including requirement definition, identifying design solutions, integration, validation and verification, qualification, and operation


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


* Experience defining, managing, and verifying flight software interfaces
* Experience with system design and test of subsystems like power, GNC, RF, and propulsion interfaces
* Experience with high\-reliability/fault\-tolerant electronics for aerospace or defense applications
* Understanding of electrical schematics and electronics manufacturing to analyze and improve test coverage
* Competence with electrical test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, power supplies, etc.)
* Ability to effectively communicate technical topics to a wide variety of audiences
* Ability to creatively solve problems and weigh against multi\-disciplinary requirements while assessing risk and making design and development decisions with incomplete data
* Self\-motivated with strong learning, multi\-tasking, organizational, communication and documentation skills
* Strong sense of accountability and integrity with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work autonomously and thrive in a fast paced environment


**Additional Requirements:**


* Ability to travel up to 10% travel to support launch campaigns
* Comfortable balancing several projects at any given time with the flexibility to adjust for abrupt changes in strategic direction

  

*We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.*

  


**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**  

  

Base salary will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full\-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20\+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10\+ days of vacation for non\-exempt staff with the ability to cash\-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer – Digital/Analog Hardware Design
jobs.description:

This role will be involved across the full hardware development lifecycle, from component selection and circuit design through PCB development, prototyping, validation, manufacturing, and product release.

* Participate in design reviews and contribute recommendations for system improvements and risk mitigation
* Communicate technical information effectively to customers and stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements, security standards, industry codes, and project specifications
* Stay current on emerging technologies and participate in training and certification programs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline
* 0–2 years of relevant experience (internships, co\-ops, laboratory experience, and academic projects are welcome)
* Basic understanding of electrical and electronic systems
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, and network troubleshooting
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and network documentation
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Exposure to multidisciplinary engineering, networking, security systems, and systems integration
* Direct mentorship from experienced engineers, project managers, and technical leaders
* Opportunities for technical training, professional certifications, and career advancement
