jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Robotics)
jobs.description:
**The Company**
We believe general\-purpose, generally\-intelligent robots will be built *in our lifetimes.* Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real\-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop.
As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state\-of\-the\-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy.
**Our Culture**
We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next\-level collaboration and respect.
**About the Role**
Our robots work in customer facilities with people nearby. The code that decides how an arm moves, how fast, and how it stops is what keeps those people safe. We're looking for a controls engineer to own it.
The work is controls: joint limits, speed limits, stopping distances and stopping times, contact and collision behavior, the loop that turns a motion command into torque, and the monitoring that detects when that loop misbehaves. It is also software work. The code lives in a large codebase that changes every week, and the safety\-critical parts of it have to be written, organized, tested, and reviewed so they stay correct through those changes. The person we want has worked in a codebase where a mistake had physical consequences, has written and organized a lot of code there, and is comfortable with the physics underneath it.
You will build the hardware\-in\-the\-loop test bench that runs the control code against real arms and real stop circuits, in continuous integration. You will also keep the evidence current: the measurements and tests that show the arm stops when it should, updated as the code, the arms, and the applications change.
The formal side of safety, risk assessments and the standards customers ask about, is part of the role. We will teach it.
### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the safety\-critical control code for our arms:** Limits, stop behavior, collision response, and the monitoring around the control loop
* **Work on the control loop itself:** Timing, stability, and failure modes, from the motion command down to the drives
* **Organize the code so it can be trusted:** Keep the safety\-critical parts small, separated, tested, and reviewable, and set the rules for how other code touches them
* **Build hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing:** A bench and a continuous\-integration path that run the control code against real arms and real safety hardware
* **Keep the evidence current:** Stopping\-time measurements and the tests behind the safety argument, updated whenever the code or the hardware changes
* **Document the design:** Decisions, limits, and the reasons for them, in a form other engineers follow

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Real\-time control experience on physical systems:** Robot arms, vehicles, aircraft, or similar. You have written control code that moved hardware and handled its failures
* **Experience in a mission\-critical codebase:** You have written and organized a large amount of code where mistakes had physical consequences, and you know what that requires of structure, testing, and review
* **Comfortable with the physics:** Dynamics, torque, inertia, stopping distances, contact. You can reason about what the arm will do
* **Strong systems software:** C\+\+ and Python or similar, real\-time behavior on Linux, and safety\-critical code kept separate from the rest
* **Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing:** You have built or used a rig that put real hardware in the loop with software under test

### **Nice to Have**

* Exposure to safety standards for robots or machinery, such as ISO 10218, ISO 13849, or ANSI/RIA R15\.06
* EtherCAT or other fieldbus experience with servo drives
* Experience with safety\-rated controllers or certified functional safety components
* Experience in warehouses, manufacturing, or other environments where robots and people share space

**About Our Roles \& Titles**
At Tutor, we believe great engineers and researchers are defined by what they build and the impact they have — not where they sit in an org chart or what title they have. Therefore, everyone in our R\&D org holds the title **Member of Technical Staff (MoTS)**. Our job postings use standard titles so you can find us, but if you join Tutor, you'll be a MoTS — with a level that is determined through the interview process.
That also means we hire people, not slots. Work at Tutor evolves every quarter, and we set the expectation of flexibility from day one — it's common for people to start on one thing and shift to another based on where the team needs them most. A high technical bar across the board is what makes that flexibility possible: it's what allows people to contribute meaningfully whatever problem they take on.

As a Systems Engineer \- Scrum Master for the Strategic Weapon Interface Simulator (SWIS), you will perform systems engineering and help a cross\-functional engineering team plan and deliver simulation capabilities supporting the future Columbia\-class submarine fleet.  

SWIS brings together the simulation capabilities needed to support both Fire Control system development and fleet training. It allows engineering teams to develop, integrate, and test Fire Control capabilities in lab environments and helps prepare the fleet to operate those capabilities before they are used aboard a submarine.  

In this role, you will facilitate the team's Agile execution and contribute directly to systems engineering work. You will use Jira to maintain a clear and actionable backlog, plan achievable work, track sprint commitments and team performance, manage dependencies, and provide transparent status to stakeholders. You will facilitate Scrum events, remove impediments, and use Jira data and objective measures to improve predictability and delivery. You will partner with product owners, technical leads, engineering disciplines, and program leadership to connect technical priorities with executable plans.  

You will apply an understanding of Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and Cost Account Management (CAM) when planning and reporting the team's work. You may support CAMs and program leadership by maintaining credible work plans, evaluating actual and forecast performance, contributing to estimates to complete and estimates at completion, supporting variance analysis and change\-control activities, and communicating risks and corrective actions. You may not be the CAM of record for assigned work packages, but you will understand how day\-to\-day engineering execution affects program cost, schedule, and earned value performance.  

You will also contribute to systems engineering activities across the development life cycle, including requirements management, technical planning, integration, verification, test, risk management, and technical documentation. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys creating clarity, helping teams solve delivery problems, and connecting day\-to\-day engineering work to program cost and schedule commitments.  

We encourage you to apply if you have any of these preferred skills or experiences:* Hands\-on experience administering and using Jira to manage backlogs, epics, stories, tasks, workflows, dashboards, queries, sprint metrics, dependencies, and team reporting.
* Experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile team facilitator, project lead, or technical task lead for a cross\-functional engineering team.
* Experience with Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, DevSecOps, or other Lean\-Agile practices in a hardware, software, systems, or integrated product\-development environment.
* Experience supporting Cost Account Management or working with earned value management systems (EVMS), work breakdown structures, integrated master schedules, or program planning and control.
* Experience analyzing schedule and cost performance using measures such as schedule performance index (SPI), cost performance index (CPI), budgeted cost, actual cost, and estimate at completion.
* Experience developing resource plans, forecasts, variance analyses, corrective\-action plans, or inputs to program reviews.
* Experience managing technical scope, risks, dependencies, and changes while maintaining alignment among engineering and program stakeholders.
* Experience with systems engineering activities such as requirements management, system design, integration, verification, test, or technical documentation.
* Experience integrating Jira planning and performance data with Confluence, scheduling tools, EVMS tools, or program reporting processes.
* Experience with defense systems, Fleet Ballistic Missile or Fire Control programs, simulation systems, training systems, or other mission\-critical integrated systems.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile, EVMS, or CAM training or certification.
 **What sets you apart:*** Solid understanding and application of systems engineering principles, concepts, and theories.
* Strong Jira skills and the ability to configure useful team workflows, dashboards, filters, and reports while maintaining reliable planning data.
* Ability to facilitate productive planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily coordination while helping a team continuously improve.
* Ability to translate technical scope into logical work packages, measurable milestones, realistic forecasts, and clear ownership.
* Working understanding of project leadership principles, including SPI/CPI, earned value, Cost Account Management, forecasting, and disciplined change control.
* Ability to identify emerging cost, schedule, technical, and dependency risks and drive practical corrective actions to closure.
* Collaborative leadership style that supports team accountability, constructive problem\-solving, and transparent communication.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain performance, risks, and recommendations to technical and program stakeholders.
* Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle complex assignments efficiently.
* Commitment to ongoing professional development for yourself and others.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**



The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:


* **Data Processing**: We are building state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user\-friendly, and highly fault\-tolerant.
* **Data Discovery**: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
* **Data Lineage**: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.
  


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
* Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
* Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
* Lead and champion high\-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.
  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
* BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
* Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
* Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
* Experience with distributed system design and development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, continuous delivery environment
  


**Bonus Points (not required):**


* Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in cross\-functional development teams
* Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
* Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.
  


**We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.**

  

**\#LI\-AE1**

 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.**


**Our journey is always people first.**



We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.


**Higher purpose, greater impact.**



We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do.


**Scale up, not starting up.**



Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.



Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.


*Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.


The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE\&TC) Surface Radars \& Sensors Center is currently looking for a Senior Principal Systems Engineer to support the Missile Defense Sensors (MDS) department. The MDS department provides subject matter expertise for concept development, architectural design, requirements generation \& flow\-down, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, integration, test and evaluation of world\-class Missile Defense \& Sensor Systems to be achieved through our people, processes, technology and performance. This position is on site in Woburn, MA.

**What You Will do:**


You will be working as part of a team to define radar system requirements, design architectures and algorithms in support of those requirements and collaborate with software development teams to ensure effective implementation. Some specific responsibilities:

* Analyzing radar system performance data with respect to requirements.
* Identifying performance deficiencies and proposing solutions.
* Defining and prototyping new algorithms to enhance system performance.
* Presenting plans, designs and system performance to peers, internal leadership and external customers.
* Providing subject matter expertise to agile software development teams to ensure proper implementation of requirements.


You will contribute to one or more capability areas, including:

* Electronic Protection, signal processing, and applied mathematics.
* Hypersonic threat defense.
* Tracking, discrimination, search, and battle manager interfaces.
* Radar calibration, diagnostics, and deployed site support.
* Modeling and simulation of tactical software.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience.
* Experience with Matlab, C/C\+\+, Java, or DOORS.
* Experience with systems analysis, algorithms, requirements development, and/or signal processing techniques.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience with Battle Management command, Control, Communications, Computers and Intelligence (BMC4I) systems, Radar Systems or signal processing techniques.
* Experience with developing, documenting and maintaining processes, methods and tools.
* Ability to develop technical solutions to complex issues.
* Analytic, technical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with MS Office Suite.
* Experience with system level requirements development, documentation and maintenance and/or requirements development and design of system level software architecture.
* Experience with radar system concepts; detection, discrimination, track and signal processing algorithms and their behaviors and performance.
* Experience with the development and coding of system models, algorithms, test vectors and analysis tools in support of analyzing radar requirements and performance.
* Experience and interest in Information Assurance/Cyber Engineering requirements, determination, development and implementation.
* Experience in using AI/ML and signal processing in database and algorithm design and enhancement
* Previous military service.
* Ability to interface with customers and lead technical solutions to complex user needs.

**What We Offer**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AWS Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Location:** This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.


**The Opportunity**



You will own and shape how Praxis designs, governs, secures, and operates AWS at scale—from account structure and identity to the platforms and applications that run on them. You will be a hands\-on builder, using your depth in cloud infrastructure and software engineering to create secure, reliable systems that enable our teams to move quickly.



You will work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. You will build and improve the systems that keep our teams moving fast while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and compliance. You will work primarily in TypeScript and Python, use modern AI tooling as part of your daily engineering workflow, and take direct accountability for production operations, including on\-call.



You will be expected to see problems, take ownership, and drive them through resolution. You will move quickly through incremental, well\-controlled changes, question assumptions when there is a better path, and turn operational learnings into durable improvements. Just as importantly, you will raise the bar for the people and systems around you by sharing what you know, communicating clearly, and helping the broader team build and operate better.


**Primary Responsibilities**


* Own and evolve AWS architecture for enterprise workloads, including multi\-account foundations, landing zone / Control Tower patterns, networking, security baselines, and shared platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve AWS governance, including organizational structure, SCPs, tagging, cost controls, compliance, audit readiness, and durable operational standards.
* Design and operate identity and access across AWS, including IAM, IAM Identity Center, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations for SSO, federation, role mapping, access reviews, and least\-privilege access.
* Build, harden, and operate AWS platforms and full\-stack services using TypeScript and Python, including compute, containers, serverless, data stores, messaging, and cloud automation as needed.
* Drive operational excellence across AWS platforms and workloads by building effective monitoring, alerting, dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, runbooks, incident response practices, and durable fixes to recurring problems; participate in the on\-call rotation and own incidents through resolution and learning.
* Automate infrastructure and delivery through Infrastructure as Code—preferably Pulumi and/or SST—and CI/CD using Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions, with an emphasis on safe, incremental delivery and low blast radius.
* Partner across engineering and IT to translate needs into secure, maintainable solutions, improve production readiness and operational practices, mentor other engineers, and use sound judgment to move fast without breaking things.


**Qualifications**


* Senior\-level software engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on experience building and operating production systems on AWS.
* Strong full\-stack engineering capability in TypeScript and Python, including APIs, services, tooling, and cloud automation.
* Deep experience with core AWS services used in enterprise environments, including IAM, Organizations, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudWatch, KMS, Config, and GuardDuty.
* Proven ability to design and operate AWS governance at scale, including multi\-account strategy, policy guardrails, access control, security standards, and operational controls.
* Strong AWS networking fundamentals, including VPNs, peering, Transit Gateway, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with enterprise SSO; Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) federation into AWS is strongly preferred, including SAML/OIDC, IAM Identity Center, application and role mapping, and access lifecycle practices.
* Experience working in regulated or audit\-ready environments, with strong habits around change control, evidence and traceability, least privilege, and durable controls.
* Demonstrated operational ownership: able to establish meaningful alerts and monitors, reduce noise, improve reliability, respond to incidents, and turn operational learnings into engineering improvements.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience; Pulumi and/or SST strongly preferred. Terraform or AWS CDK experience is transferable and welcome.
* Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions.
* Proficient with modern AI coding and productivity tools, with the judgment to validate outputs, test changes, manage risk, and maintain production quality.
* The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**  

  

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and *their* people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company\-paid life insurance, AD\&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar\-for\-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long\-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company\-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let's achieve the impossible together!

jobs.description:
* Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future\*


**Job Title:** ADAS Systems Engineer
  
**Location:** Dearborn, Michigan
  
  

**What you’ll be doing:**  

* Provide technical leadership in the delivery of ADAS features including all aspects of the delivery cycle (behavior and performance in the field, executing the Plan of Record, and supporting the planned capabilities on the roadmap)
* Accountability in feature delivery and execution partnering with Product Owners (that own feature definition/justification re: customer experience and business value)
* Ideate and evaluate technical deployment options for new and enhanced ADAS features
* Establish and document initial architectural and design assumptions
* Work closely with feature owner to insure customer and business requirements are met and iterate with stakeholders to arrive at most optimum technical deployment assumptions
* Understand current foundational capabilities of system and leverage them effectively to minimize development cost and time
* Perform initial failure mode analysis to insure system is robust to obvious scenarios


**Responsibilities:**  

* Provide technical direction by translating business needs to technical feature requirements and creating a spec to guide downstream development/testing.
* Own the System Design and define the architecture by decomposing requirements into component responsibilities and defining integration points between components/nodes.
* Perform test activities on early bring\-up, prototype proofing, support incremental sprint deliveries
* Sign\-off on test plan correctness and completeness (demonstrating ultimate accountability for the delivery)
* Triaging issues and supporting downstream team: conformance testers, system testers, service testers, field deployments, etc.
* Ensuring FMEA, Functional Safety, Security requirements have been met as appropriate.
* All done per Agile methodology.


**What you need for this position:****Required:**  

* Bachelor or equivalent degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering
* 3\+ years of experience delivering products embedded with software development and/or Systems engineering
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with complex systems
* Working knowledge of wireless, automotive, or consumer electronics systems
* Strong communication and technical documentation skills
* 3 Years experience in Software or Systems technical development
* 3 Years experience in ADAS, automotive, or consumer electronics systems
* Demonstrated knowledge of system engineering process, methods, and tools


**Preferred:**  

* Knowledge of and exposure to a breadth of areas across the ADAS ecosystem is an asset
* Strong written/verbal Communication skills to foster and drive a collaborative development model encompassing development and test engineers, project managers and other key stakeholders.
* Familiarity with automotive industry standards
* Experience with Jira or another defect management system

jobs.description:

ADAS AUTOSAR Software Engineer
  
  

**What you’ll be able to do:**  

We are seeking a diligent, detail\-driven professional to provide vital expertise in support of our Driver Assist Technologies embedded software development activities. This involves applying engineering principles and analytical techniques in AUTOSAR in support of ADAS software development.
  
  

**You will:**  

Generate and check ADAS feature SWCs’ arxmls.
  
Use AUTOSAR Authoring tools Vector Davinci for configuring and generating RTE, integrating Classic AUTOSAR components, and creating AUTOSAR compositions for the ADAS ECU.
  
Validate RTE configurations and generations.
  
Validate the SWCs arxmls, and their inter\-connections.
  
Automate all the above processes/steps for an efficient \& quality AUTOSAR code.
  
Review generated reports and perform any fixes accordingly.
  
Work with SIL and HIL testing teams to continue and expand on CAE procedures to reduce dependence on vehicle\-level testing.
  
Understand sensor and system performance requirements and limitations, to develop robust designs, identify improvements, recognize trade\-offs and make applicable design decisions.
  
Support software signoff, including calibration tuning, for all vehicle programs.
  
  

**The minimum requirements we seek:**  

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
  
5\+ years of experience in AUTOSAR and authoring tools (coursework/internship/co\-op experience allowed)
  
3\+ year of embedded software development
  
  

**Our preferred requirements:**  

Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
  
Software development in C/C\+\+, including Misra compliance
  
Experience with MIL/SIL testing
  
Experience with GitHub, Jira, Agile
  
Experience with software architecture
  
Knowledge of modular application development using models and/or software
  
Understanding of production algorithm development
  
Experience in DAT/ADAS systems/software
  
Good problem\-solving skills and innovative thinking
  
Excellent written and oral communications
  
Ability to work well with others

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Virtualization
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Work Arrangement:**

  

This role is based remotely, but if the candidate lives within a 50 miles radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week (or other frequency dictated by your manager).  



**The Role:**

  

General Motors is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to shape and scale the engineering platforms that build, test, integrate, validate, and deliver embedded software for software\-defined vehicles. This role is for a hands\-on technical leader who can turn ambiguous, cross\-team problems into durable architecture, practical standards, and measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness, release confidence, and product quality.  



The successful candidate will lead a major capability across multiple teams, influence technical direction beyond their immediate organization, and connect software, tooling, infrastructure, test, and release activities into a coherent engineering system.  



**What You'll Do:**

  

* Be a critical leader of software engineering productivity and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities, strategies, process improvements, and lead the change.
* Be hands\-on by leading high impact efforts.
* Be a strong communicator, coach, and mentor.
* Analyze unusual and difficult problems effectively.
* Ability to connect multiple initiatives together to deliver higher value.
* Visualize required innovation, learning and simplification in this space and transition the team to execute what is required to achieve.
* Maintain command skills and empathy at the same time
* Architect enterprise‑scale CI/CD systems for embedded, simulation, and cloud workloads.
* Define branching, release, and quality‑gate standards across multiple engineering domains.
* Design GitOps‑based delivery for multi‑cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Lead progressive delivery strategy including automated rollback and analysis.
* Establish IaC architecture using Terraform modules and multi‑environment patterns.
* Integrate security and compliance into pipelines and artifact flows.
* Define observability standards for pipelines, simulation workloads, and runtime systems.
Mentor DevOps and simulation developers across the organization.  
* 

  

**Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications):**

  

* Bachelor's degree in software engineering or equivalent experience.
* 12\+ years of experience in software development .
* Deep understanding of software architecture for real time systems.
* Experience shipping high quality safety critical products.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work in an action\-oriented decision\-making environment.
* Deep Kubernetes knowledge including cluster operations.
* Strong Terraform/IaC experience with production‑grade module design.
* Experience with embedded or simulation workflows (vECUs, SIL, FMU, SSP).
Cloud architecture experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.  
* 

  

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):**

  

* Master's degree in software engineering or equivalent experience
* 15\+ years of experience in software development .
* Experience in automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, or another embedded, real\-time, regulated, or safety\-critical environment.
* Knowledge of functional safety, ISO 26262, cybersecurity engineering, ASPICE, MISRA, AUTOSAR, or related engineering practices.
* Experience with vehicle\-level integration and validation, including SIL, CoSIM, vECU, HIL, benches, physical systems, or other virtual and hardware\-based environments.
* A record of creating enterprise standards, platform strategies, technical communities, developer self\-service, reliability objectives, or measurable productivity improvements.

Advanced degree in a related technical field.  

* 

**Company Vehicle:**

  

Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, though which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies.  



**Compensation:**

  

The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.  



**The Salary Range:**

  

Salary range for this role is 171,150 and 288,500\. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.  



  

**Bonus Potential:**

  

An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.  



  

**Benefits:**

  

GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. CACI/Space’s Radar and Sensor Technologies group is seeking a systems engineer to support one of our primary programs working with the US Government to understand and define requirements for our software staff. In this position, you will be at the forefront of developing the systems that keep our nation safe and work in space emerging technology. This position will work with our team on adapting our architecture to the program requirements, creating a testing approach, and interacting across our program teams to ensure clear understanding during the software development cycle. The position is based in Ypsilanti, Michigan. This work requires candidates to be a US citizen eligible for a Top Secret clearance.  



  

**Responsibilities:**

  

Take algorithm definitions and prototypes and convert them into robust software applications.


Collaborate with radar/electro\-optical and research scientist experts to solve issues and iterate to improve image product quality.


Provide systems engineering and enterprise architecture support to USG customers.


Work with software engineers to translate signals and architecture into working code.


Develop standard and repeatable processes, as appropriate, to support development and integration of new and emerging capabilities.


Support engineering review boards.


Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely and effective manner.  



  

**Qualifications:**

*Required:*

  

US citizenship eligible for a Top Secret Clearance. Work full\-time on\-site. Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline. In lieu of a degree, four years of experience may be substituted.


2\+ years of experience performing all/most aspects of product development, including defining requirements and validating hardware or software Knowledge of signal processing.

Experience with software and system development projects using model bases system engineering. Experience working with AWS and Microsoft Office. Worked on a team using Agile or SAFe development processes.


Programming experience Experience writing software implementing algorithms.


Desire to learn new technologies.  

  

  

  



*

**A culture of integrity.**

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high\-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.


**An environment of trust.**

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers \- every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.


**A focus on continuous growth.**

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Technician (Client Opening)
jobs.description:
**About Treetown Tech**



Treetown Tech is an engineering and manufacturing company that takes ideas from a napkin sketch through low\-rate production, under one roof. Our teams work side by side across mechanical, manufacturing, electrical, software, and battery engineering to design, build, and manufacture hardware for clients ranging from early\-stage hardware startups to established aerospace, battery, and semiconductor companies.



Our team has built and shipped hardware behind UAV flight controllers, battery management systems and charging electronics, semiconductor test equipment, and industrial automation and control systems. If you like seeing a design go from a schematic to a working prototype to something that ships, you'll find real variety here.


**About the Opportunity**



Treetown Tech is looking for an on\-site, experienced, full\-time Electrical Engineering Technician. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is experienced in building real hardware alongside diverse engineering teams.



You'll fit well here if you keep an organized work area, are deeply committed to cooperation and communication, take safety and quality seriously as a matter of habit rather than compliance, and are comfortable digging into a variety of tasks in a fast\-paced, multi\-disciplined team.



Treetown Tech offers competitive compensation and benefits including healthcare, IRA matching, and generous PTO and sick time.


**What You'll Do**


**Solder \& Assembly**


* Perform PCB assembly including surface\-mount and through\-hole soldering, using solder pencils, hot\-air reflow, and reflow ovens.
* Handle general and rework soldering across a mix of straightforward assembly runs and more detailed, time\-critical rework or design changes.


**Wiring \& Harness Building**


* Build wiring harnesses and wire for AC and DC circuits, including industrial automation wiring, wire end termination/crimping, and connector assembly.
* Read schematics, wiring diagrams, and eCAD to build to print, working collaboratively with the designer or engineer on the project.


**Electrical Testing**


* Support electrical test activities such as charge/discharge testing and end\-of\-line test.
* Collect and record test data accurately and diligently.
* Follow and complete internal quality control documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**


* Keep your work area organized and follow safety protocols and quality standards on every task.
* Flag issues or quality concerns as they come up rather than working around them.


**PLC Cabinet Wiring (bonus capability – not required)**


* PLC cabinet wiring and fluency with wiring diagram/schematic conventions used in cabinet builds.
* Fabrication and assembly of PLC cabinets.
* PLC cabinet testing and quality control.


**What We’re Looking For**


* Electrical shop experience, and comfort working in a fast\-paced, multi\-disciplined team.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbally, with coworkers.
* A habit of showing up on time and staying on task throughout the day.
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to know when to ask for help rather than guess.
* Eagerness to roll with frequent design changes that come with R\&D and prototypes.
* Openness to receiving direction and training from others, and to navigating changing priorities.
* Genuine care for the wellbeing of the people around them. A true team player.
* Driven to reduce cost, complexity, and time for themselves and those around them.
* Ability to lift loads of up to 50 lbs.


**Additional Nice to Haves, but Not Required**


* Soldering/rework certification (IPC or similar).
* Prior troubleshooting experience on machine or PLC electrical systems.
* Experience with small\-scale line manufacturing.
* Experience with parts ordering and inventory.
* Forklift certification.
* Experience coordinating directly with external vendors.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer-IT
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:** Challenge Manufacturing’s mission is to manufacture with operational excellence by empowering our employee\-owners. As a leading tier 1 supplier of complex metal assemblies for the global automotive industry, we drive innovative solutions for future mobility. We believe the best ideas come from individual unique perspectives. These ideas combined with the teamwork of industry leaders allow us to accomplish any challenge. Our team members take pride in the work we do and embody our core values of safety, ownership, and teamwork every day; they are the true driving force in our operations.

  

Challenge is proud to be one of the largest employee\-owned automotive companies in North America. One of the many benefits of joining the Challenge team is the ESOP program. This program allows Challenge to give shares of the Company to all employee\-owners annually. These shares are an additional retirement benefit that will continue to grow during your time at Challenge. Being part of an ESOP means our employee\-owners share in Challenge’s success!

  

Challenge is *\#QualityDriven and \#PeoplePowered!*

 **Who We Want:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented, proactive, and technically skilled Systems Engineer to join our IT Infrastructure team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting core server infrastructure across both Windows Server and Linux environments.


The ideal candidate will manage enterprise services such as Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Exchange, PKI, Microsoft System Center, Nutanix AHV/Hyper\-V, and SAN storage, while driving automation, performance optimization, and security best practices. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy balancing innovation with reliability, we would like to hear from you.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and engineer infrastructure solutions to meet project and operational requirements.
* Build, configure, patch, and maintain Windows and Linux servers according to best practices.
* Administer and optimize Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Microsoft Exchange, PKI, and Microsoft System Center.
* Implement and support virtualization platforms (Nutanix AHV, Hyper\-V) and manage SAN storage infrastructure.
* Monitor system health, track KPIs, perform tuning, and conduct capacity planning for physical and virtual environments.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, and process workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity problems quickly and effectively.
* Ensure systems are secure through regular patching, adherence to security best practices, and proactive threat hunting using SIEM platforms.
* Oversee and enhance backup processes to safeguard data integrity and availability.
* Prepare and deliver audit reports and provide clear documentation to support compliance and management requirements.

Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

  

SEL manufactures intelligent electronic devices (IED), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), and logic controllers that provide state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, communication, and protection of power systems in multiple industries.

* Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution

jobs.title: Experienced Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Controls Engineer – Multiple Career Levels
  
PAR Systems designs and builds custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges across industries including medical device, aerospace, and defense. Our solutions are engineered to solve our customers’ most complex challenges, not pulled from a catalog. You will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging systems incorporating robots, vision, complex motion, lasers, and more.
  
  

We're looking for Controls Engineers across multiple career levels. Levels are based on the experience, technical depth, independence, and leadership each candidate brings, not whether they've worked with every technology or tool we use. If your background is in custom automation and you enjoy figuring out how to make complex machines work, we'd like to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't match every technology listed below.
  
  

What You'll Own
  
As a Controls Engineer at PAR, you'll help bring custom automated equipment from concept to production. Depending on your experience, you may contribute to or independently lead the controls scope of a project, including:
  
* Translating customer and system requirements into a controls architecture and technical approach.
* Designing, programming, and integrating PLC, HMI, motion, robotics, vision, and other automation technologies.
* Bringing equipment to life through power\-up, debug, commissioning, and process optimization.
* Troubleshooting complex hardware, software, and system\-level problems.
* Supporting design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing, installation, and Site Acceptance Testing.
* Partnering with mechanical, electrical, software, project management, operations, and quality teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* At more senior levels, owning controls execution for entire production lines, providing technical direction, mentoring other engineers, and helping teams solve their toughest automation challenges.


**Experience \& Requirements:** What You Bring
  
We're looking for a combination of relevant experience and technical capability. The requirements needed to be successful in this role are:
  
* A relevant engineering, computer science, automation, or technical background through education and/or equivalent experience.
* Experience developing and commissioning controls or software for automated equipment.
* The ability to troubleshoot problems across hardware, software, and machine processes.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering or project team.
* Increasing ownership of controls projects or systems appropriate to your career level.
* Openness to use of AI in your workflow
* Ability to travel to customer sites for installation and commissioning, typically 0–10%, with occasional variation based on project needs.
* US Persons


**Some of the platforms and tools you may work with include:**  

* PLC \& Controls: Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Omron Sysmac Studio, Beckhoff TwinCAT
* HMI/SCADA: FactoryTalk View, Inductive Automation Ignition
* Robotics: FANUC, Epson, KUKA
* Vision: Cognex, Keyence
* Software: Visual Studio, C\#, VB
* Motion: Servo and multi\-axis motion control systems
* Electrical Design: AutoCAD Electrical, ePLAN, or similar tools
* Simulation: Ability to envision and pursue virtual commissioning


Technical Careers at PAR Systems \- Where You Could Fit
  
Great engineering careers are not one\-size\-fits\-all. At PAR Systems, engineers grow by taking on bigger challenges, expanding their technical expertise, and increasing their impact. Whether you are building your foundation, leading complex technical work, solving problems across teams, or shaping the future of our capabilities, there is room to grow and contribute at every stage of your career.
  
  

Our engineering career path includes Engineer, Advanced Engineer, Senior Engineer, and Principal Engineer, with increasing scope, independence, technical leadership, and impact at each level. Progression is based on demonstrated technical capability, problem\-solving, leadership, and impact, not simply years of overall experience.
  
  

For our experienced engineering opportunities, you don't need to determine where you fit before applying. We encourage you to start with a conversation. Together, we'll explore your experience, technical depth, and career interests to determine how they align with our engineering levels and opportunities.
  
  

You’ve learned about what you'll be doing, here are the benefits you'll gain when you join our team:
  
* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing
* First\-of\-a\-kind product culture and project exposure
* Training and development from industry\-leading experts
* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) \& matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability \& Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, \& Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement


PAR Systems is an equal opportunity employer and we value individuals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other status protected by applicable law. We use AI to assist with sorting applications, but real humans do all the evaluating and deciding. If selected for an interview, please advise our Human Resources department if you require accommodation during the interview or assessment process and we will support your accessibility needs. We offer market competitive pay and benefits based upon the candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Our starting rate of pay for these salaried positions range from $110,000\-160,000 annually

As a highly experienced engineer, you will be involved in critical architectural decisions, solve complex and ambiguous problems, and set engineering standards that impact multiple teams.

You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Technical Leads, and cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure our solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business goals.

**Technical Strategy \& System Design**

* Contribute to the design and evolution of core architectural patterns and frameworks used across teams.
* Drive technical roadmap development in partnership with product and engineering leadership.
* Solve complex, ambiguous, and high\-impact technical challenges, balancing trade\-offs in scalability, performance, and cost.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies and approaches that improve system reliability and developer productivity.
* Help ensure that architectural decisions support long\-term maintainability and product growth.

**Technical Execution \& Standards**

* Guide teams in implementing scalable, secure, and high\-quality solutions.

* Communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Act as the point\-person in critical outages and work with the technical lead managers to troubleshoot, diagnose, and fix any issues following our incident process flow.

* Help build and sustain a culture of learning, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
**At Lhoist North America, our core values of Respect, Courage, and Integrity are more than words.** We respect people, encourage courageous innovation, and uphold integrity in everything we do. If these principles resonate with you, you may find your next great opportunity with us.

  

We believe our people make the difference. That’s why we invest in talent by offering meaningful opportunities to grow your skills, expand your knowledge, and pursue your interests. Our work environment prioritizes safety, fosters collaboration across teams, and embraces inclusion. Here, you’ll be challenged to grow, and you’ll be supported throughout your career journey. **Join us and help shape the future of Lhoist North America.**

 **POSITION SUMMARY:**


This position will support the Ste Genevieve Plant directly using existing automation systems and provide technical support as required by the plant. This role will be the liaison between the site management, division and corporate automation teams. Automation technologies will be used to facilitate data\-driven decisions leading to improved production efficiency, safety \& quality.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES \& EXPECTATIONS:**

**1\. Standards and specifications for hardware and software**

* Work with engineers, maintenance, quality and operations to design and implement improvements in Controls and Automation equipment.
* Support and lead automation upgrades and implement division/corporate process control strategies and standards.
* Assist in coordination and oversight, completion, and implementation of plant Automation projects.
* Support design, program, specify, purchase and oversee installation of electrical systems in the plant.
* Program and document Automated equipment including control loops, State Machines, and Sequencers.
* Support maintenance and programming of our control systems and HMIs

 **2\. Optimization of process rate, efficiency, and waste to achieve or exceed budgeted goals and objectives**

* Collaboration with the production team (manager, supervisors and employees) to optimize control logic and resolve process/control failures and faults
* Development, implementation and monitoring of the “man\-machine” interface to achieve repeatable “best” outcomes

 **3\. Procurement process**

* Create scope of documents for projects assigned in accordance with guidelines developed by the operating team.
* Promote cooperative efforts between all functions related to capital projects
* Work closely with Capital Programs team as necessary.

 **4\. Maintain and improve the existing controls and equipment.**

* Calibration of field devices: weigh belts; gas analyzers; thermocouples; pressure and flow transmitters; etc.
* Optimization\-Tuning of control loops
* Maintaining accurate, accessible records of calibrations, jumpers, programming changes, etc.
* Development, implementation and monitoring of “man\-machine” interface and SOP’s
* Troubleshooting and Root cause analysis of equipment and software failures
* Process hazards identified and control logic, limits and other safeguards implemented and maintained in reliable

 **5\. Problem Solving and Decision\-Making Ability**

* Provide technical assistance to all plant personnel in solving control and process problems by utilizing SPC, SQL, Historian, and other tools.
* Work closely with the division/corporate Automation team to ensure consistency.

**6\. Training and development**

* Develop yourself as a positive learner/professional who participates in cross\-functional communication and training between production and engineering teams.
* Drive culture changes of the plants from reactive to proactive in their approach to asset management and reliability.
* Provide feedback to direct managers and supervisors of those managed through projects.
* Train and upskill electricians and other team members

 **7\. Plant IT support for computers, hardware and software.**

* Install, maintain, and support all plant personal computer hardware and software. Liaison for corporate IT department on computer hardware and software installation, maintenance, and upgrades.
* Proficiency in windows based operating systems and networking.

 **8\. Perform other duties as assigned.**

 **ATTRIBUTES:**

* Knowledge of PLC system design (Rockwell Automation preferred) and demonstrated capabilities with computers, VFDs, HMIs, Factory Talk View SE, process instrumentation, supervisory software and networks.
* Must be able perform advanced mathematical calculations, including advanced algebra and statistics.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Develop experience with our Control Systems and HMIs.
* Effective oral, written, and spoken communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and problem\-solving skills.
* Read, write, and interpret documents such as work orders, safety rules, standard operating procedures, electrical drawings, maintenance instructions, and procedural manuals.

 **PHYSICAL DEMANDS INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

* Must be physically able to perform work assigned.
* Must be physically capable of accessing all plant locations.
* Access all areas within a site which could include heights of 150 feet, confined spaces, climbing ladders or stairs, and accessing tunnels.
* Will be working at times in covered environment but mainly in a lime/mineral environment.
* The employee will be exposed to the following working conditions: Extreme Heat and Cold, Noise, Vibration, Oils, and Atmospheric Conditions such as Dust, Fumes, and Lime/Mineral Particles.
* The employee will be required to perform the following actions (from time to time): Standing, walking, balancing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, talking, seeing, hearing and sitting.
* Ability to lift/carry up to 50 pounds.

 **REQUIRED EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Instrumentation. Associate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related technical field or demonstrated skills and abilit

jobs.title: Support Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI\-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision\-making and improve patient outcomes.



At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Support Systems Engineer plays a key role in implementing, configuring, and supporting multiple CareDx software platforms and HL7 interfaces. This role ensures system reliability, performance, and seamless customer experience within defined budgets and timelines.


**Responsibilities:**



Technical Support \& Implementation


* Deploy, configure, and support CareDx software, including transplant, medication, and patient management platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to operating systems, databases (SQL, Oracle), and application interfaces.
* Support and maintain HL7 interfaces, including custom filtering and performance monitoring.
* Assist with remote connectivity setup and VPN configurations for customer sites.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs while managing ticket queues and project timelines.


Customer Engagement \& Documentation


* Advise customers on software and hardware requirements before deployment.
* Provide ongoing support with a strong focus on customer service and follow\-up.
* Document processes, configurations, and troubleshooting steps for internal and external use.


Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement


* Work independently to execute implementation plans and resolve technical issues.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to optimize system performance.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies to improve deployment and support processes.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**



Required:


* Education: Bachelor's degree in MIS, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience: 2\+ years of experience in system engineering, implementation, and automation.
* Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and managing Microsoft SQL Server \& Oracle databases.
* Experience with SAP Crystal Reports and software interface troubleshooting.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows Active Directory and VPN protocols (Cisco, Nortel, RDP, etc.).
* Expectation is to be on call one week per month


Preferred:


* Experience in biomedical systems engineering.
* Familiarity with IIS Web Services and website management.
* Knowledge of coding languages such as Python, C\+\+, or JavaScript.
* Experience with data conversions and network administration.


Success Metrics:


* Provides timely and effective technical support with high customer satisfaction.
* Ensures seamless software deployment with minimal disruptions.
* Maintains accurate documentation and knowledge sharing.
* Continuously enhances technical skills and industry knowledge.


**Additional Details:**



Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.



Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes:


* Competitive base salary and incentive compensation
* Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program
* 401(k) savings plan match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* And more!
* Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers


In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full\-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.



With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it's an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.


**CareDx, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer\-vets/disabled, and participates in the E\-Verify program.** **By proceeding with our application and submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read our** **U.S. Personnel Privacy Notice****and consent to receive email communication from CareDx.** **Certain jurisdictions require notice of how we use and protect your personal information. For more information, please read our** **Privacy Policy**


**The U.S. EEO posters are available****here****.**


**Note: We do not accept resumes from headhunters, placement agencies, or other suppliers that have not signed a formal agreement with us.**

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
TRAVEL: Yes, 25% of the Time**Description**
---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Northrop Grumman is seeking a Principal Software Engineer in Bellevue, NE. In this role, you will have a challenging and rewarding opportunity to contribute to our enterprise\-wide digital transformation. Through the use of DevSecOps and Agile practices, we continue to evolve how we deliver critical national defense products and capabilities for the warfighter. This position supports the OIX program \- a platform which provides secure messaging and cross\-domain solution (CDS) products and services across the federal agencies and foreign partners. Our multi\-disciplinary team including software, systems, cyber, and test engineers employ the latest cutting\-edge technologies to deliver information across security domains.


As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:

* Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions
* Develop software utilizing modern programming languages to modernize and productionize software used to support United States Government requirements
* Implement software systems, applications, and architectures that emphasize modularity, scalability, reliability, precision, accuracy, and performance to meet demanding requirements.
* Conduct multidisciplinary research and collaborate with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software
* Determine computer user needs; analyze system capabilities to resolve issues related to program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
* Ensure industry software engineering best practices and standards are applied and maintained
* Work closely with Software Leads and Architects to understand program intent, system capabilities, and output requirements
* Support customers on site through installations, upgrades and continuous maintenance

*The position requires up to 25% travel and active Secret Clerance and eligibility for Top Secret Security Clearance and SCI, as well as the ability to meet customer\-specific security screening requirements within a timeframe set forth by management.*

**Basic Qualifications for a Principal Software Engineer (T03\)**

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with 5\+ years of relative experience; Master's degree in a STEM discipline with 3\+ years of relative experience; PhD \+ 1 year of relative experience
* **Active Secret security clearance** enrolled in Continuous Evaluation, and ability to obtain TS/SCI
* Ability to meet customer\-specific security screening requirements within a timeframe set forth by management
* Demonstrated ability to analyze system requirements to derive software design and performance requirements
* Proven ability to design and code new software, as well as modify existing software to add new features
* Ability to debug existing software and correct defects
* Experience with open software/system architecture solutions
* Experience with Git\-based or other software configuration management tools
* Ability to work on\-site in Bellevue

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in software application development on Linux in Java, Rust, Ada, shell scripting
* Experience with Security Enhanced Linux (SELinux)
* Experience implementing Cyber Security controls on Linux
* Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with Agile lifecycle process including Scrum and DevSecOps
* Experience developing or deploying Cross Domain Systems
* Experience with supporting customers on site to include installation, maintenance and support

*This position is contingent upon the successful transfer of an active DoD Secret Clearance and the ability to meet customer\-specific security screening requirements (TS/SCI) within a timeframe set forth by management.*


Primary Level Salary Range: $98,400\.00 \- $147,600\.00
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**



The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:


* **Data Processing**: We are building state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user\-friendly, and highly fault\-tolerant.
* **Data Discovery**: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
* **Data Lineage**: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.
  


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
* Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
* Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
* Lead and champion high\-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.
  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
* BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
* Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
* Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
* Experience with distributed system design and development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, continuous delivery environment
  


**Bonus Points (not required):**


* Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in cross\-functional development teams
* Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
* Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.
  


**We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.**

  

**\#LI\-AE1**

 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.**


**Our journey is always people first.**



We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.


**Higher purpose, greater impact.**



We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do.


**Scale up, not starting up.**



Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.



Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.


*Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

* Work with product owners and business partners to translate business needs into well\-scoped technical work and estimates
