jobs.title: Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
About NOV:


**Where Are We?**

We are located at 500 Conroe Park West Dr, Conroe, TX 77303\.


**What Do We Do Here?**

Our Conroe Facility produces downhole products for drilling activities in North America. Our plant has high demand and is operating 24/7 to produce these products for our customers. To meet the demand for our products, we provide employees with an air\-conditioned environment, highly organized and clean 300,000 SQ. ft. fabrication facility, new CNC Machines (Mazak, Mori Sieke, DMG Mori, Weiler, etc.), and a strong safety program designed to ensure our team goes home safe to their families after every shift.


**What is the Team Like?**

At NOV and at our 500 Conroe Park West location, we recognize the value of people. Building strong work relationships is key to keeping talented, reliable, and loyal employees. That’s why we work hard to ensure our team feels appreciated for their hard work. Collaboration, respect, integrity and accountability are core concepts for our success.


**Why Would I Want to Join the Team?**

* Competitive Wages
* Opportunities for Professional \& Personal Growth and Learning
* Great Health \& Wellness Benefits
* Vacation, Sick \& Holiday Pay

***NOV is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates are given consideration for employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.***


  
* Design, program, test, and commission industrial robotic systems.
* Develop robot programs using FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa/Motoman, or Universal Robots.
* Configure EOAT, vision systems, sensors, and peripheral equipment.
* Optimize robot cycle times and troubleshoot robotic systems.
* Collaborate with Controls Engineers to integrate robots with PLCs, HMIs, conveyors, and safety systems.
* Provide production support, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Manage small\-to\-medium automation projects and coordinate suppliers.

  
Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field.
* 3–7 years of industrial robotics experience.
* Experience with industrial robot programming, PLC integration, industrial networking, and manufacturing support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Must be fluent in Chinese  
* 

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience in energy equipment or heavy manufacturing.
* Robotic welding, machine vision, collaborative robots, offline simulation software.
* SprutCAM
* Python or C\# experience.
* Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification.
* Project management experience.

jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.  

We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/30/2026\.  



  

Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. See more information on our benefits here: U.S. Employee Benefits \| Accenture

jobs.title: Manufacturing Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us! Start your next chapter and join MilliporeSigma.

  

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

  

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 **Your Role:**


In the role of Manufacturing Automation Engineer you will develop, enhance, and maintain manufacturing equipment and automation systems at a nucleotide manufacturing site. In this role you will drive engineering improvements that strengthen safety, quality, reliability, and operational efficiency in a regulated ISO 13485 environment. The operation consists of a 37,000 sqft facility operating a wide variety of robotic equipment including automated handling of labware, vision systems and small scale precision liquid handling.


In this role you will lead or contribute to automation projects from concept through implementation, commissioning, documentation, operator training, and handoff to operations.


* Program manufacturing equipment such as Festo and ACS Motion control platforms, Panasonic FP0H, Visual Studio C\# Windows applications, and PIC microcontrollers to control motion platforms, valves and end effectors.
* Analyze production and equipment data to identify and implement improvements in uptime, throughput, cycle time, quality and safety.
* Collaborate closely with safety and quality teams to maintain adherence to regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Use SolidWorks and PDM to create, revise, and maintain engineering drawings and BOMs.
* Create accurate SOPs and maintenance documentation.
* Train operators on safe, effective use of new or modified systems.
* Implement good engineering practices as well as adherence to management of changes policies.
* Work safely and effectively in a live manufacturing environment using standard laboratory PPE.
* Effectively communicate and collaborate across Manufacturing, Quality, Safety, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to deliver robust solutions.
* This position involves less than 5% travel.

 **Who You Are**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in an Engineering discipline (Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, etc.).
* 2\+ years of experience programming or configuring automation systems using PLC, PC\-based, microcontroller, or comparable control platforms.
* 1\+ years of experience in technical documentation, work instructions, or training materials.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, troubleshooting or prototyping electromechanical systems in a laboratory, manufacturing, industrial, or comparable environment.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong communication and collaboration skills across operations, quality, safety, maintenance, and engineering teams.
* Ability to develop clear technical documentation, work instructions, and training materials.
* Experience with equipment qualification, validation, change control, risk assessment, and/or technical investigations.
* Proficiency with source control and documented software release practices.
* Experience using Foundry, Tableau, Power BI or similar tools to provide quality and cost savings insights.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or structured continuous\-improvement experience.

  

Pay Range for this position: $69,500\- $104,200


The offer range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base pay compensation for this position. The actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level of experience, education, skills, and other job\-related factors. Position may be eligible for sales or performance\-based bonuses. Benefits offered by the Company include health insurance, paid time off (PTO), retirement contributions, and other perquisites. For more information click **here**.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Grassroots Carbon is hiring a Data Platform Engineer to build and operate the core data infrastructure powering our soil carbon modeling work and PastureMap grazing management platform. In this role, you will integrate and serve soil measurements, satellite imagery, ranch records, and partner data through a unified database to ensure reliable, high\-integrity access across the company.


As the first dedicated owner of our data platform, you will drive data ingestion, dataset accessibility, and production pipeline architecture. Your immediate mission is to replace manual and ad\-hoc data preparation with dependable, automated workflows that support science, operations, and rancher\-facing products.


You will work closely across our engineering and science teams. While Data \& Soil Science handles model development and scientific validation, you will own the production pipelines and execution runtimes that put approved models into live use. You will also partner with backend engineers on application APIs and integrations, aligning key priorities with the VP of Product \& Technology.  

  

**About You**

Data ingestion and integrations* Build and maintain reliable, automated ingestion pipelines for APIs, hardware feeds (IoT), and imagery services, replacing ad\-hoc manual data extraction.
* Normalize spatial and temporal incoming data from external partners and hardware, establishing clear validation and error\-recovery protocols.


Model operations \& Security* Build secure data services with backend engineers so PastureMap, internal tools, and approved partners can use shared datasets and model outputs.
* Package, deploy, schedule, and monitor science models. Ensure code and inputs are versioned so runs are reproducible and verifiable for carbon crediting.
* Provide documented datasets and accessible query tools for operations and commercial teams. Evaluate AI\-assisted access where it solves a defined need and respects permissions.
* Apply least\-privilege access, ranch\-level data isolation, secrets management, and encryption. Protect rancher and landowner information and support SOC 2 readiness.


Must Haves* 5\+ years in data engineering or data platform work, including ownership of a production data system from design through ongoing operation.
* Strong Python and SQL, with maintainable code, automated tests, and practical debugging skills.
* Production orchestration and deployment experience, including scheduled jobs, backfills, failure recovery, and CI/CD.
* Hands\-on AWS experience, infrastructure as code, and an understanding of cloud operating costs.
* Experience taking ML or scientific models into production, ensuring reproducible runs, versioning, monitoring, and automated recovery.
* Experience handling third\-party API integrations, specifically dealing with rate limits, schema changes, and unreliable source data.


Nice to Haves* Working knowledge of geospatial data, coordinate systems, spatial joins, and tools/formats like H3, PostGIS, GDAL, GeoPandas, or cloud\-optimized GeoTIFFs.
* Experience implementing data access controls, secrets management, and encryption to support SOC 2 readiness or audited MRV systems.
* Familiarity with model deployment tools (MLflow or SageMaker) and serverless batch processing (e.g. Modal).
* Experience ingesting IoT/telemetry data from livestock devices, environmental sensors, or satellite pipelines.
* BS or MS in Computer Science or similar technical studies

**What success looks like**

**In Your First 90 Days:**

* Align on Priorities: Partner with Product, Tech, and Soil Science to select and map out your first high\-value production workflow based on data readiness.
* Ship to Production: Deploy that first pipeline into active use for science or product teams, fully equipped with data validation, access controls, monitoring, and runbooks.
* Build the Blueprint: Establish shared identifiers, source lineage, and repeatable ingestion patterns to form the foundation for all future pipelines.

**In Your First Year:**

* Migrate Historical Data: Successfully migrate and reconcile priority PastureMap legacy data, systematically documenting known gaps.
* Productionize Core Modeling: Power core science inputs and approved production models through versioned, maintainable pipelines feeding a unified, reliable database.
* Scale Data Services: Deliver key integrations and data services built with end\-to\-end lineage, clear SLAs, and documentation that enables seamless team coverage.

Grassroots Carbon works with ranchers to improve grazing practices, restore grasslands, and store carbon in soil. Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

  

SEL manufactures intelligent electronic devices (IED), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), and logic controllers that provide state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, communication, and protection of power systems in multiple industries.

  

SEL Engineering Services (SEL ES) is the sector of SEL that creates solutions to target applications of SEL equipment for worldwide customers. The SEL ES engineering team designs, develops, tests, and commissions projects to meet our customers’ requirements. Applications include, but are not limited to:

* Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution
* Industrial Plants and Universities– Substation and Switchgear
* Renewables – Wind, Solar, and BESS

This role involves applying electrical engineering principles to ensure the efficient and safe operation of power distribution, control systems, and related electrical components.  

  

Job Responsibilities  

  

* Design, develop, and test electrical systems and components for various projects, including power generation, transmission, and distribution.
* Prepare detailed electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and equipment specifications in compliance with industry standards and project requirements.
* Perform calculations for load analysis, voltage drop, short circuit, and protective device coordination.
* Conduct site visits to gather information, assess existing conditions, and oversee the installation and commissioning of electrical systems.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including civil, mechanical, and structural engineers, to integrate electrical designs into overall project plans.
* Develop and implement testing procedures for electrical equipment and systems to ensure performance and reliability.
* Troubleshoot electrical issues and provide solutions during project execution and post\-completion.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant electrical codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards.
* Prepare technical reports, project documentation, and cost estimates for electrical components.
* Stay abreast of new technologies, industry trends, and best practices in electrical engineering.

  

Job Qualifications\*\*  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the heavy civil, industrial, or utilities sectors.
* Proficiency in electrical design software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, ETAP, SKM PowerTools).
* Strong understanding of National Electrical Code (NEC) and other relevant electrical standards.
* Experience with power distribution systems, control circuits, and instrumentation.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical specifications.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe is a plus.
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites as required.

Primoris Pipeline is committed to being the value and customer solutions leader in midstream, transmission, and upstream construction by delivering safe, high quality, environmentally\-compliant, timely and cost\-effective projects for our clients, regardless of size or challenges.**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation, paid weekly.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**:  

  

Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas' portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings' access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

  


**How You Will Make an Impact:**
================================



The **Senior Automation Engineer** leads the technical design and development of industrial automation applications at Atlas, combining hands\-on development with technical leadership. This role builds complex automation solutions on Ignition and Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix platforms while defining and enforcing development standards, application architecture, and engineering best practices. The Senior Automation Engineer also serves as a technical mentor to the automation team, guiding how solutions are designed, developed, and maintained while actively contributing to project delivery.

  


**Responsibilities**

* + Design, develop, and deploy automation solutions using Ignition and Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix platforms.

	+ Experience with Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix and Studio 5000
	+ Experience developing applications in Ignition Perspective and/or Vision

	+ Proven ability to lead technical projects and mentor other engineers
	+ Experience providing technical oversight of third\-party automation vendors, including deliverable review, issue resolution, and alignment to engineering standards
	+ Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills
	+ Willingness and ability to work flexible hours and to be on\-call after hours
	+ Willingness to work at multiple geographic locations within Texas, including travel to Kermit, Monahans, and other locations
	+ Valid Driver's License and qualified through our company insurance/Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Policy
* **Preferred:**

	+ Strong software development experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar programming languages, including object\-oriented programming principles, source control (Git), code review practices, and modern software development workflows
	+ Experience developing scripts, tools, and automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and streamline administrative processes across Windows and Linux environments
	+ Familiarity with industrial automation and networking technologies, including LAN/WAN infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and distributed control platforms such as Opto 22 groov EPIC, CODESYS, edge computing devices, and remote operations systems
	+ Experience with industrial data platforms, historians, and reporting systems such as OSI PI, Canary, SQL\-based solutions, and cloud\-connected analytics platforms
	+ Experience in mining, manufacturing, energy, or similarly demanding industrial operations

  

**Reporting Relationship:**


* Reports To: Process Engineer Manager

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Platform Architecture
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what we can accomplish together. Do you love crafting elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Can you intrinsically see the importance of every detail?  

  

At Apple, our Platform Architecture group is responsible for connecting our hardware and software into one unified system. Join this team, and you'll collaborate with engineers across Apple to build and deploy forward\-looking prototype systems that contribute to the development of our world renowned hardware and software architecture. You and your team will confirm that every product we make performs exactly as intended. Together, our work will be the reason millions of customers feel that they can trust our devices every single day.  

  

**Description**  

  

Apple’s Platform Architecture group is seeking an experienced systems engineer, who will support our current, as well as develop new hardware/software interface technologies for chip development and verification. You will work with and support our world leading silicon engineering teams on next generation chips, which end up in the hands of millions of users worldwide.","responsibilities":"Design and develop new technologies for interfacing software to hardware prototypes.  

  

Work with software, design verification and silicon validation teams to deploy and transfer this technology.  

  

Support various groups (software, architecture, verification, validation) in the use of existing and the development of new technology.  

  

Work independently and lead deliverables to different teams.  

  

Occasional travel to development groups in the US and overseas.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

10\+ years of relevant industry experience.  

  

Experience with C\+\+17 or later, including templates for compile\-time optimizations.  

  

Experience with SystemVerilog, HDL simulation tools, and protocols such as AXI.  

  

Experience with atomics and memory ordering.  

  

Experience moving data over sockets, shared memory, or PCIe.  

  

Experience with internal customer support.  

  

Excellent communication, analytical, and documentation skills.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related engineering field.  

  

Experience programming in C\+\+.  

  

Experience with multi\-threading/concurrency.  

  

Experience with a scripting language such as Python or Lua.  

  

Experience with debugging and profiling tools.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

Fortem is looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a passion for solving difficult problems. In this role you will primarily be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving DroneHunter’s ability to autonomously seek and capture targets safely.


The ideal candidate combines technical expertise in embedded systems with architectural thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and a passion for building reliable, safety\-critical drone platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and test flight control and autonomy software, including state estimation, sensor fusion, and control loops
* Develop navigation and path\-planning algorithms, including obstacle avoidance and GPS/GNSS\-based positioning
* Build and maintain firmware for flight controllers and embedded hardware, working within real\-time constraints
* Implement communication protocols for telemetry, command\-and\-control, and failsafe/lost\-link scenarios
* Contribute to ground control station software for mission planning, monitoring, and post\-flight analysis
* Build and run hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) simulations to validate software before field testing
* Collaborate closely with hardware, mechanical, and regulatory/compliance teams to ensure system\-level reliability
* Participate in field testing and flight trials, iterating quickly based on real\-world results
* Write clean, well\-documented, and testable code, and participate in code reviews
* Other software engineering tasks and projects as assigned by engineering leadership


Requirements:
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally in robotics, aerospace, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles
* Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and/or Python; experience with real\-time or embedded systems is a plus
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment with frequent hardware testing
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to debug complex, multi\-layered systems (hardware \+ software)
* Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and code review workflows
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2, PX4, or ArduPilot
* Understanding of communication protocols (MAVLink, UART, CAN, etc.)
* Part 107 Remote Pilot License

 **ABOUT US**


Fortem Technologies is the global leader in airspace security, delivering advanced solutions that protect against today’s autonomous aerial threats while ensuring the safety of tomorrow’s advanced air mobility. Fortem’s AI\-powered SkyDome® Family of Systems combines TrueView™ sensors, command\-and\-control software, and autonomous DroneHunter® interceptors to defend military, government, and commercial operations worldwide from hostile or unauthorized drones. Fortem is the only company authorized to deploy a drone\-on\-drone kinetic interceptor in U.S. airspace, and its technology has been validated in operational deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia.


Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Fortem is privately held and backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, AE Industrial Partners, AIM13, Signia Venture Partners, and others.

*Fortem Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We believe that diversity drives innovation and makes us stronger.*

**Job Code: 44955**

**Job Location: Salt Lake City, Utah**

**Job Schedule: 9/80\- Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off**

 **Job Description:**


We are seeking an ambitious hardware engineer to help us design custom circuit technology for software\-defined radio applications. As a member of our team, you’ll help us build groundbreaking digital and RF circuits for the special operations and intelligence communities to address challenging national security problems and enable planning and decision making in domains as diverse as active threat deterrence, signal intelligence, cyber operations, machine learning, image processing, and applied data analytics. You’ll join a multidisciplinary team of engineers who believe in fostering an open, collaborative work environment to solve complex problems.

  

As a Hardware Design Engineer, you will assist in the development of communications systems through board\-level integration of high\-speed digital components, commercially available chipsets, and embedded processors. Product Design: Schematic Capture, Simulations, PCB analysis and layout.

 **Essential Functions:**

* Document your designs from requirements, testing procedures and bill of material.
* Perform detailed performance and functional measurements and debug at a hardware level.
* Create custom Circuit Cards, utilizing FPGAs, Embedded Processors, networking components, and other electronic components.

* Support test engineering with transition of hardware to manufacturing testing.
* Contribute to design review, system integration.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Integration
jobs.description:
Description:

Fortem Technologies is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (C\+\+) to lead the integration of third\-party sensors and mitigation systems into Fortem’s established SkyDome Family of Systems. In this role, you will design and build robust C\+\+ software that connects new radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic, and mitigator hardware into Fortem’s command\-and\-control platform, enabling rapid onboarding of best\-in\-class third\-party technology alongside Fortem’s own TrueView sensors and DroneHunter interceptors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or higher) software that integrates third\-party sensors (radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic) and mitigation systems (RF jammers, kinetic interceptors) into the SkyDome command\-and\-control platform
* Develop and maintain driver/interface layers, SDKs, and protocol adapters (e.g., ASTERIX, NMEA, proprietary vendor APIs) for new sensor and mitigator integrations
* Partner with hardware, systems engineering, and product teams to define integration requirements and interface control documents (ICDs)
* Build and maintain automated test harnesses to validate sensor and mitigator data fidelity and system\-level performance
* Debug and resolve real\-time data processing and multi\-threading issues across distributed sensor networks
* Participate in design and code reviews, upholding high standards for reliability and maintainability
* Support field testing and deployment of newly integrated capabilities at customer sites
* Other engineering duties and tasks as assigned by the Director of Software Engineering or otehr engineering leadership


Requirements:
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience in C\+\+, with required proficiency in C\+\+17 or higher
* Experience integrating third\-party hardware/sensors (radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic) via serial, Ethernet, or custom protocols
* Strong understanding of multi\-threaded, real\-time, and networked systems programming
* Experience developing in Linux\-based environments
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross\-functionally with hardware and systems teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with counter\-UAS, radar, or other defense/aerospace systems
* Familiarity with ASTERIX, DDS, ROS/ROS2, or similar sensor fusion middleware
* Experience with sensor fusion, track correlation, or multi\-sensor data processing
* Active or ability to obtain a U.S. government security clearance
* Experience with containerized deployment (Docker/Kubernetes)

**ABOUT US**


Fortem Technologies is the global leader in airspace security, delivering advanced solutions that protect against today’s autonomous aerial threats while ensuring the safety of tomorrow’s advanced air mobility. Fortem’s AI\-powered SkyDome® Family of Systems combines TrueView™ sensors, command\-and\-control software, and autonomous DroneHunter® interceptors to defend military, government, and commercial operations worldwide from hostile or unauthorized drones. Fortem is the only company authorized to deploy a drone\-on\-drone kinetic interceptor in U.S. airspace, and its technology has been validated in operational deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia.


Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Fortem is privately held and backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, AE Industrial Partners, AIM13, Signia Venture Partners, and others.

*Fortem Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We believe that diversity drives innovation and makes us stronger.*

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**Electrical Engineer II**
==========================

**Department:** Engineering
  

**Level:** Individual Contributor — Level II
  

**Reports To:** Site Engineering Manager
  

**Location:** Grantsville, Utah
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  



  

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

The Electrical Engineer II turns complex electrical designs into reliable, scalable manufacturing solutions for hyperscale data\-center and energy customers.


This hands\-on role supports NPI, qualification, production ramp, and sustaining operations while improving test performance, resolving production issues, and meeting quality, cost, delivery, reliability, and customer requirements.


The ideal candidate combines strong electrical\-engineering fundamentals, disciplined problem solving, sound judgment, and clear communication in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.  



  

**What will you do?**

* Support prototype, pilot, qualification, ramp, and sustaining production activities.
* Review schematics, PCBAs, wiring, cables, specifications, and drawings for manufacturability, testability, reliability, and scale.
* Partner with Test Engineering to define, validate, maintain, and troubleshoot manufacturing test solutions.
* Diagnose electrical failures at component, PCB, subassembly, system, and rack levels.
* Lead investigations of defects, test failures, and intermittent issues; verify corrective actions with cross\-functional teams.
* Analyze production and test data to improve quality, yield, throughput, coverage, cost, and cycle time.
* Support DFM/DFA/DFT reviews, PFMEA, control plans, capability studies, risk assessments, and readiness reviews.

Coordinate ECOs, deviations, component qualifications, configuration changes, and product revisions.  

* 

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Technology, a related technical field; or a combination of education, training, and relevant experience.  

* 

**Experience:**

Two to five years of relevant experience in electrical, manufacturing, or hardware engineering.  

* 

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Strong knowledge of electrical and electronic circuits and systems.
* Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, drawings, and technical specifications.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting electrical hardware with laboratory and diagnostic equipment.
Experience collaborating across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting NPI, high\-volume electronics, or electromechanical contract manufacturing.
* Knowledge of server or rack\-level power distribution, AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion, grounding, and protection.
* Experience with PCB assemblies, cable assemblies, backplanes, power\-distribution boards, or system\-level integration.
* Familiarity with high\-speed digital systems, signal integrity, or communication interfaces such as PCIe, Ethernet, I²C, SPI, UART, or USB.
* Experience developing or troubleshooting manufacturing test equipment and automated test systems.
* Familiarity with engineering or test\-automation tools such as LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, C/C\+\+, Altium, Cadence, or OrCAD.

Knowledge of DFM, DFA, DFT, and applicable IPC, UL, IEC, or IEEE standards.  

* 

**What Can Jabil Offer You?**

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:


* Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
* 401K Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Life, AD\&D, and Disability Insurance
* Commuter Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pet Insurance
* Adoption Assistance
* Annual Merit Increases
Community Volunteer Opportunities  
*

jobs.description:
**About Decision Technologies, Inc.**


Decision Technologies was founded to help bridge the gap between Department of Defense and Federal Government acquisition programs and technology to help our customers optimize their decision\-making process. Over the years, our areas of expertise have expanded to include Systems Engineering, Program Management, In\-Service Engineering, Equipment Repair, Research and Development, Test and Evaluation, and Intelligence and Counterintelligence Support. Our growth and success have positioned us as a premier engineering and intelligence services provider contributing to our nation's defense.


Our company culture cultivates talented problem\-solvers on focused on performance with industry\-leading teamwork and responsiveness. We have established a reputation for offering superior services and solutions, proven integrity and innovation, employee engagement and development, and customer collaboration.


Bring your expertise and knowledge to our team!

  

Decision Technologies is seeking an experienced, high\-impact **Lead Systems Engineer** ready to take the next major step in their career trajectory by serving as the principal technical direction engineer embedded within a major U.S. Navy weapon system program office. **This is a 100% in\-office (Arlington, VA), on\-site position sitting inside the Navy program office spaces. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work arrangements.**

 **Position Description:**


This role is tailored for an accomplished surface weapons or combat systems engineer, especially those with direct experience at OEMs and Labs/Warfare Centers who are looking to move beyond isolated subsystem tasks and transition into high\-visibility technical leadership across the Navy enterprise. Embedded directly with program leadership, you will partner with the Government Technical Director to steer future weapon capability, analyze real\-world operational feedback from the Fleet, and translate emerging threat intelligence into actionable science \& technology (S\&T) roadmaps for the next generation of surface munitions and ship self\-defense capabilities.

 **Responsibilities**


The selectee will serve as the Decision Technologies Lead Systems Engineer for U.S. Navy Terminal Defense Systems engineering support. In this capacity, you will drive top\-level engineering analysis, architectural roadmapping, and operational alignment across the portfolio:

* **Operational Fleet Feedback \& Threat Analysis:** Serve as the trusted technical advisor to the Government Technical Director, keeping a constant pulse on real\-world operational challenges, Fleet feedback, and live combat engagements to rapidly inform near\-term CONOPS and long\-term capability baselines.
* **Threat vs. Weapon Systems Requirements Analysis:** Analyze cutting\-edge threat intelligence and emerging adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) against current and planned surface weapon capabilities to identify gaps, update weapon specifications, and drive survivability solutions.
* **Combat System \& Weapon Integration:** Direct system\-of\-systems (SoS) integration studies and interface definitions linking terminal defense weapons (e.g., RAM, CIWS) into ship combat systems (such as SSDS and Aegis) and advanced sensor suites (e.g., SPY\-6 EASR).
* **High\-Level Stakeholder \& Enterprise Alignment:** Interface at the senior executive and Flag/SES levels across PAE Munitions, PAE Mission Systems, OPNAV, warfare centers (NSWC Dahlgren, NSWC Port Hueneme, NAWC China Lake), international cooperative partners, and national security leadership.
* **Digital Engineering Leadership:** Guide the program office’s model\-based transition by applying Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) frameworks (SysML, Cameo/MagicDraw), digital threads, and Agile/DevSecOps practices to weapons modernization lifecycles.

 **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** *Master’s Degree* in a science, engineering, technology, or mathematics (STEM) discipline (or *Bachelor’s Degree* with equivalent demonstrated experience directly with U.S. Navy surface weapon systems or combat systems).
* **Experience:** 10 years of systems engineering experience with U.S. Navy surface weapon systems, surface combat systems (e.g., SSDS, Aegis), or naval guided munitions.
* **Clearance:** Active DoD **SECRET** clearance required (Top Secret eligible preferred); ability to access SIPRNet and handle classified intelligence/threat briefings.

 **Desired Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in a science, engineering, technology, or math discipline.
* Direct technical experience with Navy terminal defense elements, including the **Rolling Airframe Missile (RAM)** and **Close\-In Weapon System (CIWS)** weapon systems, launchers, and guided missile rounds.
* Proven track record leading requirements analysis, weapon specification development, and System Engineering Technical Reviews (SETR) according to the NAVSEA Technical Review Manual (TRM).
* Practical familiarity with Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and architectures (e.g., Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, SysML, DoDAF).
* Working knowledge of weapon\-to\-combat system interface documentation (ICDs, IRSs), firing policies, and combat system designation loops.
* Excellent executive briefing, written communication, and cross\-functional leadership skills with the poise to advise military program managers, technical directors, and international steering committees.

 **Travel Requirements**

* Limited travel required (\~10%), primarily to warfare centers, test facilities, or OEM plant l

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.  

  

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
* Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
* Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well\-thought\-out products.
* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

  

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.  

  

About the team  

Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.  

  

We value collaboration, creative problem\-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you are excited about working on large\-scale infrastructure challenges alongside a talented group of engineers, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation o

jobs.title: Software Engineer, EC2 Nitro
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


EC2 Networking is at an exciting inflection point as we shape the next generation of cloud networking. To deliver on our ambitious roadmap, we are growing our team and looking for talented engineers to join us.  

  

You will be part of the team that owns the software\-defined networking dataplane stack powering EC2 across workloads such as machine learning, high\-performance computing, cloud gaming, healthcare, fintech, and video streaming. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide by delivering secure, scalable, highly available, and high\-performance networking at massive scale.  

  

In this role, you will own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of networking capabilities across multiple areas. This includes performance and availability improvements for machine learning and high\-performance workloads running on accelerated EC2 platforms, as well as new high\-performance networking interfaces and instance capabilities for edge computing.  

  

You will help design and build the next generation of high\-performance virtualized networking capabilities for EC2\. This work spans the networking dataplane, hardware and software co\-design to implement novel HW offload capabilities, packet\-processing optimizations to achieve high PPS and bandwidth, hardware offload capabilities, and new approaches to flow management and caching. You will solve complex systems challenges where performance, scale, availability, and correctness are all critical, while helping extend EC2 networking to support new workload types and deployment environments.  

  

We are looking for software engineers with experience in dataplane development, systems or embedded software, cloud computing, and networking. The role offers broad technical scope and the opportunity to influence multiple platforms, solve complex distributed systems problems, and innovate across the EC2 networking stack.  

  

You will also work alongside and learn from Principal, Senior Principal, and Distinguished Engineers across EC2, AWS, and Amazon, providing exceptional opportunities to deepen your technical expertise and accelerate your career growth.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, scoping, implementation, and integration testing of performance optimizations and dataplane features that run on the EC2 Nitro System that power Machine Learning workloads.
* You set high standards for development processes, tools, and automation to enhance team productivity and quality.
* You influence best engineering practices on design and coding.
* You identify business problems and opportunities, and advocate for technical solutions that influences the technical roadmap for your team.
* Mentor junior engineers with scoping, design, and developing scalable and maintainable code.
* Collaborate with Senior/Principal Engineers, Product Managers, Sr TPMs, and cross\-functional teams to define requirements, system architectures, and implement robust and scalable solutions.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 4\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 4\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 3\+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience
* 4\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience in embedded development in C/C\+\+
* Knowledge of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference
* Experience in software development, or experience in Linux and Networking protocols and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.  

  

The Electrical Engineer will be a member of Amazon Leo's Inter\-Satellite Link Avionics team, focusing on the design of electrical functions including analog sensor signal conditioning and processing, motor and actuator control, embedded digital electronics, power regulation, and overall monitoring and control across spacecraft interfaces.  

  

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

In this role, you will be expected to own a variety of tasks, from board design and component selection to layout review, board bring\-up, system test, and root\-cause analysis at the subsystem and system levels. You will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality and innovative designs while also supporting other Amazon Leo colleagues by reviewing and improving board\-level and other electrical designs.  

  

We are looking for an engineer who combines superb technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively. You will be expected to work with a team of top\-notch engineers and collaborate with multiple spacecraft design and integration teams. You should be comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy and relish the idea of solving problems that have not been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun, and make a positive impact on tens of millions of people.  

  

A day in the life  

You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. As an Electrical Engineer, your tasks would vary between board design, layout reviews, test plan development, qualification and root cause analysis. This is a cross\-functional role requiring constant interaction with multiple HW/SW design teams and end\-users.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in hardware development across multiple phases of the product life cycle in consumer electronics, power electronics, robotics, aerospace, automotive, communications, or a combination thereof.
* Demonstrated technical depth in board\-level electrical hardware design, including areas such as precision analog and sensor electronics, embedded digital systems, high\-speed interfaces, motor or actuator control, memory, or power regulation.
* Experience with PCB design, board bring\-up, and debugging involving components such as microprocessors, SoCs, FPGAs, memories, power supplies, ADCs, DACs, and sensors.
* Experience with complex board designs involving high\-speed interconnects, high\-reliability electronics, power regulation, or motor and actuator\-control electronics.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB\-layout ECAD tools.
* Hands\-on experience performing bench design\-verification testing and debug using oscilloscopes and other common electrical laboratory equipment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* M.S. or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Broad hardware\-development experience spanning multiple electrical engineering disciplines.
* Experience designing precision analog circuits involving ADCs, DACs, low\-noise amplifiers, transimpedance amplifiers, sensors, or filters.
* Experience with motor drivers, current sensing, feedback circuits, or actuator\-control electronics.
* Experience with embedded processors, SoCs, FPGAs, or memories such as DDR, NOR flash, or FRAM.
* Experience with high\-speed circuit design, transmission lines, controlled\-impedance routing, signal integrity, or power integrity.
* Experience designing or debugging board\-level power supplies, including buck converters and LDOs.
* Experience using circuit simulation and analysis tools such as LTspice or MATLAB.

jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  

  

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience with developing large\-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies or storage.
* Experience programming in C\+\+.
* Experience with the following: Distributed Systems, Debugging.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Experience shipping mission\-critical code with high performance and correctness requirements.
* Experience in debugging performance of a multi\-node distributed systems.
* Domain knowledge in the SQL database query processing and query optimization space.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Join the Query Optimization team in BigQuery. We're at the forefront of cloud\-native data warehousing, powering mission\-critical analytics for the world’s largest enterprises. We make sure that customers can get the answers they need as quickly and smoothly as possible through a variety of means, including algebraic SQL enhancements and materialized views.  

In this role, you will learn execution dynamics and tuning at depth, test your limits, and deliver customer\-focused innovation across a growing set of crucial workloads. If you're ready to make a significant difference on a global platform used by millions and dive into the technical depths of high\-performance information processing, we want to hear from you.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.  

  

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.

* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.

* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.

Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. Tesla Laboratories is a Service\-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. Requirements  


Tesla Laboratories is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4\). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design\-Bid\-Build and Design\-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).  


Perform facilities electrical engineering design tasks, including:  


Design calculations to size electrical services, service transformers, and secondary power distribution systems.  


Calculations to size overcurrent devices, disconnect switches, branch circuits, and feeders.  


Lighting calculations, lighting layouts, and specifying of light fixtures.  


Develop drawings using AutoCAD and edit product specifications; well versed with the National Electric Code (NEC).  


In addition, the Electrical Engineer will:  


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements.  


Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.).  


Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes.  


Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing.  


Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues.

Join GE HealthCare and help develop the advanced electronics behind next\-generation Magnetic Resonance imaging systems.  

  

As a Senior Electrical Engineer on our Digital Controls \& Mixed Signal Engineering team, you will design and debug complex circuit boards and electronic subsystems incorporating analog circuitry, power, signal conditioning, data converters, communications, and embedded digital devices.  

  

We are seeking a strong, hands\-on hardware engineer with sound technical judgment and experience turning challenging designs into reliable products. This role also provides opportunities to lead projects, mentor engineers, influence technical decisions, and improve reusable designs and engineering practices.  

  

Candidates may come from many industries and technical backgrounds. Relevant experience may involve microcontrollers, processors, DSPs, SoCs, ASICs, or programmable logic. FPGA or HDL development experience is not required.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and verify mixed\-signal circuit boards and electronic subsystems for advanced MRI platforms.
* Develop hardware integrating analog signal chains, data converters, power circuitry, communication interfaces, and embedded or complex digital devices.
* Perform component selection, schematic development, circuit analysis, design reviews, board bring\-up, laboratory characterization, debugging, and system integration.
* Define and validate electrical interfaces across hardware, programmable devices, firmware, software, mechanical, and systems engineering.
* Develop verification approaches and lead or contribute to root\-cause investigations.
* Support signal integrity, power integrity, EMC, reliability, testability, and manufacturability activities.
* Support hardware throughout the product lifecycle, from early architecture through production and field support.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Five or more years of experience designing and debugging electronic hardware.
* Demonstrated strength in mixed\-signal board or subsystem design.
* Hands\-on experience in several areas such as analog signal conditioning, sensors, data converters, embedded processors, microcontrollers, power electronics, controls, or communications.
* Experience integrating analog circuitry with a microcontroller, processor, DSP, SoC, ASIC, programmable\-logic device, or similar digital device.
* Experience with schematic development, component selection, board bring\-up, laboratory testing, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Familiarity with embedded interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, or comparable technologies.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with precision analog circuitry, sensors, ADCs, DACs, power, EMC, signal integrity, or high\-speed digital interfaces.
