* Experience with regulated, safety\-critical, high\-reliability, harsh\-environment, or high\-volume products.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**  
DEVELOP LLC is an engineering company that designs and builds custom machines and robotic integrations for manufacturers across the country. We are a FANUC Authorized Systems Integrator and an A3 Certified Robot Integrator based in Verona, Wisconsin, and we are building a company that compounds year over year.  
We are not trying to be the biggest. We are trying to own the machine building market in North America. We do it by being the best, earning long\-term client relationships, and building a team that gets stronger every year.

**WHAT THE JOB IS**  
You will help create, review, and test machine code that will make automated systems function for manufacturing cells. You will need to work side by side with mechanical, manufacturing, electrical and assembly to make sure your code functions with the rest of the system. You will need to understand how to make systems work in the real world and be an active test engineer as well. When questions come up you help solve them. When things get confusing you help clear the path. When something works you learn why. When something does not you help fix it and move forward.

**DAY TO DAY**  
A typical week looks like this:

* Design flow charts covering normal operation and error handling.
* Review and write code to make sure it both functions before being run on the machine
* Coordinate with mechanical and electrical to make sure hardware and software synchronize well
* Test the machines to make sure the machine meets requirements

If you like seeing what you design get built and shipped, this role fits.  
If you prefer handing things off with no follow up, this is not the place.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Degree in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field
* 1\-2 years’ experience programming using ladder logic or structured text
* Experience using Git version control
* An understanding of how to define and test technical requirements
* Comfortable working around machines, tools, and shop environments
* Curiosity, ownership, and pride in work that runs in production

**WHAT HELPS YOU STAND OUT**

* Experience with QML or Azure
* Familiarity with common electromechanical systems
* TIA Portal or RSlogix experience
* Hands\-on testing experience
* Time spent around automation, robotics or industrial equipment

**WHAT FITS OUR CULTURE**

* You bring energy and follow through
* You want to learn and take on more responsibility
* You enjoy being part of a small team that works closely together
* You care about the quality of your work and how it performs in the field
* You want your career to move forward

**JOB TYPE:** Full\-time

**PAY**: $65,000 \- $110,000

**BENEFITS:**

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance

**WORK LOCATION:** In person, 319 YARD DRIVE, VERONA, WI 53593

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

jobs.title: Manufacturing Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about automation, controls engineering, and continuous improvement?**


Join our team as a Manufacturing Controls Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our manufacturing operations. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands\-on engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, implementing innovative automation solutions, and improving operational performance.


In this role, you'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize advanced manufacturing control systems that drive safety, quality, reliability, and productivity. If you're looking for a position where your expertise directly influences business success, we'd love to hear from you.

**Location:**


This role is located in our facility in Monroe, Wisconsin, and works onsite Monday through Friday. Remote work is not available.


**Position Summary:**


The Manufacturing Controls Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing automation and control systems. This role combines technical expertise, project leadership, and problem\-solving skills to support production operations and ensure optimal equipment performance.


Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external partners, you will lead automation initiatives, support new equipment installations, troubleshoot complex systems, and identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, program, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC, HMI, robotics, and industrial automation systems to ensure maximum reliability and performance.
* Develop, modify, and improve control systems for manufacturing equipment and production lines.
* Support the installation, startup, commissioning, validation, and integration of new manufacturing equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve electrical, controls, robotics, and industrial network issues to minimize downtime and optimize production performance.
* Optimize manufacturing processes through automation technologies, data\-driven analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Create and maintain electrical schematics, control narratives, I/O lists, technical drawings, and supporting documentation.
* Manage controls\-related projects, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, vendor management, and project execution.
* Support maintenance teams in troubleshooting equipment failures and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Maintain critical controls spare parts inventories and pre\-program replacement components to support rapid recovery efforts.
* Lead root cause analysis activities and implement sustainable solutions to improve reliability and throughput.
* Ensure all systems comply with company safety standards, electrical codes, food safety requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and external resources to complete projects and service activities.
* Provide technical training and ongoing support to manufacturing, maintenance, and engineering personnel.
* Complete work orders, maintenance records, logs, and system documentation accurately and on time.
* Operate material handling and powered industrial equipment as required.
* Support compliance with BRCGS, HACCP, GMP, OSHA, and other applicable food safety and sanitation standards.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned.




**What We Are Looking For:**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field; or a minimum of three years of experience in manufacturing automation or controls engineering.
* Experience programming, troubleshooting, and supporting PLC systems, including Allen\-Bradley platforms.
* Strong knowledge of HMI systems, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, robotics, and industrial control systems.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and DeviceNet.
* Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and root cause problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management abilities.
* Experience working in manufacturing environments with automated production equipment.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced knowledge of electrical controls, control wiring, panel design, transducers, and machine controls.
* Working knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, packaging equipment, machine guarding, drive belts, alignments, and related mechanical systems.
* Ability to analyze system performance and identify opportunities for automation, reliability, and efficiency improvements.
* Proficiency using engineering software and diagnostic tools to support system development and troubleshooting.

**Professional Attributes**

* Self\-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Team\-oriented mindset with the ability to effectively collaborate across engineering, maintenance, production, and leadership teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Willingness to work occasional evenings, weekends, or emergency call\-ins when business needs require.
* Ability to travel periodically for training, vendor support, and equipment commissioning activities.

**Why Join Us?**


At Klondike Cheese Co., we believe in the power of cheese to bring joy to people’s lives. We’re not just in the business of making cheese; we’re in the business of making moments memorable. As we continue to grow and share our love for cheese with the world, we’re always on the lookout for talented individuals who share our passion.


* Be a key contributor to high\-impact automation and manufacturing improvement projects.
* Work with advanced control systems, robotics, and emerging manufacturing tech

jobs.title: Early Career Electrical Engineer (Mission Critical/Data Center)
jobs.description:
**This Opportunity**
--------------------

WSP is currently initiating a search for an **Early Career Electrical Engineer** for our **Milwaukee, WI** office


Takes part in providing local technical assistance for the due diligence, investigation, remediation, impact assessment, permitting, design, development, and construction of utility, industrial, and commercial scale projects in the public and private sector. Tasks may include basic assistance with the research, design, concept development, and construction of transmission and distribution substations, power distribution, power regulation, renewable energy, as well as protection and control systems in a wide variety of contexts (utilities, transportation, building, and Federal, State, and local government projects). Generates accurate and concise documentation regarding assigned aspects of the project. Ensures that responsibilities are delivered and adhered to with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry standards for design, safety, and functionality.


**Your Impact**
---------------

* Under general supervision, assist with collecting, compiling, and analyzing data relating to substation components, equipment specifications for procurement package development and pricing, IFR/IRC design and review processes, and IEEE/NESC Standards/NERC regulations for design work.
* Assist with performing basic professional electrical engineering work relating to the design of single line, three line, wiring diagrams, general arrangement, substation layout and bus arrangement, grounding grid design and lightning protection in conformance with applicable rules, standards, and construction or operating permits.
* Perform routine engineering functions and provide entry\-level technical assistance on various design requirements, equipment sizing and cabling, AC/DC panel design, and conduit and trenching design strategies to account for the safety and functionality of end\-users, systems, and infrastructure.
* Assist with verifying the characteristics of a site and providing basic technical assistance on engineering, design, testing, maintenance, and construction procedures and issues.
* Under close supervision, develop electrical calculations for loads, equipment sizing, feeder sizing, voltage drop, grounding, lighting circuits and controls, facility and electrical service, and power distribution.
* Generate complete, accurate, and concise documentation using electronic systems, drawings, and field/work site notebook/logs.
* Comply with safety guidelines and site\-specific procedures which include but are not limited to, location data, statistical documentation, engineering studies and surveys, and construction.
* Complete training on assigned tasks.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision\-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering.
* 0 to 1 years of relevant post education experience.
* Excellent research skills with analytical mindset.
* General understanding of electrical engineering as applied in design engineering of large capital projects.
* Familiarity with relevant engineering and electrical construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record\-keeping requirements.
* Competent interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non\-engineering audience.
* Proficient self\-leadership with attention to detail, multi\-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to work independently under general supervision, as well as part of a team to meet business objectives.
* Basic proficiency with technical writing, office automation, software, spreadsheets, technology, and tools.
* Familiarity with discipline\-specific design software (i.e., CADD, Aspen, and CAPE), AutoCADD electrical.
* Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
* Ability to work schedules conducive to project\-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
* Occasional travel may be required depending on project\-specific requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Engineer in Training Certification.
* Prior internship related to the degree of study and the specific engineering discipline.
A member of and/or actively participate in local professional practice organizations.

jobs.title: Security Software Engineer, Endpoint Security
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**



We're seeking a Security Software Engineer to develop novel security tooling for securing embedded Linux systems and Android devices. The ideal candidate can develop, test, and debug an endpoint detection and response agent with mission critical security responsibilities.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Design and develop cybersecurity tools for realtime embedded, embedded Linux, and Android systems.
* Implement an endpoint detection and response agent for use on Anduril products.
* Develop thorough testing and qualification procedures for security critical components.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify specific security needs and implement solutions.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to security best practices.
* Stay updated on the latest security threats and technologies.

* 2\+ years of software development experience in some combination of Golang, Rust, or C/C\+\+.
* Experience with Linux observability and eBPF.
* Strong understanding of Linux security internals.
* Experience debugging and optimizing performance of Linux software.
* Experience with CI/CD and test automation, including for mobile and embedded devices.
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Ability to obtain and hold a U.S. Secret security clearance.

* Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards.
* Experience in mobile development, specifically on Android platforms.
* Experience implementing EDR tooling.

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is seeking a highly skilled Non\-Propulsion Electronics Systems (NPES) Engineer to support U.S. Navy submarine operations and advanced undersea warfare systems. This position is ideal for a former Navy Fire Control Technician, Fire Controlman, or similarly experienced submarine systems professional who understands the technical, operational, and mission requirements of modern submarine combat systems.
The NPES engineer will apply hands\-on Navy experience and technical expertise to support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, and evaluation of submarine fire control and combat systems. The successful candidate will work closely with Navy personnel, engineers, program managers, and other technical professionals to ensure systems remain operational, reliable, and mission ready.  

**Must be able to obtain a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**  

Key Responsibilities
* Provide technical and operational expertise on Navy submarine fire control, combat control, and associated weapons systems.
* Support the operation, maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and evaluation of fire control and combat system equipment.
* Analyze system performance and assist in identifying, isolating, and resolving hardware, software, and integration issues.
* Provide subject\-matter expertise on submarine tactical systems, fire control processes, weapons employment, and associated operational procedures.
* Support system integration, verification, validation, and Test and Evaluation (T\&E) activities.
* Review technical documentation, system requirements, engineering specifications, test procedures, and configuration documentation.
* Assist with the development and execution of test plans, test procedures, demonstrations, and technical evaluations.
* Support configuration management and ensure system documentation accurately reflects approved system baselines and changes.
* Coordinate with Navy operators, engineers, government stakeholders, and industry partners to resolve technical and operational issues.
* Translate operational requirements and fleet feedback into clear technical requirements and recommendations.
* Support technical reviews, working groups, program meetings, and customer engagements.
* Prepare technical reports, briefings, presentations, and other program documentation.
* Provide recommendations to improve system performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational effectiveness.
* Maintain a strong understanding of Navy policies, procedures, safety requirements, and applicable security protocols.

  

Required Qualifications
* **Ability to obtain a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**
* Prior U.S. Navy experience as a Fire Control Technician (FT), Fire Controlman (FC), or equivalent experience supporting submarine combat or fire control systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
* Required: 5\+ years’ work experience within DoW, or Armed Services.
* Demonstrated experience with Navy fire control, combat control, weapons control, or related tactical systems.
* Strong understanding of submarine operations and the role of fire control systems in undersea warfare.
* Experience troubleshooting complex electronic, computer, weapons, or combat system equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, system documentation, schematics, and engineering documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with military, civilian, engineering, and contractor personnel.
* Ability to work independently while effectively contributing to a multidisciplinary team.
* Ability to travel 25% of the time.

  

Preferred Qualifications
* Former Navy submarine Fire Control Technician or Fire Controlman with significant fleet experience.
* Experience aboard Los Angeles\-, Seawolf\-, or Virginia\-Class submarines.
* Experience with submarine combat control, weapons control, sonar, navigation, or tactical systems.
* Experience supporting Navy acquisition programs, Program Executive Offices (PEOs), NAVSEA, Team Submarine, or other DoD organizations.
* Experience supporting system integration, verification and validation, T\&E, or fleet introduction activities.
* Experience developing or reviewing technical requirements, test procedures, engineering documentation, or system specifications.
* Familiarity with Navy configuration management processes and technical baseline documentation.
* Experience supporting submarine modernization, technology insertion, or combat system upgrades.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience working with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  

Core Competencies
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
* Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of Navy fire control and submarine combat systems.
* Operational Knowledge: Ability to apply fleet experience to acquisition, engineering, testing, and sustainment activities.
* Problem Solving: Ability to troubleshoot complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical and operational concepts to diverse audiences.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with Sailors, government personnel, engineers, and industry partners.
* Attention to Detail: Commitment to accuracy in technical analysis, documentation, testing, and reporting.
* Mission Focus: Understanding of the importance of submarine combat systems to Navy readiness and national security.

**Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R\-EGI Program**

  


**Position Overview**


IS4S is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test software for the R\-EGI program. R\-EGI brings together GPS/GNSS, inertial sensors, and other navigation capabilities to support resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) for military aircraft.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable developing C/C\+\+ software on embedded Linux systems, bringing up software on hardware, and solving problems at the boundary between software, sensors, and avionics. The engineer will work closely with systems, navigation, hardware, and test teams through integration and qualification.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ software for navigation processing, device interfaces, middleware, and system control.
* Develop and debug software on embedded Linux platforms, including interactions with device drivers, operating system services, and hardware interfaces.
* Integrate GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, and other navigation inputs; work with navigation engineers to implement and evaluate sensor\-fusion and estimation functions.
* Diagnose system\-level issues involving software timing, sensor data, electrical interfaces, and hardware behavior.
* Support hardware bring\-up and software integration in laboratory and system integration lab environments.
* Develop automated tests, diagnostic tools, and scripts that improve software integration, regression testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including evaluation of performance when GPS is degraded or unavailable.
* Translate system and interface requirements into software designs, test procedures, and verification evidence.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect resolution, and software releases.
* Support technical reviews and program milestones, including PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification activities.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help the team resolve complex embedded software issues.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 8 or more years of embedded software engineering experience.
* Strong C and C\+\+ proficiency for embedded or real\-time applications.
* Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on embedded Linux systems.
* Experience working with hardware interfaces, device drivers, or low\-level software and diagnosing hardware/software integration issues.
* Experience using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or debuggers to troubleshoot embedded systems.
* Experience with software requirements, interface definitions, verification, and configuration management.
* Experience with Git, cross\-compilation toolchains, and automated builds.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with military aviation PNT systems, GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, inertial navigation systems, or integrated GPS/INS solutions.
* Experience with navigation estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, or operation in GPS\-degraded and GPS\-denied environments.
* Experience with aircraft avionics interfaces such as MIL\-STD\-1553 or ARINC 429\.
* Experience developing and integrating systems that use modern embedded processing platforms, such as the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+ MPSoC.
* Experience with real\-time Linux, VxWorks, INTEGRITY, or another real\-time operating system.
* Experience with software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system integration labs.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis, or diagnostic tools.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, interface diagrams, and hardware documentation.
* Experience supporting formal software qualification or airworthiness activities.
* Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.

Dynamic and collaborative work environment


Employee ownership

Paid time\-off and parental leave programs


Group term life insurance


401(k) retirement plan

The Software Engineer, Entry\-Level role supports the development and maintenance of real\-time lab control applications. Assist in executing programming assignments using established programming procedures and data processing requirements.

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join BAE Systems' Infrastructure Management Center (IMC) and help shape National Security. We are seeking a motivated Systems Engineer to join our dynamic, cross\-functional team. In this role, you will support the planning, design, and integration of complex technical challenges that support critical national security missions, including nuclear missions, production facilities, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and ammunition plant infrastructure.
  

This is an ideal role for an early\-career engineer looking to grow within a matrix\-type organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate across multiple departments, leveraging digital engineering tools and Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices to deliver cutting\-edge solutions for the warfighter.
  

  

The Role
  

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the systems integration and analysis of hardware and software systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:
* Systems Integration: Assist in the integration and analysis of military hardware and software systems/processes (or commercial equivalents).
* Technical Analysis: Support the design and analytical efforts required to optimize the management of critical infrastructure programs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work within a multi\-disciplinary team of engineers and program managers to understand customer requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Digital Tool Utilization: Utilize project management software and digital engineering tools, (CAMEO, DOORS, Etc…).
* Documentation: Assist in the creation of technical documentation, system specifications, and reports to ensure program milestones are met.
* Process Improvement: Support the implementation of Agile methodologies and continuous process improvement initiatives within the IMC.
* Requirements Management: Manage the full requirements lifecycle, including the derivation, analysis, and development of comprehensive technical requirements documents to ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and system design.
  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM field (e.g., Mathematics, Physics).
* 2 yrs technical experience 0yrs with MS) with an emphasis in Systems engineering
* Technical Aptitude: Fundamental understanding of systems design, integration, and analytical efforts.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with team members, stakeholders, and customers in a professional environment.
* Secret Security Clearance
  

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Familiarity with Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or other digital engineering tools
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and their application in a technical environment.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret.
* Any foundational certifications in Systems Engineering or Project Management.
  

  

  

**Pay Information**
  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $107359 \- $182510
  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  

  

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  

  

  

  

**About BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security**  

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  

  

Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  

  

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

new_jobs.title: TAK Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner
new_jobs.description:
COLSA Corporation is seeking a **Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner** to support the U.S. Army's Threat Systems Management Office (TSMO). This position will design, develop, integrate, test, and troubleshoot software solutions involving the Team Awareness Kit (TAK), including the integration of clients, servers, data pipelines, and other systems to deliver capabilities that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.



Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential functions)



* Design and orchestrate systems of systems, including clients, servers, data pipelines, and other integrated components.
* Design, develop, test, and implement software programs using Java, C\+\+, Python, React, Go, or similar technologies.
* Support software development and delivery using Jira and Kanban\-based continuous flow processes.
* Set up and maintain development environments for Windows and Linux, including containerized environments.
* Perform merge request and pull request reviews to support software quality assurance.
* Develop and implement user\-friendly interface requirements for software clients.
* Collaborate with team members and end users to analyze requirements, troubleshoot software issues, and deliver solutions that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.
* Perform systems modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Perform data analysis and provide input for reports and dashboards, as needed.
* Develop or oversee user training, troubleshooting materials, and step\-by\-step guides.
* Advise hardware design engineers on system characteristics that may affect software systems, as needed.
* Provide input for documentation of new and existing software programs, as needed.


*At COLSA, people are our most valuable resource and centered at our core value. We invite you to unite your talents with opportunity and be a part of our “Family of Professionals!” Learn about our employee\-centric culture and benefits here:* *https://www.colsa.com/culture\_benefits*

  

  

Required Experience  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Minimum of 8\-12 years of related experience.
* Hands\-on experience supporting systems integration efforts.
* Experience configuring and maintaining development environments, including Git\-based version control, Linux operating systems, and Docker containerization.
* Experience with version control software and the Driessen branching model (Gitflow).
* Practical experience with front\-end application development, including the implementation of responsive, user\-focused interfaces.
* Experience designing, developing, and integrating custom interfaces, extensions, or plugins within existing software frameworks.
* Active Secret security clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.


**Preferred Qualifications**



* Previous experience leading software development teams.
* Experience with web development technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP) experience using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Computer vision experience with object detection or gait recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and YOLO models.


Applicant selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. COLSA Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

* Experience in the development and design of electronic circuit designs, and/or multi\-assembly system/unit design

* Experience in taking design concepts from block diagram or requirements level to development of complete hardware designs, with verification via test and integration
* Experience with PCB design process and expertise with design tools (schematic capture) to analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution

i3 is seeking Software Engineers to join tour team in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design, develop, integrate, test, and sustain mission‑critical command and control (C2\) software used by our warfighters and customers around the world.  

In this role, you will support Agile Software Teams, working closely with systems and test engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands‑on development, solving complex technical problems, and collaborating in a highly integrated, Agile environment.
Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications and software systems that implement logical and mathematical solutions that are aligned with program objectives.
* Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Scrum teams to develop and maintain software products across multiple software baselines for the IBCS program.
* Work in a fast\-paced environment with high expectations, diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels of the organization.
* Perform software development and upgrades in multiple programming languages/versions while minimizing changes to the operational behavior of tactical software.
* Support documentation creation and updates using Markdown and other collaboration tools.
* Support testing activities including unit and functional testing, code coverage analysis, and static code analysis; contribute to continuous improvement of test effectiveness and automation.
* Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Education, Experience and Required skills:* This role can be filled at mulitple levels
	+ Associate Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 1 year of relevant experience
	+ Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant experience, Master's degree in STEM field and 0 years of relevant experience
* Strong object\-oriented software development experience with Java and C\+\+
* Proficiency in Linux\-based development and runtime environments.
* Experience with scripting languages and tools including Bash and Python.
* Experience with modern configuration management and source control tools (Git / GitLab).
* Experience with Agile SAFe and Atlassian Agile tools including Jira and Confluence.
* Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain a clearance required.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.


Preferred Qualifications:* Experience with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including Cameo or similar tools.
* Experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to build, integrate, test and deliver software.
* Experience supporting real\-time or distributed systems using RTI/DDS publish/subscribe middleware.
* Engagement: Experience with US Army Systems including PATRIOT, LTAMDS, SENTINEL A3/A4, IFF devices, and M\_SHORAD.
* Experience with Engagement Planning and Execution, PAC2/PAC3, and AIM9x, and Indirect Fires.
* Track Management: Experience with track management including sensors, composite track, IFF devices, and Combat Identification.
* CompTIA Security\+


Physical Demands:* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer I
new_jobs.description:
Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/**

Department: Engineering

Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer

Employment type: Full\-time

Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)

Position Summary

Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building.

As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast.

Key Duties \& Responsibilities

Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works.

What You’ll Work With

* Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant.

Required Qualifications

* 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

*This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.*

Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

**Senior Thermal Systems Engineer**



Advantest Test Solutions, Inc. (ATS) is seeking a Senior Thermal Systems Engineer to serve as a thermal technical lead on our team in Lake Forest, CA. ATS is a leading provider of massively parallel electronic test systems, including System Level Test (SLT), burn\-in, and semiconductor/module testing. We offer an exciting portfolio of high\-performance test systems that support the semiconductor industry worldwide.



This individual will act as the thermal lead on assigned programs, taking ownership of technical decisions and drafting thermal requirements with minimal supervision. The role covers the full range of thermal and mechanical engineering functions related to the design, testing, and evaluation of thermal systems for electronic systems, including semiconductors, photonics, and embedded devices, from early concept through mass production. Responsibilities include directing thermal system design and validation, mentoring junior engineers, and serving as the primary technical point of contact for thermal scope on their programs.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the thermal lead on assigned programs, making independent technical decisions and drafting thermal system requirements.
* Own thermal system design and validation for liquid\-cooled and refrigerant\-based systems, from architecture through release.
* Lead thermal system design and validation across the full product lifecycle, including prototyping, design validation, and transition to mass production.
* Design and develop thermal components such as cold plates (liquid\-cooling and two\-phase), ceramic heaters, heat sinks, chillers, and condensing units.
* Design and support high power, high temperature active thermal control systems.
* Perform hands\-on thermal system testing and design validation to confirm designs meet specifications and performance requirements.
* Conduct thermal analyses to evaluate component and system\-level performance.
* Collaborate with and provide technical direction to design and development teams to integrate thermal solutions into product designs.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers on the team.
* Optimize thermal designs to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance.
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation of designs, analyses, and testing results.
* Stay current with advancements in thermal management technologies and methodologies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to thermal design and performance.
* Work with procurement, manufacturing, quality assurance, and technical support teams to establish specifications, and assist in vendor/supplier selection for parts, materials, and assemblies.
* Provide hands\-on support during product installation and commissioning at customer sites, and guidance to the field service team.
* Identify risk areas and opportunities for optimization, and drive resolution of field issues in collaboration with the field team.
* Act as a technical point of contact for customers on thermal\-related issues for their programs.
* Conduct hands\-on evaluation of prototype and sub\-assembly builds, including thorough performance assessments.
* Perform additional duties as required.

Requirements:
**Requirements, Education \& Skills**


* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or Physics required; Master's degree preferred.
* 8\+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a demonstrated track record of leading thermal scope on programs independently, including drafting technical requirements and making design decisions with minimal oversight.
* Active thermal control experience in the semiconductor industry required.
* Expertise in thermal system design and validation for liquid\-cooled and refrigerant\-based systems.
* Proven experience across the end\-to\-end product lifecycle: prototyping, design validation, and mass production.
* Hands\-on capability performing thermal system testing and design validation.
* Deep knowledge of cold plates (liquid\-cooling, two\-phase), ceramic heaters, heat sinks, chillers, and condensing units.
* Experience with high power, high temperature active thermal control systems.
* Experience with PID control and tuning for closed\-loop thermal systems.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to lead technical decisions on ambiguous problems.
* Background in electronic packaging, testing, and integration of thermal systems into automated handling preferred.
* Experience working on cross\-functional teams building complex test systems involving motion control hardware, electrical, and software components is a plus.

* 3D design experience with SolidWorks preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 20% to customer sites.

* Prior experience formally leading or technically directing a program team.

A successful Software Engineer at NOW will thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-energy, team\-focused engineering environment. The ideal candidate will have strong technical, analytical, and communication skills and can balance independent execution with effective collaboration across engineering, customer support, and other functional teams.This position requires the ability to quickly understand existing systems and architectures, evaluate technical requirements, and develop creative yet practical solutions. The Software Engineer will participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including system planning, architecture, development, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing customer support.Software developed in this role will be integrated into and supported across NOW products. Particular emphasis will be placed on reliability, maintainability, forward and backward compatibility, and comprehensive cross\-product testing and validation.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software used across NOW products and systems.
* Develop and maintain embedded and distributed software applications.
* Analyze system and software requirements and translate them into practical, maintainable technical solutions.
* Perform formal technical and software risk analysis and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Design software with strong forward and backward compatibility to support multiple generations of NOW products.
* Develop robust cross\-product testing, integration testing, and validation procedures.
* Design and maintain flexible and reusable APIs for embedded, IoT, and distributed systems.
* Develop and maintain applications that interface with SQL Server databases.
* Participate in software architecture, design reviews, code reviews, testing, and system integration.
* Diagnose and resolve complex software, hardware\-interface, network, and system integration issues.
* Work closely with Customer Support Engineers to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues at customer sites.
* Provide engineering support for deployed products, including root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Develop clear technical documentation for software architecture, APIs, interfaces, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with software, hardware, systems, and support engineers throughout the product lifecycle.
* Maintain and improve existing products while contributing to future generation systems.

**Qualifications and Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of hands\-on development experience using C/C\+\+.
* Experience developing software using Python.
* Strong experience developing embedded and distributed applications.
* Experience designing software for systems involving multiple interconnected devices and services.
* Experience developing flexible, reusable system APIs for IoT, embedded, or large\-scale distributed systems.
* Experience developing applications that interface with Microsoft SQL Server or similar relational database systems.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, debugging, testing, and system integration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex problems involving software, hardware, communications, and networks.
* Ability to rapidly learn and support existing software and legacy systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross\-functional engineering team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with data serialization libraries, protocols, and techniques.
* Experience developing GPS, GNSS, positioning, or vehicle\-tracking applications.
* Experience with industrial IoT or telematics systems.
* Experience with embedded communications and device\-to\-server architectures.
* Experience supporting software deployed in industrial or mission\-critical customer environments.
* Experience troubleshooting systems remotely and directly with customer technical personnel.

**Job Type**

Full\-time

**Benefits**

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Food provided
* Snacks provided

new_jobs.description:
At NetApp, our High Achievement Principles shape how we work: we innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel as a team. We have a history of helping customers turn challenges into business opportunities. That’s because we bring new thinking to age\-old problems, like how to use data most effectively in the most efficient possible way. As an Engineer with NetApp, you’ll have the opportunity to work with modern cloud and container orchestration technologies in a production setting. You’ll play an important role in scaling systems sustainably through automation and evolving them by pushing for changes to improve reliability and velocity.

  

**Success profile**
-------------------


Ready to be an engineer at NetApp? Explore the traits that can help you thrive.


* Analytical
* Adaptable
* Communicator
* Detail\-oriented
* Quick\-thinking
* Problem solver

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


San Jose, California, United States; Morrisville, North Carolina, United States **Job category:** Software Engineering **Job ID:** 136380\-en\_US
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**


At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.


Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Job Summary**
---------------


As a Software Engineer, your responsibilities will include developing and maintaining cloud\-based solutions. You will focus on solving complex problems, developing, testing, automating and collaborating with the Software Engineering team to deploy features in a production environment.


Additionally, you will be responsible for designing and implementing managed Cloud Services based on given requirements. We expect you to have excellent coding skills and take a lead role in designing ,implementing managed Cloud Services and supporting production deployments.


**Short Description**
---------------------


* Engage in incident management processes including the 24X7 Oncall rotations (as per the sun model) to resolve production issues within agreed SLAs/SLOs.
* Lead to deliver features, including participating in the full software development lifecycle.
* Participate in product design, development, verification, troubleshooting, and delivery of a system or major subsystems, including authoring project specifications.
* Continuously monitor, analyze, and measure system health, availability, and latency
* Develop and implement steps to improve system and application performance, availability, and reliability.
* Work on development, bug fixes/updates, spec updates, customer RCAs and automation.
* Hands on troubleshooting of production outages.
* Focus on continuous improvement of production operations and avoiding fires proactively.
**Job Requirements**
--------------------


* 5\+ years of experience is required.
* **24X7 Oncall rotations (as per the sun model) every 2 weeks**
* **This role will have non\-traditional work days and hours including weekends.**
* Proficient with any of the languages C\+\+ or Golang.
* Experience with Python, Java/C\-sharp is added advantage.
* Scripting and infrastructure automation using, for example, Ansible, Python, Go, Perl, or Ruby.
* Thorough understanding of Linux or other Unix\-like Operating Systems.
* Strong in Data Structure and algorithms and Expertise in REST API design and implementation.
* Prior experience with Filesystem development and Distributed system design is desirable.
* Deep working Knowledge of Containers, Kubernetes, and Serverless computing implementation.
* Understanding of SDLC lifecycle, distributed systems and DevOps development methodologies
* Demonstrated ability to have completed multiple, moderately complex technical tasks.
* Strong familiarity with Google Cloud is preferred, or other Hyperscalers, AWS, Azure.
**Education**
-------------


* Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience is required.
Compensation:
  

The target salary range for this position is 147,900 \- 220,000 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance\-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

new_jobs.title: Senior Network and Platform Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Application close date:


Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space\-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi\-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise\-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.
**About This Role**

Blue Origin is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Software Engineering team supporting TeraWave in the Greater Seattle Area. In this role, you build the foundational platform infrastructure, the operating nervous system, deployed across TeraWave satellites, user terminals, and gateways. This position focuses on embedded Linux and low\-level platform infrastructure, spanning fleet management, operating\-system services, hardware integration, security, observability, and networking performance. You will shape reliable, high\-performance systems that operate aboard LEO satellites. Responsibilities


**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Design core Linux platform infrastructure, including process management, custom initialization systems, and inter\-process communication frameworks.
* Develop and maintain Linux kernel modules and device drivers to support custom hardware and platform requirements.
* Modify kernel subsystems to improve scheduling, memory management, and I/O performance for embedded satellite systems.
* Work with silicon, electrical, and RF teams to bring up hardware prototypes and optimize kernels for custom SoCs.
* Debug system\-level performance issues, minimize context switching, and tune the networking stack for satellite links.
* Implement secure boot, runtime security monitoring, and hardware\-backed credential management across embedded platforms.
* Own the complete software lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment aboard LEO satellites.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related STEM discipline, or 10\+ years software development experience.
* At least 8 years of C or C\+\+ experience in Linux or embedded environments.
* Deep Linux kernel knowledge, including driver development, memory management, and system\-level debugging.
* Experience with system\-level debugging tools such as GDB, perf, and eBPF.
* Experience with Buildroot, Yocto, Bazel, or comparable build systems.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Infrastructure experience supporting large distributed systems or device fleets at scale.
* Proficiency with Rust or Python for systems tooling and automation.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, Ethernet, Linux networking, and custom routing protocols.
* Experience with mission\-critical aerospace, automotive, medical, or similarly high\-reliability systems.
Ability to troubleshoot down to assembly code and hardware\-level diagnostics.  
* 

  

Base Pay Range for:


CA applicants is $248,830\.00 \- $348,361\.65\&\#xa;WA applicants is $248,830\.00 \- $348,361\.65
**Other site ranges may differ**

  

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  



  

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  



  

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre\-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical  
* 

  

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4\) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer II
new_jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.


We are seeking an experienced, high caliber Software Engineer II. Performs moderate risk/moderate complexity specialized level software project activities in such areas as Development, Tools, Test, Requirements and/or related areas. Assignments may include, but are not limited to, analyzing requirements, planning and scheduling data, updating and maintaining different software specifications based on analysis of specifications, needs and improvements, as well as troubleshooting, debugging, and maintaining of software, test, or tool designs, cases, scripts, procedures, and/or code based on strategic analysis. May lead a project. Work requires the application of theoretical engineering principles, evaluation, ingenuity and creative/analytical techniques typically acquired in a recognized four\-year or more academic course of specialized study. Applies engineering and scientific principles to the evaluation and solution of technical problems in a creative manner unique to each study. Exercises level appropriate technical judgment in planning, organizing, performing, and/or coordinating engineering work.


Each employee can make a difference at Abbott and has the power, either individually or as a team, to influence the success of the company. We are team\-oriented, fast\-paced and progressive. We value people with great ideas who partner with others both internally and externally to take action and accomplish goals.

**Impact this role will have on Abbott:**

* Working from requirement specifications, develops, maintains, and updates detailed design and interface specifications
* Participates in and supports the implementation, development, enhancements, and modifications to software source code, scripts, and procedures
* Debugs, troubleshoots, and isolates software problems as well as offers strategic solutions, analysis, and advice regarding identified issues for future development
* Identifies parameters, structure, and critical test components
* Writes, updates, or executes test design, test cases, as well as test procedures (automated, semi\-automated or manual) and analyzes and reports test results
* Writes, updates, and maintains requirement and interface specifications
* Contributes to and supports gathering, analyzing, and validating requirements
* Contributes to and supports writing, updating, developing and maintaining Hazard/Risk/Cyber Security analysis specifications
* Contributes to and supports root\-cause analysis of failures
* Working from requirement specifications, develops, maintains, and updates test requirements and design/test protocols
* Supports implementation, enhancements, and modifications to test cases, procedures, scripts, and code
* Presents at design reviews; documents and resolves issues as directed
* May lead project as a testing leader

**Your experience(s), education and knowledge will further expand Abbott’s marketplace success:**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant engineering discipline, computer science, related engineering field
* Minimum 2 years of experience in testing embedded software
* Experience with C, C\+\+, C\# and/or Python is required
* Experience with formal software development methodologies, and source code management is recommended
* Experience with unit\- and integration\-level testing and automated testing is recommended
* Experience with testing Embedded Software(firmware) within implantable medical devices is desired
* Experience with testing Bluetooth Low Energy within implantable medical devices is desired
* Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment
* Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization
* Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills, as well as attention to detail

  

The base pay for this position is $81,500\.00 – $141,300\.00\. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Firmware Platforms, Vehicle Software
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
As a member of the Firmware Platforms team, you will deliver high\-quality embedded code on the processors at the heart of Tesla’s heart of current and future Tesla products—next\-generation vehicles, Cybercab robotaxis, Optimus robots, and energy devices. You will take on the hardest embedded problems: bringing up new microcontrollers, low\-level debugging and diagnostics, applied cryptography, real\-time operating systems, and more. At Tesla, you will help build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables Over\-The\-Air updates across these platforms, and you will have a direct hand in shipping the firmware that makes unsupervised autonomy real.  

**What You'll Do*** Deliver high\-quality C code in a real\-time embedded environment
* Specify, design, and implement new functionality for embedded subsystems
* Design the software architecture and firmware implementation through integration, test, and high\-volume manufacturing
* Hands\-on hardware bring\-up, system debugging, and code optimization
* Make performance and optimization trade\-offs to meet product requirements
  

**What You'll Bring*** Experience in embedded development in robotics, real\-time controls, or system software
* Proficiency in C
* Fluent in software fundamentals including software design for maintainability
* Experience with embedded microprocessor toolchains and debuggers
* Controls software and algorithm development
* Test\-driven development and familiarity with developer\-driven automated testing
* Ability to collaborate and communicate complex technical concepts
* Understanding of physics and basic electronics principles, preferred
* Experience with at least one assembly language, preferred
* Familiarity with static analysis, fuzzing, or other advanced testing/verification tools, preferred
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$140,000 \- $300,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

new_jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Embedded Systems/Firmware, Servers
new_jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
* 5 years of experience working with embedded operating systems.
* 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience with C and C\+\+.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects.
* Experience with Kernel and Kernel Drivers.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of low\-level software to lead product development within our Server portfolio. This team is responsible for the platform software (Firmware, Basic Input/Output System (BIOS), Drivers) for all Google servers, including compute servers and ML headnodes. You will also contribute to initiatives like Far Memory and other innovative, currently need\-to\-know products shaping our future solutions.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the end\-to\-end software architecture, design, and development of high\-performance server platforms, establishing technical direction and defining the goal for high\-impact projects.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, software, and system engineering teams to drive pre\-silicon Firmware (FW)/Software (SW) co\-development, optimize integration, and align cross\-organizational roadmaps with overall business goals.
* Own the delivery of comprehensive software solutions—spanning FW, BIOS, Kernel, and drivers—ensuing rigorous testing, deployment, and long\-term maintenance of large\-scale systems.
* Influence, mentor, and coach a distributed team of engineers, fostering a collaborative culture of continuous innovation, technical excellence, and professional growth.
* Manage project priorities, deliverables, and timelines while facilitating absolute clarity across multiple teams to ensure seamless execution on high\-impact objectives.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer Sr - E3
new_jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------


**WHO WE ARE**

* Engineer resilience at scale: Push cutting\-edge firmware, driver innovations, and real\-time reliability platforms across millions of machines.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity.
