We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $262000 \- $364000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive technical strategy for hardware security across Google's fleet, leading transitions to open\-source Roots of Trust (Caliptra, OpenTitan) and Post\-Quantum Cryptography readiness.

new_jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer, Robotics
new_jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join our Robotics Team, with a strong focus on humanoid robots and embodied intelligence. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing through the invention of the GPU, the engine of modern accelerated computing. Today, this foundation powers breakthroughs across gaming, film, scientific research, autonomous machines, and robotics. Our team is building a robotics platform for the next generation of intelligent robots, including humanoid systems. NVIDIA’s Isaac Robotics Platform brings together high\-fidelity physical and visual simulation, scalable system software, optimized robotics and AI algorithms, and powerful edge computing platforms to serve as the brain of intelligent machines. You will work with experts across robotics, systems, AI, and simulation to enable real\-world deployment of embodied AI on humanoid robots, and help shape how foundation models and learning\-based policies are integrated into production robotic systems.

**What you’ll be doing:**
-------------------------

* Develop system software, runtime components, tools, and workflows that enable reliable, performant deployment of embodied AI models on real robots.
* Optimize model execution and system performance across compute, memory, networking, sensors, and actuators.
* Build validation, testing, benchmarking, and observability infrastructure spanning simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments, and physical robots.
* Measure and improve critical system\-level metrics, including end\-to\-end latency, determinism, throughput, reliability, resource utilization, and startup performance.
* Debug complex issues across application software, middleware, operating systems, device drivers, firmware, and hardware.
* Work with AI, simulation, hardware, platform, and partner teams to bring up, validate, and harden robotic systems for real\-world deployment.
* Own technical issues through investigation, root\-cause analysis, resolution, and field validation.
* Contribute to architectural decisions, review code, and uphold high standards for system software quality, maintainability, and operational readiness.

**What we need to see:**
------------------------

* BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience developing robotics, embedded, platform, distributed, or system software.
* Strong understanding of robotics system architecture, platform software, and hardware\-software integration.
* Hands\-on experience bringing up, debugging, and deploying complex robotic systems on both physical hardware and simulation.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, embedded software, distributed computing, and real\-time systems.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership and deliver complex projects across multiple functions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teams across global organizations.

**Ways to stand out from your crowd:**
--------------------------------------

* Experience building and shipping humanoid robotic systems or reference platforms.
* Background with deploying foundation models, embodied AI models, or reinforcement learning policies on physical robots.
* Experience evaluating learning\-based robotic policies in simulation, including task success, robustness to disturbances, and generalization across tasks and environments.
* Experience building hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing and automated benchmarking pipelines to measure closed\-loop policy performance, validate real\-time execution, and detect regressions across simulation and physical hardware.
* Strong background in perception, sensor integration, performance optimization, and system validation.

  

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you are creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD \- 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD \- 287,500 USD for Level 4\.

**Be visionary**


Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.


We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

  



**Job Description**

  



**Job Summary:**

  

This position will lead the software engineering group and provide guidance and assistance in all phases of the design process from concept to manufacturing. Work environments are general office and Engineering Lab.  

  

**Detailed Description:**

* Supervise specific division of the Software Engineering group. This responsibility includes resource allocation, hiring, performing reviews, feedback on project planning, and establishing realistic goals with the engineers.
* Supervise and validate the technical solutions and schedules proposed by the design engineers in the group.
* Periodically report the performance of the group, its bandwidth availability and ensure that the group performs at its maximum capacity.
* Establish a quality process enabling engineers to produce designs efficiently by reusing established practices while allowing flexibility to innovate and achieve.
* Play a hands\-on role in day\-to\-day software implementation cycles; writing specifications, making designs trade\-off decisions, participating in design reviews, coding and troubleshooting, as required to fill the gaps in the group bandwidth.
* Ensure the software development process is followed by creating a paper trail of meeting minutes, specifications and validation documents.
* Assist in the decision making process during the design cycle and provide an objective view when reviewing implementation proposals.
* Contribute to proposals, project plans and schedules for each project in design by the software development group.
* Maintain and improve the software development environment to include revision control systems, bug/issue tracking, build server and test systems.

 **Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in managing engineering groups and a minimum 15 years’ experience desired in some of the following areas:
* Developing strategies for software
* Deploying and administering software development tools.
* Architecture, designing, implementing, and testing embedded systems software
* Designing, implementing, and testing software writing in assembly, C/C\+\+
* Imaging systems and electro\-optical components (highly desirable).
* Word\-Excel\-Power Point skills required.
* Strong Computer Skills: Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Design and implementation of embedded software from given or derived specifications (implemented in C, C\+\+ and assembly)

 **Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Design, implementation and integration of software products using Linux/OpenSource and/or Microsoft Visual Studio
* Validation of software
* Imaging Systems and Electro\-Optical Components
* Must be US Citizen or Perm Resident

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. **About the Company:**

At **SK Hynix Memory Solutions**, we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in DRAM and NAND flash technologies, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting\-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.



We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK Hynix Memory, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco\-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

  


**About the Role:**


* Create comprehensive firmware verification plans covering NVMe standards, enterprise SSD protocols, and customer specifications (e.g., SMART, Trim, Get Log Page, OCP).
* Design and deploy white\-box, grey\-box, and black\-box automation tests using Python to validate security protocols and firmware functionality on a module\-by\-module basis.
* Execute and own end\-to\-end testing across diverse platforms, including simulation, FPGA prototyping, and prototype SSD hardware.
* Utilize deep SSD domain expertise to analyze weekly regression failures, root\-cause complex firmware bugs, and drive issue resolution.
* Partner closely with firmware development teams during code reviews to improve software architecture, expand test coverage, and elevate overall code quality.
* Own test reporting and articulately communicate technical challenges, solutions, and mitigation plans to both engineering teams and management.

  


**Education / Experience:**


* Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, Digital Sciences, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and five (5\) years of progressive, post\-baccalaureate experience in job offered or in an engineering\-related occupation.
  


**Position requires experience in:**


* SSD firmware testing and/or development.
* SSD or NAND Flash development industry.
* Code development using Python, C/C\+\+, and Javascript.
* Storage industry protocols including NVMe, ONFI, and TCG Opal.
* Agile development, GIT development flow, Branch management and tools.
* Test automation, testing methodologies and test tools.
* Automated build, continuous integration, and test automation systems.
  


**COMPENSATION: $110,000\-$160,000**

  


**REGARDING COMPENSATION:**



SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. offers you the opportunity to apply your skills to exciting projects while working with innovative teams. Our compensation package is complimented by a generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance and a company 401(k) match, as well as cafeteria, onsite gym and much more. If you are motivated by technical challenges, we offer a collaborative work environment that encourages career growth.



The salary offered to a selected candidate will be tailored based on several factors, including the location, job grade, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience. We also take into account the internal equity among our current team members to ensure fairness and competitiveness

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


Strategic Defense protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air\-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid\-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software\-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale.
### **ABOUT THE JOB**



We're seeking a Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Irvine, CA or Huntsville, AL. As a Software Engineer on the Strategic Defense team, you will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way. Your efforts will ensure that Anduril products seamlessly work together to achieve a variety of critical outcomes. Above all, Software Engineers are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset—executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes correctly, on\-time, and with high quality. This role will focus on the Guam Defense System Battle Manager product. Experience with mid and upper tier Air Defense Command and Control programs is a plus. You will be helping to create a new strategic business line and will work closely with the other strategic Command and Control programs within Anduril.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the software solutions that are deployed to customers
* Write code to improve products and scale the mission capability to more customers
* Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality
* Create and analyze metrics that are leveraged for debugging and monitoring
* Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next steps
* Partner with end\-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints
* Travel up to 30% of time to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
* 3\+ years working with a variety of programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, Rust, Go, JavaScript, etc.
* Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processingand analysis
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* A desire to work on critical software that has a real\-world impact
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Strong background with focus in Physics, Mathematics, and/or Motion Planning to inform modeling \& simulation (M\&S) and physical systems
* Developing and testing multi\-agent autonomous systems and deploying in real\-world environments
* Feature and algorithm development with an understanding of behavior trees
* Developing software/hardware for flight systems and safety critical functionality
* Distributed communication networks and message standards
* Knowledge of military systems and operational tactics
* Experience working with mid and upper tier Air Defense systems in the Army, Navy, Air Force or the Missile Defense Agency


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform — Maritime Autonomy
new_jobs.description:
Help turn streams of maritime sensor data into dependable datasets for machine\-learning and perception systems. You will build the data platform that lets engineers process live signals, revisit historical recordings and understand exactly which data informed a model or evaluation. The work spans software infrastructure, dataset quality and close collaboration with teams building autonomous systems.


Location: Torrance, California  

Employment: Full\-time  

Base salary range in the matching recruiter posting: $200,000–$240,000, plus equity

### **Responsibilities**

* Build pipelines that ingest and process high\-volume sensor and telemetry data for ML and analytics.
* Align and calibrate data from different sensors; support both near\-real\-time processing and repeatable historical reprocessing.
* Make datasets traceable through versioning, metadata and lineage so experiments can be reproduced.
* Create data\-discovery interfaces and access patterns that help ML and perception teams find fit\-for\-purpose datasets.
* Measure data completeness and quality, investigate failures and improve reliability as data volume grows.
* Work with ML, hardware and product colleagues to translate changing model needs into durable data contracts.

### **Requirements**


Must\-haves

* Experience building and operating substantial data platforms, ML data infrastructure or large\-scale processing pipelines.
* Strong Python skills and practical use of data\-processing tools or libraries such as PyArrow, Polars, Pandas or NumPy.
* Experience working with sensor, time\-series, audio, vision or similarly complex data.
* Understanding of dataset quality, reproducibility and access patterns for downstream users.
* Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate across software and ML teams.


Nice\-to\-haves

* Experience with sonar, maritime systems, robotics, autonomy or other sensor\-rich environments.
* Experience with orchestration, metadata or experiment\-tracking tools.
* Experience with backfills, labeling workflows, data APIs/SDKs or storage optimization at scale.

  

Interested? Apply now and we will be in touch within 3 workdays.

new_jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

new_jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer, Battery Cell Manufacturing
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Automation Control Engineers are responsible for implementing equipment controls solutions for all cell manufacturing projects. This includes design, architecture and implementation of automated equipment in process and discrete mass manufacturing. Equipment will include mixing, winding, hydraulics, automated storage systems, robotics, automated case and pallet conveyance, automated guided vehicles, etc. Controls Engineers own equipment controls standard, hardware programming, robot programming, commissioning and review process of the project as well as additional functions such as auditing, installation and safety assessment.  

**What You'll Do*** Program and debug structure text and ladder logic code on multiple PLC controller platforms (Siemens, Beckhoff, B\&R, Omron)
* Develop code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable and reusable
* Create robust programs and sequences to control complex, multi\-station machinery to perform processes such as material pick and place, dispense, fastening, welding, testing and material transport
* Use Python scripting and SQL to interface equipment with Tesla Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and to collect data into production databases
* Create intuitive operator touchscreen interfaces using WinCC/MappView/TwinCAT HMI and SCADA dashboards screens using Ignition, Grafana
* Set up and tune servo drives and VFDs for fast and smooth operation (Schneider, B\&R, Beckhoff, Siemens, SEW)
* Design and implement control reliable safety systems for safeguarding robots, gantries, conveyors, and other high\-volume manufacturing equipment as per codes and standards
* Manage electrical cabinet builds, field wiring, pneumatic and fluid plumbing
* Participate in initial equipment conceptual development and carefully balance product specifications, process requirements, layout complexity, cost, and lead\-time limits
* Manage suppliers during specification, design, buyoff and installation of automated manufacturing equipment
  

**What You'll Bring*** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science or 5\+ years’ experience in Control Systems Design and Implementation, or equivalent experience
* PLC (Siemens, Beckhoff or B\&R preferred)
* Human Machine Interface (HMI / GUI – Beckhoff View, WinCC, Ignition)
* Proficiency creating detailed electrical and fluid schematics in CAD (EPLAN preferred)
* Structured Text (IEC 61131\-3\) programming skills
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$91,600 \- $164,400/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

new_jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Satellites
new_jobs.description:
Vast is developing next\-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware\-rich, and low\-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high\-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.



Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long\-term space economy.



Vast is looking for a **Senior Avionics Systems Engineer**, reporting to the **Senior Manager, Avionics and Power Systems**, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of high power satellites.



This will be a **full\-time, exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location.


**Responsibilities:**


* Function as responsible engineer for avionics systems across design, integration, test, launch, and operations
* Define detailed systems design, including system interfaces, consumable budgets, harness and channel capabilities, hardware capabilities, reliability and fault tolerance compliance, vehicle risk assessments, and configuration change management
* Collaborate with a cross\-functional engineering team to define requirements, lead systems trades, and scope designs as they move from concept to flight production
* Architect and inform autonomous behaviors, vehicle modes, and fault responses to comply with vehicle mission requirements
* Develop system\-level verification plans for integrated flight hardware to verify test coverage and vehicle flight readiness
* Evaluate vehicle health and perform real\-time troubleshooting to drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions
* Create and maintain system designs, processes, and validation techniques to improve reliability and streamline production
* Support process improvement by identifying recurring issues, implementing design feedback, and enabling higher system reliability
* Travel to launch sites or test facilities as needed to support operational activities
* Mentor and support fellow engineers, fostering strong technical development across the team


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline
* 5\+ years of professional or project experience with avionics design, analysis, system level integration, and/or unit level testing
* Experience with systems engineering principles and processes as they relate to spacecraft development
* Experience with lifecycle development as it relates to space systems, including requirement definition, identifying design solutions, integration, validation and verification, qualification, and operation


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


* Experience defining, managing, and verifying flight software interfaces
* Experience with system design and test of subsystems like power, GNC, RF, and propulsion interfaces
* Experience with high\-reliability/fault\-tolerant electronics for aerospace or defense applications
* Understanding of electrical schematics and electronics manufacturing to analyze and improve test coverage
* Competence with electrical test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, power supplies, etc.)
* Ability to effectively communicate technical topics to a wide variety of audiences
* Ability to creatively solve problems and weigh against multi\-disciplinary requirements while assessing risk and making design and development decisions with incomplete data
* Self\-motivated with strong learning, multi\-tasking, organizational, communication and documentation skills
* Strong sense of accountability and integrity with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work autonomously and thrive in a fast paced environment


**Additional Requirements:**


* Ability to travel up to 10% travel to support launch campaigns
* Comfortable balancing several projects at any given time with the flexibility to adjust for abrupt changes in strategic direction

  

*We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.*

  


**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**  

  

Base salary will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full\-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20\+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10\+ days of vacation for non\-exempt staff with the ability to cash\-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip c

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer – Digital/Analog Hardware Design
new_jobs.description:
Torrey Pines Logic – Sector Optics is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** with strong analog and digital hardware design experience to join a fast\-moving, multi\-project engineering environment. This role will be involved across the full hardware development lifecycle, from component selection and circuit design through PCB development, prototyping, validation, manufacturing, and product release.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer who can independently develop new designs, improve existing products, and work closely with mechanical, optical, software, manufacturing, and product teams to bring reliable hardware to production.

**Core Responsibilities \& Qualifications**

* Design and develop **analog and digital electronic circuits**, including systems incorporating microcontrollers, microprocessors, and SoCs.
* Identify, evaluate, and select critical hardware components based on **electrical performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and long\-term supply considerations**.
* Design and select components for **low\-power applications**, with an understanding of power consumption and system\-level power requirements.
* Apply strong working knowledge of standard digital communication protocols, including **UART, I²C, SPI, and Ethernet**.
* Apply **Design for Manufacturing (DFM)** and **Design for Cost (DFC)** principles to create reliable, manufacturable, and economically viable products.
* Develop and review **PCB designs and layouts**, and provide technical direction for PCB layout, fabrication, assembly, and manufacturing.
* Generate new hardware designs as well as **modify, troubleshoot, and improve existing circuit designs**.
* Perform hardware bring\-up, debugging, testing, and validation of prototype and production hardware.
* Use **PADS** for schematic capture and PCB design/layout.
* Work independently with minimal oversight while effectively collaborating with a small, multidisciplinary engineering team.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced development environment.

**Preferred / Additional Experience**

The following skills are valuable but are **not required**:

* Experience with mechanical CAD tools such as **SolidWorks**.
* FPGA or FPGA board\-level design experience.
* Basic understanding of **electro\-optical front\-end design**, including optical emitters and receivers.
* Experience designing **power management and power conversion circuitry**.
* Experience with **motor and motion\-control systems**.
* Experience working with **electro\-optical components and systems**.
* Experience with **signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI)** analysis and mitigation.
* Understanding of **EMI/EMC design and compliance**.
* Experience with **thermal design and management** of electronic systems.

Pay: $117,119\.15 \- $141,046\.72 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: JR SYSTEMS ENGINEER
new_jobs.description:
**Launch Your Engineering Career with Birdi Systems!**

  

Birdi Systems, Inc. (BSI) is seeking a motivated **Junior Systems Engineer** with a background in Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering to support, maintain, troubleshoot, and deploy integrated security, communications, and infrastructure systems across aviation, transportation, and government facilities.


This entry\-level engineering role bridges traditional engineering disciplines, IT infrastructure, and security operations. It is ideal for recent graduates or early\-career professionals seeking hands\-on experience working with mission\-critical systems that support airports, transportation networks, and government operations.


You will work alongside experienced engineers and project teams in both field and office environments, gaining practical experience in systems integration, networking, low\-voltage infrastructure, and client\-facing technical support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Troubleshoot and perform root\-cause analysis across multiple system layers, including power, cabling, networking, software platforms, and end\-user interfaces
* Maintain, repair, and optimize physical infrastructure, including low\-voltage systems, power distribution, communications equipment, and connected devices
* Assist with the installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning of integrated technology systems
* Configure and troubleshoot IP\-based networks, including switches, VLANs, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and connected devices
* Support security and communications platforms, including Video Management Systems (VMS), access control systems, alarm monitoring systems, and situational awareness technologies
* Monitor system performance, review logs and alerts, identify trends, and recommend preventive maintenance actions
* Respond to service requests, perform preventive maintenance, and maintain accurate service documentation and reports
* Participate in site visits, system assessments, testing, and deployment activities
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, network drawings, equipment layouts, and technical documentation
* Assist with the development of reports, procedures, system diagrams, and engineering documentation
* Collaborate with engineers, technicians, project managers, vendors, and customers to resolve technical issues and support project delivery
* Participate in design reviews and contribute recommendations for system improvements and risk mitigation
* Communicate technical information effectively to customers and stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements, security standards, industry codes, and project specifications
* Stay current on emerging technologies and participate in training and certification programs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline
* 0–2 years of relevant experience (internships, co\-ops, laboratory experience, and academic projects are welcome)
* Basic understanding of electrical and electronic systems
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, and network troubleshooting
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and network documentation
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites as required

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to security technologies such as CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, fire/life safety, or communications systems
* Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, or other engineering design software
* Experience with low\-voltage infrastructure, structured cabling, or IT systems
* Understanding of systems integration principles
* Interest in pursuing professional certifications such as EIT, CCNA, BICSI, Security\+, or related credentials

**What You'll Gain:**

* Hands\-on experience supporting large\-scale airport, transportation, and government infrastructure projects
* Exposure to multidisciplinary engineering, networking, security systems, and systems integration
* Direct mentorship from experienced engineers, project managers, and technical leaders
* Opportunities for technical training, professional certifications, and career advancement
* Experience working on mission\-critical systems that have a direct impact on public safety and transportation operations
* A clear path toward future Systems Engineer, Project Engineer, or Project Manager roles

**Why Birdi Systems?**


At Birdi Systems, you'll be part of a team delivering advanced security, communications, and situational awareness solutions that keep critical infrastructure operating safely and efficiently. Early\-career engineers are given meaningful responsibilities, hands\-on field experience, and direct access to experienced mentors, accelerating both technical and professional growth.


We invest in our people through training, certifications, and diverse project exposure, providing a strong foundation for long\-term career success. If you're looking for an opportunity to apply your engineering education, develop practical technical skills, and grow within a fast\-paced technology environment, Birdi Systems offers an exceptional place to start your career.

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Summit Engineering, Inc. is seeking a professionally licensed electrical engineer with proven project management and leadership skills to join our Electrical/Lighting Division. This experienced person will utilize their professional background to provide project management and design engineering on winery, custom residential, restaurants, apartment buildings and other commercial building type projects.

As an Electrical Project Manager at Summit, you will serve as the firm’s direct contact with the client and will be responsible for developing and maintaining positive relationships with clients. You will be responsible for design team leadership, internal project organization, preparing project proposals, design engineering, scheduling and budgeting, as well as business development and generating new work for the firm. The job requires getting things done quickly, handling a variety of activities, and effectively delegating to others. Being able to purposely drive toward results while problem\-solving and engaging the commitment of others is essential.

**Salary Range:** $130,000 to $180,000 annually

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

In addition to duties and responsibilities of Project Engineer:

* Responsible for preparation of project proposals.
* Establishes direction of work to be performed and holds staff accountable for executing on schedule and on budget.
* Prepares project specifications including conditions of contract and General Conditions.
* Performs and/or checks work performed by other staff.
* Provides input to the Principal in Charge and the Division Manager regarding staffing decisions for a project.
* Maintains close communication with the client, making the client aware of progress, problems, and scope changes. Develops a trusting relationship with the client.
* Gives clear directions to others. Communicates clearly with staff, clients, contractors, and outside consultants.
* Responsible for meeting project budget and schedule objectives and provides input to project team and Principal in Charge regarding status of project and budget. Takes action to seek approval for additional services prior to beginning work.
* Performs regular operational tasks that support the overall health of the firm and inform the management team of firm performance (i.e., invoicing, backlog, contract management).
* Provides mentoring and training for staff in Summit systems. Provides training or serves as resource to staff regarding engineering design principles and concepts and/or problem resolution.
* Provides input to the management team regarding staff performance reviews and training needs.
* Coordinates in\-house and/or external consultant\-based design teams as required for the successful completion of the work.
* Effectively manages several projects at one time.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor.

**Qualifications/Skills:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering, with a concentration in power distribution or lighting design.
* Registered Professional Electrical Engineer.
* Minimum five years of related project management and engineering experience.
* Demonstrates a proficient knowledge of AutoCAD, Bluebeam Civil 3D, or Revit.
* Exhibits strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with use of computers including spreadsheets, word processing, and engineering software and ability to prepare electronic design documents.
* Ability to oversee the work of others and delegate work effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and budgets, and meet project deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate in\-house and/or external consultant\-based design teams.
* Experience in business development with proven expertise in relationship building.
* Technical competency in design and engineering for the following technical areas:
* Power distribution systems (480V and below)
* Coordination of electrical utility company services
* Short circuit analysis
* Emergency power distribution systems
* Lighting design
* Lighting control systems
* Title 24 Lighting
* Must maintain a valid Driver’s License.
* Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

new_jobs.description:
You'll be joining Central Security, Meta's first line of defense technology team that manages risk across critical security domains. As part of this organization, you'll work within a cross\-functional team of engineers, analysts, product managers, and program managers, collaborating closely with professionals across Product, Infrastructure and Enterprise Engineering teams. You will develop automated and autonomous security systems using AI/ML in high\-impact security domains including Identity and Access Management, Product Security, Threat Detection, Detection \& Response. This organization operates at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and enterprise security, where you'll help shape how Meta approaches security across our entire technology stack, from custom\-built systems to commercial software such as cloud services and increasingly sophisticated AI/ML systems.  

  

  

### **Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) — Central Security Responsibilities:**

* In this position, you'll drive security solutions that protect Meta's most critical assets while enabling rapid innovation, particularly in the AI/ML space. Your primary focus will be architecting and implementing security frameworks for large\-scale AI/ML products and features, ensuring that secure\-by\-design principles are embedded throughout the entire AI/ML lifecycle from conception to deployment. You'll act as a Senior Individual Contributor in a combined organization of Security Engineers, Security Analysts, and Software Engineers to implement security solutions and platforms that serve the entire company and our billions of users. Your strategic thinking will be essential as you determine the highest\-risk items across all security domains, then guide the team through developing detailed threat models and comprehensive solutions. A significant portion of your role involves identifying, assessing and mitigating security risks that are unique to AI/ML systems and products built on top of them — including classical ML, agentic product features, and the risks associated with frontier models. Your influence extends beyond your immediate team — you'll navigate complex tradeoffs between security requirements and operational friction, ensuring Meta can maintain its pace of innovation while remaining secure. This means representing these critical tradeoffs to senior leadership including VPs and C\-levels, where your recommendations will directly influence company\-wide security decisions.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience leading projects with industry\-wide impact
* Vast experience communicating and working across functions to drive solutions
* Significant experience in mentoring/influencing engineers across organizations
* Proven track record of planning multi\-year roadmap in which shorter\-term projects ladder to the long term vision
* Experience in driving large cross\-functional/industry\-wide engineering efforts
* 12\+ years coding experience in C, C\+\+, Java and/or C\#
* 12\+ years experience building server applications

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Security, or related field
* Expertise in AI/ML security domains (e.g., threat modeling for ML systems, ML system design, secure model development, adversarial machine learning)
* Hands\-on experience with agentic development using Frontier AI models
* Proficiency with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks
* Experience with regulatory frameworks and compliance for AI/ML systems
* Familiarity with Meta's technology stack or similar large\-scale environments
* Passion for securing cutting\-edge systems that impact billions of users worldwide

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com.

Are you a bold thinker? We dream big at SNC—advocating the exploration of space, keeping service members safe and creating the systems that keep our world united and sustain our way of living. Join our team! As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will exhibit expert\-level skills in requirements engineering, systems integration, Verification \& Validation (V\&V), and Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE). You will oversee and lead complex system and decision analysis, technical planning, and risk management activities. You will be responsible for major project deliverables, leveraging deep knowledge in architecture/design development, technical monitoring, and lifecycle management. Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills are vital as you influence project direction, mentor team members, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance \& Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high\-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end\-to\-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance \& Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries.
**Responsibilities:**

* Exhibit expert\-level skills in requirements engineering, systems integration, V\&V, and MBSE.
* Oversee and lead complex system and decision analysis, technical planning, and risk management activities.
* Manage major project deliverables and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
* Leverage deep knowledge in architecture/design development, technical monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Provide strong leadership and effective communication.
Mentor and guide team members.  
*

* Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
* Expert proficiency with Systems modeling and simulation tools.
* Proven leadership experience in systems engineering.
* Demonstrated knowledge of multiple Engineering principles and practices.
* Experience working in multi\-disciplinary design and development teams.

Ability to obtain and maintain United States secret security clearance.

* Agile methodologies and Scrum Master certification.
* Missile development experience.

new_jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Platform Engineer to support the deployment, validation, and operation of large\-scale solutions. This role focuses on system bring\-up, hardware and firmware validation, and operational reliability across storage, compute, and networking infrastructure.


You will work closely with senior engineers to ensure systems are correctly configured, stable, and performant: from BIOS settings and firmware versions to OS behavior and device health.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Perform system bring\-up and validation, including BIOS configuration, firmware updates, and OS\-level checks.
* Configure and verify platform settings (BIOS, BMC, OS) to ensure systems meet performance, reliability and consistency standards.
* Execute and validate firmware updates across components, including NVMe drives, NICs, and system firmware.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues related to:
* Device initialization and visibility.
* Firmware mismatches or upgrade failures.
* Misconfigurations impacting performance or stability.
* Understand, define and test procedures for:
* Drive swaps and rebuilds.
* Data integrity and system health checks.
* Minimizing impact to running systems.
* Monitor and validate storage device health, including basic performance characteristics and failure indicators.
* Work with Linux systems to verify configuration, collect diagnostics, and assist in debugging issues.
* Collaborate with senior engineers to escalate and help triage complex cross\-layer issues.
* Contribute to documentation and standardization of bring\-up, validation, and operational procedures.

**What will you bring to DDN**
------------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in systems, infrastructure, or platform\-focused engineering roles.
* Comfortable working directly with hardware and firmware, including BIOS, BMC, and device\-level tools.
* Solid understanding of Linux systems administration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with storage and networking fundamentals (NVMe, NICs, basic I/O concepts).
* Experience performing and supporting firmware updates, with awareness of risk and failure scenarios.
* Good scripting skills; familiarity with Go is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, able to verify configurations and catch subtle issues.
* Willingness to learn and grow into deeper system, performance, and debugging responsibilities.
* Curiosity about why systems perform the way they do: investigate, rather than just run scripts blindly.


Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

new_jobs.title: Sr. Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Senior Controls Engineer

Location: Loveland, CO  
Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Approximately 30% Travel

We’re looking for a Senior Controls Engineer who knows industrial automation and can own projects from programming through startup.

This is a hands\-on role. You’ll be working on custom automation equipment, programming PLCs and HMIs, troubleshooting systems, supporting installations, and working directly with customers and the rest of the engineering team.

The biggest thing we’re looking for is someone who is genuinely strong with Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell controls and is comfortable walking into a machine or automation system, figuring out what’s going on, and getting it running.

You do not need to be a robotics expert. Robotics and vision experience are a plus, but strong controls experience is much more important.

What you’ll be doing:

* Programming and troubleshooting Allen\-Bradley PLCs using Studio 5000
* Developing and modifying HMI applications
* Designing controls for new automation equipment
* Debugging and commissioning equipment in\-house and at customer facilities
* Working with drives, servos, sensors, safety systems, industrial networks, and other controls hardware
* Troubleshooting electrical and controls issues
* Supporting projects from design through installation and startup
* Working directly with customers during commissioning and startup
* Helping guide less experienced engineers when needed
* Traveling to customer sites for installations, startups, and service work

Travel is typically around 30% and comes with the territory in custom automation. It won’t be every week, but you should be comfortable getting on\-site when a project needs you.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for someone with solid real\-world controls experience, not someone who has only made minor PLC changes or supported existing equipment.

Ideally, you have:

* Strong Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell PLC programming experience
* Strong Studio 5000 experience
* HMI programming experience
* Experience with industrial automation or custom machinery
* Experience commissioning and starting up equipment
* Strong electrical troubleshooting ability
* Experience with VFDs, servos, safety systems, sensors, and industrial networks
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Good communication skills with both customers and other engineers

Experience with Fanuc robots, Keyence vision systems, or robotic automation is a plus, but it is not required.

Why this role is worth looking at:

This isn’t a plant maintenance controls job where you’ll spend your day keeping the same equipment alive.

You’ll work on different automation projects, solve different problems, and be involved in projects from the engineering stage all the way through startup.

If you like building things, troubleshooting equipment, programming controls, and seeing a project actually come to life, this is the kind of role you’ll probably enjoy.

We’re looking for someone in the Northern Colorado / Denver\-area market, or someone who is seriously planning to relocate to the area.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Overhaul and Repair Engineering (O\&RE) is a large organization that supports the top U.S. Navy priority of fleet readiness by accomplishing overhaul, repair, and modernization work on active duty SEAWOLF, VIRGINIA, OHIO, and LOS ANGELES class submarines. The organization is involved with all aspects of a project starting with planning and development of technical work documents through supporting final system test and ship certification at Electric Boat’s shipyard and various off\-site U.S. Navy shipyards and facilities. Frequent opportunities exist to travel to other submarine repair facilities in support of Electric Boat contracted fleet maintenance work.  

Overhaul and Repair Engineering is cognizant of almost all systems and components on a submarine, functioning as a dynamic multi\-discipline team involving electrical systems, mechanical/piping systems, and structural components. In order to accomplish its mission, the U.S. Navy needs to minimize the time submarines spend in the shipyard being repaired which requires work to be performed in shifts to maximize progress made each day. This posting is focused on applicants seeking to provide real\-time creative, technical leadership and problem resolution to skilled trades working the afternoon / evening shift, directly impacting the submarine’s ability to return to sea. This includes guidance on navigating unforeseen shipboard conditions; tailoring work procedures to meet unique configurations; and accounting for the realities of fabrication, manufacturing, installation, and testing of shipboard systems and equipment.
Common Electrical Systems* Non\-propulsion electronic systems, including fly\-by\-wire ship control, weapons launch control, navigation, sonar, instrumentation and indications
* Power distribution, electrical methods, electrical hull penetrators, and electromechanical actuation.
* Voice communications, interior communication circuits, and fiber\-optic data distribution.


Common Mechanical/Piping Systems* Valves, actuators, main condensers/heat exchangers, pipe and machinery fabrication and welding
* Weapons and countermeasure launching, steering and diving, hatch operability, masts and antennas, shaft and propulsion, hydraulics, and compressed air.


Common Structural Components* Pressure hull boundary and non\-pressure hull boundary ship structures
* Structure fabrication and welding
* Submarine coating and cathodic protection
* Non\-metallic coverings and treatments

  

O\&RE operates in a collaborative and fast paced manner to ensure safety, stealth, maneuverability, and habitability of a submarine are maintained to the highest level. Engineers interface consistently with other Electric Boat departments including scheduling, quality assurance, material sourcing, contracts, cost engineering, system testing, operations skilled trades, and project management as well as U.S. Navy submariners. On the job training as well as training under more experienced engineers or subject matter experts will be provided.  

Job responsibilities:* Planning of submarine maintenance, repair, and modernization work through the development of clear and concise procedures contained in technical work documents. This includes interpretation of shipbuilding specifications, military specifications and standards, maintenance requirements, construction drawings, and contractual requirements.
* Providing in\-person proactive support to shipyard execution efforts onboard submarines and throughout the shipyard.
* Hands\-on troubleshooting to provide timely technical resolutions for execution roadblocks.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
As a systems engineer with established expertise across the full SE development lifecycle, you will own subsystem requirements for electrical systems on New Glenn's launch pad infrastructure. You will deeply understand and communicate the impacts of design and verification decisions, driving cross\-functional resolution from specification through verification.


This role requires close collaboration with EGSE (Electrical Ground Support Equipment) and DSCE (Data Systems and Controls Engineering) designers, supporting CONOPS development and building strong working relationships with the engineers and operators who design, build, and test these systems. EGSE and DSCE fall within the "C3" discipline \- Command, Communication and Controls. You'll interface regularly with New Glenn Systems Engineering, the Launch Ops Architecture team, and participate in gated design reviews.


We're looking for someone whose core strength is electrical systems, who also brings enough breadth in adjacent disciplines (controls, software, structures, fluids) to understand how electrical subsystems interact with the rest of the vehicle/pad ecosystem.


**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Co\-lead assessment and definition of electrical subsystem solutions for the next\-generation Launch Pad
* Serve as the SE focal point for one or more C3 subsystems — hands\-on collaboration with designers
* Electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) design and documentation
* Own verification planning, tracking, and coordination for electrical systems, while understanding downstream impacts on controls, software, and structural interfaces
* Plan and coordinate subsystem test/activation/commissioning with the Operations Team
* Apply technical expertise to problem solving throughout product lifecycle, including design review support and verification planning and execution, scheduling, etc.
* Conduct strategic subsystem lookaheads, flagging emergent risks related to C3 or cross\-discipline integration issues
* Support milestone design reviews with electrical\-specific technical rigor, while collaborating effectively with controls, avionics, fluids and structural SEs
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on systems or design engineering experience, with a primary emphasis on electrical systems
* Working knowledge of continuity system design/conceptualization — routing, sizing, component selection, testing
* Hands\-on build\-up or testing experience
* Familiarity with at least one additional discipline — controls, software, avionics, fluids, or structures — sufficient to collaborate effectively across subsystem boundaries (this is a plus, not a requirement to exclude strong electrical\-only candidates)
* B.S. degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field
* Robust written and verbal communication skills — ability to translate C3 systems complexity for cross\-functional stakeholders
* Ability to identify, prioritize, and drive systems engineering tasks independently
* Ability to travel up to 25%
* Experience with requirement management tools (e.g., DOORS/DNG) or willingness to learn
* Experience with aerospace or industrial safety standards and verification methods
* Must be a U.S. citizen, national, or permanent resident (Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted refugee/asylee

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with RF systems
* Cross\-disciplinary experience integrating electrical systems with software/controls/avionics and fluids (e.g., valve actuation logic, sensor integration, automated fluid sequencing)
* SE tools: JIRA, Microsoft Project/Visio
* Experience conducting Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
* Graduate degree in related engineering or technical field
* Experience developing and testing complex electronic systems combining hardware, firmware, and software
* Experience with Launch Pad and / or Test Operations
* Knowledge of NFPA or other standards related to electrical systems

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  



  

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  



  

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground

new_jobs.title: Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
new_jobs.description:
About Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions
  
Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions is a fast\-growing defense technology company headquartered in the Tampa Bay area, Florida. Founded by U.S. and U.K. veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real\-world employment of unmanned systems.
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking a detail\-oriented Junior Electrical Engineering Technician to join our electrical integration team. In this role, you will build, integrate, and test wire harnesses, low\-voltage electrical systems, and autonomy components for marine applications. You will work directly with the lead electrical engineer on marine power distribution, wire sizing, network topologies, and sensitive electronics, ensuring high\-quality standards for marine durability and operational reliability.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
**Harness \& Cable Fabrication:** Build, break out, route, and terminate low\-voltage wire harnesses and custom cable assemblies.
  
**Hardware \& Systems Integration:** Mount and wire autonomy hardware, sensors, marine communications equipment, Ethernet switches, and CAN bus networks.
  
**Physical Installation:** Route cabling neatly through tight marine spaces, bulkheads, and conduits, ensuring proper strain relief, bend radius, and chafe protection.
  
**Testing \& Verification:** Conduct continuity, pinout, voltage, and ground checks; assist engineering with troubleshooting electrical and wiring faults.
  
**Component Assembly:** Perform precision hand soldering, weather\-sealing, heat shrinking, and lug crimping.
  
Required Qualifications
  
**Hands\-on Experience:** 2\+ years of electrical assembly, wire harness building, or technician experience (marine, automotive, robotics, or industrial context preferred).
  
**Electrical Diagnostics:** Experience using Digital Multimeters (DMM), bench power supplies, and signal test equipment for troubleshooting and pinout validation.
  
**Tools \& Assembly Techniques:** Proficiency in precision hand soldering, heat shrinking, weather\-sealing, and operating manual/hydraulic crimpers for heavy\-gauge lugs.
  
**Power Systems:** Practical familiarity working with 12–48VDC and 120VAC electrical systems.
  
**Schematics \& Diagrams:** Ability to accurately read and interpret electrical schematics, pinout tables, and wiring diagrams
  
Preferred Experience
  
2–3 years of experience in marine electrical systems, unmanned surface vessels (USVs), or vehicle prototyping.
  
Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automotive, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
Familiarity with CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANalyzer, Kvaser, Peak PCAN, Vehicle Spy).
  
ABYC (American Boat and Yacht Council) Electrical Certification.
  
Work Environment
  
Primarily onsite at Marcurius facilities in Clearwater, Florida, with direct work in workshops, vessels, docks, and field\-testing environments. The role supports prototype development, electrical integration, and sea\-trial preparation in a fast\-paced setting with changing priorities and close cooperation across engineering, software, operations, and test teams.
  
Why Marcurius
  
Marcurius is a people\-first, execution\-focused organization assembling a small, high\-impact team of engineers and operators. This role offers the opportunity to design and field electrical systems that directly enable real\-world maritime missions and help build the technical foundation of a next\-generation unmanned systems company.

Seven Seas Water Group (www.sevenseaswater.com) is a portfolio company owned by investment funds managed by EQT. Headquartered in Tampa, with operations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America, Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) delivers annually over 20 billion gallons of water to industrial, commercial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers. We have more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants in operations throughout the United States, Caribbean, and Latin America. With its mission of Space Access Reimagined®, Sidus Space is committed to rapid innovation, adaptable and cost\-effective solutions, and the optimization of space system and data collection performance. With demonstrated space heritage, including manufacturing and operating its own satellite and sensor system, LizzieSat®, Sidus Space serves government, defense, intelligence, and commercial companies around the globe.

  

Strategically headquartered on Florida’s Space Coast, Sidus Space operates a 35,000\-square\-foot space manufacturing, assembly, integration, and testing facility and provides easy access to nearby launch facilities. But it’s our people who truly set us apart. We foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and agility, empowering our team to innovate and evolve in a rapidly changing industry. Join us at Sidus Space to be part of something extraordinary and help shape the future of space access!

 **Job Summary**

  

The Senior PCB Design Electrical Engineer will design and develop high‑reliability circuit card assemblies (CCAs) and integrated electronic systems for spaceflight and other mission‑critical applications.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical guidance.

Ability to travel \< 10%

Onsite work Monday through Friday; day shift generally working 8am to 5pm
