new_jobs.title: Scrum Master / Systems Engineer - SWIS
new_jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

 **CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**  

Department of Defense Secret security clearance is preferred at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, **U.S. citizenship is required**.
Responsibilities for this Position:
**ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:**
As a Systems Engineer \- Scrum Master for the Strategic Weapon Interface Simulator (SWIS), you will perform systems engineering and help a cross\-functional engineering team plan and deliver simulation capabilities supporting the future Columbia\-class submarine fleet.  

SWIS brings together the simulation capabilities needed to support both Fire Control system development and fleet training. It allows engineering teams to develop, integrate, and test Fire Control capabilities in lab environments and helps prepare the fleet to operate those capabilities before they are used aboard a submarine.  

In this role, you will facilitate the team's Agile execution and contribute directly to systems engineering work. You will use Jira to maintain a clear and actionable backlog, plan achievable work, track sprint commitments and team performance, manage dependencies, and provide transparent status to stakeholders. You will facilitate Scrum events, remove impediments, and use Jira data and objective measures to improve predictability and delivery. You will partner with product owners, technical leads, engineering disciplines, and program leadership to connect technical priorities with executable plans.  

You will apply an understanding of Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and Cost Account Management (CAM) when planning and reporting the team's work. You may support CAMs and program leadership by maintaining credible work plans, evaluating actual and forecast performance, contributing to estimates to complete and estimates at completion, supporting variance analysis and change\-control activities, and communicating risks and corrective actions. You may not be the CAM of record for assigned work packages, but you will understand how day\-to\-day engineering execution affects program cost, schedule, and earned value performance.  

You will also contribute to systems engineering activities across the development life cycle, including requirements management, technical planning, integration, verification, test, risk management, and technical documentation. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys creating clarity, helping teams solve delivery problems, and connecting day\-to\-day engineering work to program cost and schedule commitments.  

We encourage you to apply if you have any of these preferred skills or experiences:* Hands\-on experience administering and using Jira to manage backlogs, epics, stories, tasks, workflows, dashboards, queries, sprint metrics, dependencies, and team reporting.
* Experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile team facilitator, project lead, or technical task lead for a cross\-functional engineering team.
* Experience with Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, DevSecOps, or other Lean\-Agile practices in a hardware, software, systems, or integrated product\-development environment.
* Experience supporting Cost Account Management or working with earned value management systems (EVMS), work breakdown structures, integrated master schedules, or program planning and control.
* Experience analyzing schedule and cost performance using measures such as schedule performance index (SPI), cost performance index (CPI), budgeted cost, actual cost, and estimate at completion.
* Experience developing resource plans, forecasts, variance analyses, corrective\-action plans, or inputs to program reviews.
* Experience managing technical scope, risks, dependencies, and changes while maintaining alignment among engineering and program stakeholders.
* Experience with systems engineering activities such as requirements management, system design, integration, verification, test, or technical documentation.
* Experience integrating Jira planning and performance data with Confluence, scheduling tools, EVMS tools, or program reporting processes.
* Experience with defense systems, Fleet Ballistic Missile or Fire Control programs, simulation systems, training systems, or other mission\-critical integrated systems.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile, EVMS, or CAM training or certification.
 **What sets you apart:*** Solid understanding and application of systems engineering principles, concepts, and theories.
* Strong Jira skills and the ability to configure useful team workflows, dashboards, filters, and reports while maintaining reliable planning data.
* Ability to facilitate productive planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily coordination while helping a team continuously improve.
* Ability to translate technical scope into logical work packages, measurable milestones, realistic forecasts, and clear ownership.
* Working understanding of project leadership principles, including SPI/CPI, earned value, Cost Account Management, forecasting, and disciplined change control.
* Ability to identify emerging cost, schedule, technical, and dependency risks and drive practical corrective actions to closure.
* Collaborative leadership style that supports team accountability, constructive problem\-solving, and transparent communication.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain performance, risks, and recommendations to technical and program stakeholders.
* Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle complex assignments efficiently.
* Commitment to ongoing professional development for yourself and others.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**



The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:


* **Data Processing**: We are building state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user\-friendly, and highly fault\-tolerant.
* **Data Discovery**: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
* **Data Lineage**: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.
  


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
* Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
* Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
* Lead and champion high\-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.
  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
* BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
* Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
* Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
* Experience with distributed system design and development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, continuous delivery environment
  


**Bonus Points (not required):**


* Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in cross\-functional development teams
* Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
* Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.
  


**We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.**

  

**\#LI\-AE1**

 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.**


**Our journey is always people first.**



We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.


**Higher purpose, greater impact.**



We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do.


**Scale up, not starting up.**



Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.



Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

You will own and shape how Praxis designs, governs, secures, and operates AWS at scale—from account structure and identity to the platforms and applications that run on them. * Own and evolve AWS architecture for enterprise workloads, including multi\-account foundations, landing zone / Control Tower patterns, networking, security baselines, and shared platforms.

* Design and operate identity and access across AWS, including IAM, IAM Identity Center, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations for SSO, federation, role mapping, access reviews, and least\-privilege access.
* Build, harden, and operate AWS platforms and full\-stack services using TypeScript and Python, including compute, containers, serverless, data stores, messaging, and cloud automation as needed.
* Drive operational excellence across AWS platforms and workloads by building effective monitoring, alerting, dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, runbooks, incident response practices, and durable fixes to recurring problems; participate in the on\-call rotation and own incidents through resolution and learning.
* Automate infrastructure and delivery through Infrastructure as Code—preferably Pulumi and/or SST—and CI/CD using Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions, with an emphasis on safe, incremental delivery and low blast radius.
* Partner across engineering and IT to translate needs into secure, maintainable solutions, improve production readiness and operational practices, mentor other engineers, and use sound judgment to move fast without breaking things.


**Qualifications**


* Senior\-level software engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on experience building and operating production systems on AWS.
* Strong full\-stack engineering capability in TypeScript and Python, including APIs, services, tooling, and cloud automation.
* Deep experience with core AWS services used in enterprise environments, including IAM, Organizations, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudWatch, KMS, Config, and GuardDuty.
* Proven ability to design and operate AWS governance at scale, including multi\-account strategy, policy guardrails, access control, security standards, and operational controls.
* Strong AWS networking fundamentals, including VPNs, peering, Transit Gateway, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with enterprise SSO; Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) federation into AWS is strongly preferred, including SAML/OIDC, IAM Identity Center, application and role mapping, and access lifecycle practices.
* Experience working in regulated or audit\-ready environments, with strong habits around change control, evidence and traceability, least privilege, and durable controls.
* Demonstrated operational ownership: able to establish meaningful alerts and monitors, reduce noise, improve reliability, respond to incidents, and turn operational learnings into engineering improvements.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience; Pulumi and/or SST strongly preferred. Terraform or AWS CDK experience is transferable and welcome.
* Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions.
* Proficient with modern AI coding and productivity tools, with the judgment to validate outputs, test changes, manage risk, and maintain production quality.
* The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**  

  

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and *their* people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company\-paid life insurance, AD\&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar\-for\-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long\-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company\-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let's achieve the impossible together!

Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. \* \* \*  

  

**The Opportunity:**

  

CACI/Space’s Radar and Sensor Technologies group is seeking a systems engineer to support one of our primary programs working with the US Government to understand and define requirements for our software staff. In this position, you will be at the forefront of developing the systems that keep our nation safe and work in space emerging technology. This position will work with our team on adapting our architecture to the program requirements, creating a testing approach, and interacting across our program teams to ensure clear understanding during the software development cycle. The position is based in Ypsilanti, Michigan. This work requires candidates to be a US citizen eligible for a Top Secret clearance.

LTS Lohmann Therapy Systems is a global leader in transdermal and oral thin‑film drug delivery technologies. **Electrical/Controls Engineer\- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing**

**Position Overview**
---------------------


LTS is seeking an experienced **Electrical/Controls Engineer** to design, improve, and sustain automated manufacturing and packaging systems in a highly regulated environment. new_jobs.title: Experienced Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Controls Engineer – Multiple Career Levels
  
PAR Systems designs and builds custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges across industries including medical device, aerospace, and defense. Our solutions are engineered to solve our customers’ most complex challenges, not pulled from a catalog. You will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging systems incorporating robots, vision, complex motion, lasers, and more.
  
  

We're looking for Controls Engineers across multiple career levels. Levels are based on the experience, technical depth, independence, and leadership each candidate brings, not whether they've worked with every technology or tool we use. If your background is in custom automation and you enjoy figuring out how to make complex machines work, we'd like to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't match every technology listed below.
  
  

What You'll Own
  
As a Controls Engineer at PAR, you'll help bring custom automated equipment from concept to production. Depending on your experience, you may contribute to or independently lead the controls scope of a project, including:
  
* Translating customer and system requirements into a controls architecture and technical approach.
* Designing, programming, and integrating PLC, HMI, motion, robotics, vision, and other automation technologies.
* Bringing equipment to life through power\-up, debug, commissioning, and process optimization.
* Troubleshooting complex hardware, software, and system\-level problems.
* Supporting design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing, installation, and Site Acceptance Testing.
* Partnering with mechanical, electrical, software, project management, operations, and quality teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* At more senior levels, owning controls execution for entire production lines, providing technical direction, mentoring other engineers, and helping teams solve their toughest automation challenges.


**Experience \& Requirements:** What You Bring
  
We're looking for a combination of relevant experience and technical capability. The requirements needed to be successful in this role are:
  
* A relevant engineering, computer science, automation, or technical background through education and/or equivalent experience.
* Experience developing and commissioning controls or software for automated equipment.
* The ability to troubleshoot problems across hardware, software, and machine processes.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering or project team.
* Increasing ownership of controls projects or systems appropriate to your career level.
* Openness to use of AI in your workflow
* Ability to travel to customer sites for installation and commissioning, typically 0–10%, with occasional variation based on project needs.
* US Persons


**Some of the platforms and tools you may work with include:**  

* PLC \& Controls: Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Omron Sysmac Studio, Beckhoff TwinCAT
* HMI/SCADA: FactoryTalk View, Inductive Automation Ignition
* Robotics: FANUC, Epson, KUKA
* Vision: Cognex, Keyence
* Software: Visual Studio, C\#, VB
* Motion: Servo and multi\-axis motion control systems
* Electrical Design: AutoCAD Electrical, ePLAN, or similar tools
* Simulation: Ability to envision and pursue virtual commissioning


Technical Careers at PAR Systems \- Where You Could Fit
  
Great engineering careers are not one\-size\-fits\-all. At PAR Systems, engineers grow by taking on bigger challenges, expanding their technical expertise, and increasing their impact. Whether you are building your foundation, leading complex technical work, solving problems across teams, or shaping the future of our capabilities, there is room to grow and contribute at every stage of your career.
  
  

Our engineering career path includes Engineer, Advanced Engineer, Senior Engineer, and Principal Engineer, with increasing scope, independence, technical leadership, and impact at each level. Progression is based on demonstrated technical capability, problem\-solving, leadership, and impact, not simply years of overall experience.
  
  

For our experienced engineering opportunities, you don't need to determine where you fit before applying. We encourage you to start with a conversation. Together, we'll explore your experience, technical depth, and career interests to determine how they align with our engineering levels and opportunities.
  
  

You’ve learned about what you'll be doing, here are the benefits you'll gain when you join our team:
  
* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing
* First\-of\-a\-kind product culture and project exposure
* Training and development from industry\-leading experts
* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) \& matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability \& Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, \& Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement


PAR Systems is an equal opportunity employer and we value individuals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other status protected by applicable law. We use AI to assist with sorting applications, but real humans do all the evaluating and deciding. If selected for an interview, please advise our Human Resources department if you require accommodation during the interview or assessment process and we will support your accessibility needs. We offer market competitive pay and benefits based upon the candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Our starting rate of pay for these salaried positions range from $110,000\-160,000 annually

**Description**


The Staff Software Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for helping shape the architecture, strategy, and long\-term success of our parking devices and applications. As a highly experienced engineer, you will be involved in critical architectural decisions, solve complex and ambiguous problems, and set engineering standards that impact multiple teams.


This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong system design skills, and the ability to influence across organizational boundaries. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Technical Leads, and cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure our solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business goals.


The Staff Engineer is not only a hands\-on technical contributor but also a mentor, setting the bar for engineering excellence and supporting the growth of engineers across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Strategy \& System Design**

* Contribute to the design and evolution of core architectural patterns and frameworks used across teams.
* Drive technical roadmap development in partnership with product and engineering leadership.
* Solve complex, ambiguous, and high\-impact technical challenges, balancing trade\-offs in scalability, performance, and cost.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies and approaches that improve system reliability and developer productivity.
* Help ensure that architectural decisions support long\-term maintainability and product growth.

**Technical Execution \& Standards**

* Guide teams in implementing scalable, secure, and high\-quality solutions.
* Champion engineering excellence by defining coding, testing, and architectural standards.
* Provide technical reviews and guidance across multiple teams and codebases.
* Partner with Cloud Operations team and infrastructure teams to optimize CI/CD, observability, and reliability practices.

**Collaboration \& Influence**

* Work with Product Management, Architecture, and Technical Lead Managers to align engineering direction with product strategy.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing technical insight and recommendations.
* Bridge gaps across teams to ensure consistent practices, shared solutions, and technical alignment.
* Communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Act as the point\-person in critical outages and work with the technical lead managers to troubleshoot, diagnose, and fix any issues following our incident process flow.

**Mentorship \& Culture**

* Mentor engineers at all levels, fostering technical growth and leadership development.
* Help build and sustain a culture of learning, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Model effective collaboration and create opportunities for others to lead.

**Qualifications**

* **12\+ years** of professional software development experience, with demonstrated expertise across multiple systems and technologies.
* Advanced proficiency in **.NET Core, React (or similar), and cloud\-native architectures (AWS preferred)**.
* Deep experience with **system design, distributed systems, and architectural trade\-offs**.
* Proficiency with **databases (SQL and NoSQL)**, event\-driven systems, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Track record of delivering high\-impact technical solutions and influencing technical direction at the team or org level.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

**Desired Attributes**

* A strategic thinker who sees the “big picture” and can balance immediate needs with long\-term goals.
* Comfortable making tough technical trade\-offs in ambiguous situations.
* Highly collaborative and influential, with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Passionate about building systems that last — scalable, reliable, and maintainable.
* Committed to mentoring others and raising the technical bar for the organization.

new_jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Mechatronics Engineer position is a technical leadership role within Operations that serves as a liaison between manufacturing engineering, product engineering, quality, and production teams. The role focuses on developing, implementing, and improving automated manufacturing systems, controls, robotics, and industrial equipment to enhance efficiency, quality, reliability, and safety. The engineer leads projects, supports new product launches, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and provides technical expertise for troubleshooting and process optimization. The position is reported to the Manufacturing \& Industrial Engineering Manager.  

  

Qualification 1: Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, or a related technical field.  

Qualification 2: 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing, automation, controls, or maintenance engineering within an industrial environment.  

Qualification 3: Demonstrates expertise in PLC programming, troubleshooting, modification, and commissioning, with the ability to diagnose complex control\-related issues and restore equipment to reliable operation. Experience should also include HMI configuration, machine interface development, industrial sensors, servo systems, variable frequency drives, and industrial communication networks.  

Qualification 4: Strong hands\-on experience with industrial robotics and automated manufacturing systems, including robot programming, troubleshooting, integration, optimization, and production support. Experience integrating robotics with other manufacturing equipment, controls, sensors, welding systems, or vision applications is preferred.  

Qualification 5: Strong electro\-mechanical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose equipment issues and read electrical schematics and technical drawings.  

Qualification 6: Experience with manufacturing data and production monitoring systems, including MES, SCADA, historian platforms, industrial data collection systems, and OEE analytics. Must be able to use manufacturing data to identify performance losses, equipment trends, downtime causes, quality concerns, and opportunities for process improvement.  

Qualification 7: Working knowledge of machine safety, functional safety systems, risk assessments, safety relays/PLCs, machine guarding, and LOTO requirements.  

Qualification 8: Strong project management, vendor coordination, and cross\-functional leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities.  

Qualification 9: Strong root cause analysis and structured problem\-solving capabilities using tools such as 5\-Why analysis, Fishbone/Ishikawa diagrams, FMEA, fault isolation, and other analytical problem\-solving methods. Description: **IMPORTANT APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS**

TRUE Fitness is looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our engineering team and help design, test, troubleshoot, and improve the electrical systems behind our fitness equipment. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with both hardware and systems, and seeing their work become a real product.


You’ll work across electrical and electronic systems—from motors and control boards to wiring, sensors, power components, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). You’ll collaborate with engineering and other teams to ensure our products are safe, reliable, manufacturable, and perform as intended.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide technical support and engineering expertise for electrical systems used in fitness equipment, including:


AC and DC power systems


AC and DC motors and control boards


Linear actuators


Motor\-driven pulley conveyors


EMI filters


Capacitors, inductors, resistors, switches, and circuit breakers


Cables, wiring, and related electrical components

* Read, interpret, and follow electrical schematics to analyze and troubleshoot electrical systems.
* Design and create interface cables, wiring diagrams, schematics, and cable assemblies using CAD tools.
* Test and troubleshoot electrical and electronic systems using a variety of test equipment, including:


Digital multimeters


Oscilloscopes


Immunity test generators


Spectrum analyzers


Power meters

* Apply techniques to identify and reduce radiated and conducted electrical disturbances.
* Develop and perform testing of electrical products and components.
* Design and fabricate test fixtures, devices, and equipment needed to support product testing and validation.
* Review and evaluate engineering changes from internal engineering teams and outside suppliers or engineering firms.
* Maintain accurate digital engineering records, test documentation, and project information.
* Provide routine project and testing progress updates.
* Work collaboratively with engineering, product development, manufacturing, quality, and other teams to resolve technical issues and improve products.
* Support other engineering projects and initiatives as needed.

**What You Bring**


Required:

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* At least 2 years of experience with:


Analog and digital circuits


Electrical system analysis


Electrical troubleshooting


Project management

* Experience using CAD software to create wiring diagrams, schematics, and cable assemblies.
* Experience with Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and electrical disturbance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.

**What You'll Get to Work On**


This isn't an engineering role where you'll spend all day behind a desk. You'll have opportunities to design, test, troubleshoot, build, and improve real products. You'll work directly with electrical and electronic components and help solve problems throughout the product development and manufacturing process.


If you enjoy figuring out why something isn't working, designing a better solution, and seeing that solution make its way into a finished product, we'd like to hear from you.

This position requires infrequent domestic and international travel.

The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. Overview:  

We are seekingan **Instrumentation \& Controls** **Engineer** to join our team of experienced engineering professionals. This position provides the opportunity to contribute to a variety of controls engineering projects from initial concept (FEED) through design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. The successful candidate will work closely with engineers, designers, clients, and vendors to deliver effective engineering solutions for Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) and natural gas projects nationwide.  

This role is based in our **Portsmouth, NH** office. **About NV5 LNG Engineering**
At NV5, we engineer transformative LNG solutions to address industry pressing challenges head\-on.
Our innovative approach includes the design and installation of liquefaction equipment at gas utility sites, enabling utilities to purchase natural gas at opportune moments when prices are low and compress it into liquefied natural gas (LNG). By compressing natural gas into LNG, utilities can effectively store it, ensuring availability during peak usage periods and mitigating the impact of price fluctuations.*Join us in revolutionizing natural gas delivery, as we harness the power of technology to meet the evolving needs of a dynamic energy landscape.* *NV5 offers competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k), cell phone allowance, employee discount program and professional development/advancement opportunities.**NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.* ***Recruitment \& Staffing Agencies****: NV5 Inc does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than passive \& active candidates and employee referrals. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to NV5 or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by NV5's internal Talent Acquisition team seeking 3rd party sourcing assistance. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement and given permission to represent NV5 to candidates on a particular search, NV5 will not owe any referral or other fees with respect to the unsolicited submission.*  


Responsibilities:
* Lead the selection, procurement, and installation of hardware for industrial automation equipment and instrumentation systems.
* Design control system panels, networks, field junction boxes, and other control system hardware components.
* Develop and implement process control system narratives.
* Assist with the development of Piping and Instrument Diagrams and ensure adherence to ISA standards for the process industry.

* Travel is typically between 10% to 20% but varies each year depending on site commissioning activities. Travel in continental US only.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Shape the Future of Engineering at BAE Systems
  

See what you’re missing. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced software and electronics – from developing world\-class autonomous mission management capabilities to advanced data analytics to support the warfighters and the intelligence community. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  

  

Imagine being at the forefront of a seismic shift in the way engineering is done. BAE Systems' Model Based Engineering Capability Group (MBE CG) is on a mission to transform the industry with cutting\-edge Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices. We're seeking a visionary MBSE expert to join our team and help propel this revolution forward.
  

  

As a key player in our MBE CG, you'll be responsible for championing the implementation of Agile\-MBSE best practices, empowering programs across the ES Sector with the latest MBSE training and providing technical guidance on model development and process implementation. Your expertise will be instrumental in driving our transition to a Digital Enterprise (DE), where virtual and cloud\-based networks are redefining the boundaries of traditional engineering.
  

  

This role’s responsibilities will require you:


* Utilize your knowledge of MBSE processes, practices, tools, and related modeling languages and frameworks (e.g. SysML, UML, UAF) to solve complex technical problems
* Guide a program in their total MBSE development activities
* Collaborate with project teams and leadership to contribute to the development of MBSE training materials and company best practices

Join our team of trailblazers and help shape the future of engineering at BAE Systems. If you have a strong passion for MBSE and a desire to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Active Secret Security Clearance

new_jobs.description:
**About Eos Energy Enterprises**

Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. is accelerating the shift to American energy independence with positively ingenious solutions that transform how the world stores power. Our breakthrough Znyth™ aqueous zinc battery was designed to overcome the limitations of conventional lithium\-ion technology. It is safe, scalable, efficient, sustainable, manufactured in the U.S., and the core of our innovative systems that today provides utility, industrial, and commercial customers with a proven, reliable energy storage alternative for 3 to 12\-hour applications. Eos was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Edison, New Jersey. For more information about Eos (NASDAQ: EOSE), visit eose.com .


Eos is at the forefront of developing advanced embedded solutions for energy storage and management. The Manager of Embedded Software Engineering will lead a team of talented engineers in designing, developing, and optimizing firmware for Battery Management Systems (BMS) tailored to the Eos battery technologies, ensuring safety, reliability, and compliance with industry standards such as UL 1998, UL 60730 Annex H, etc.


The Manager of Embedded Software Engineering is responsible for overseeing the strategic direction, technical execution, and team performance in the development of embedded firmware for the Eos BMS. This role involves managing a team of engineers using the V\-model of software design, driving safety\-critical compliance with UL 60730 Annex H, and ensuring seamless integration of firmware with hardware components like STM32 microcontrollers, CAN/CANFD, RS\-485 protocols, ADC\-s, etc.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead Firmware Development for BMS: Oversee the design, documentation, development, and maintenance of embedded firmware for generations of Eos Battery Management Systems, ensuring adherence to the V\-model and compliance with UL 60730 Annex H functional safety standards.
* Team Management: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of embedded software engineers, setting performance goals, allocating resources, and fostering a collaborative, innovative environment.
* Drive Safety and Compliance: Ensure the implementation of diagnostics, fail\-safe mechanisms, and safety features (e.g., overvoltage/undervoltage protection, electrolyte monitoring) in BMS firmware, aligning with UL 60730 Annex H requirements.
* Strategic Oversight of Communication Protocols: Guide the team in designing and implementing communication interfaces (e.g., CAN/CANFD, RS\-485, I2C) for real\-time data transmission and control of battery systems.
* Collaborate on Hardware\-Software Integration: Partner with electronics engineering leads to ensure robust integration of firmware with BMS hardware, including sensors, ADCs, and power electronics, while overseeing validation and performance testing.
* Hardware\-Software Integration: Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure proper integration of firmware with BMS hardware components, including sensors, and power electronics, conducting safety validation and performance testing.
* Process Improvement: Develop and refine embedded software engineering processes to enhance efficiency, reliability, and scalability of BMS development.
* Documentation and Standards: Oversee the creation of comprehensive technical documentation (e.g., design specifications, test plans, compliance reports) and ensure traceability and quality per V\-model methodologies.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with other departments (e.g., product management, etc.) to align embedded software efforts with company goals and support troubleshooting tools and commissioning processes.
* Roadmap Development: Contribute to the strategic planning of future BMS product features and enhancements, aligning with Eos’ clean energy mission.
* Ensure a safe work environment by following health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Root Cause Analysis: Lead investigations into firmware\-related failures, implementing corrective actions to improve system reliability.
* Champion a culture of continuous learning by staying updated on advancements in BMS design, microcontroller platforms, and safety standards.
* Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Leadership Expertise: Proven ability to lead and inspire a team of embedded software engineers, balancing technical guidance with managerial oversight.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong background in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems, real\-time operating systems (RTOS), and microcontroller\-based development (e.g., STM32 family).
* Safety Standards Knowledge: Deep understanding of IEC 60730 Annex H and its application to safety\-critical embedded systems.
* Communication Protocols: Expertise in CAN bus, CANFD, RS\-485, SPI, I2C, and other protocols relevant to battery systems.
* Problem\-Solving: Exceptional ability to troubleshoot complex software and hardware integration issues and implement scalable solutions.
* Project Management: Skilled in managing timelines, resources, and deliverables in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
* Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and clearly articulate technical concepts.
* Knowledge of embedded security practices (e.g., secure bootloaders, encryption).

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related field required.
* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years' experience.

**Travel**
----------

* Local Travel: Less than 10%
* Overnight/North America: Less than 10%

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Office Environment \- Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time and occasion

new_jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high\-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work\-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.


L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission\-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end\-to\-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title:*** ***Scientist, Electrical Engineering***

***Job Code: 44954***

***Job Location:*** ***Clifton, NJ***

***Job Schedule: 9/80: Employee works 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off***

 **Job Description:**

  

L3Harris EW in Clifton, NJ has an immediate need for highly motivated FPGA design engineer. In this role you will develop, simulate, and integrate in lab highly specialized firmware designs targeting electronic warfare systems. Responsibilities include generation of firmware derived requirements, architecture of digital solutions to meet said requirements and formal test / lab verification of the functional system. The qualified candidate is able to work semi\-autonomously as a lead designer, potentially driving a small team of firmware engineers through coding, simulation, code analysis, and circuit card design support.  

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide leadership and Subject Matter Expertise for the development of high reuse and easily extensible EW technology.
* Develop Signal Processing Architectures targeting single chip and distributed chip low latency signal classification and countermeasures.
* Work cross\-functionally to adopt an efficient, common, mission specific, best practices derived, development process.
* Work with a variety of firmware, software, and systems development teams, assuring requirements are verified in a consistent fashion prior to firmware delivery to Integration.
* Decompose and allocate system and box\-level requirements to FPGA specifications.
* Architect High Complexity solutions against requirements and implement those solutions in FPGA platforms.
* Map FPGA simulation work products to system\-level requirements and capabilities
* Refine and enforce efficient, effective, and consistent firmware development processes across FPGA designs.
* Lead team of engineers generating FPGA design solutions, assuring adherence to best practices.
* Ensure the FPGA simulations verify performance, then integrate and test the FPGA on the circuit card assembly.
* Ability to obtain a Top\-Secret security clearance.

 **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience, or Graduate Degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

 **Preferred Additional Skills:**

  

* System level knowledge of Electronic Warfare technology with a concentration in FPGA Firmware architecture development and support.
* Experience and understanding of RF concepts and constraints including analog/digital conversion, channel bandwidth, resolution BW, noise, gain, and power.
* Experience targeting VPX architecture and familiarity with SOSA standards.
* Experience with High Complexity FPGA Digital Design Techniques and Devices.
* Experience debugging down to the hardware level \& experience using Signal Generators, Logic Analyzers, Digital Oscilloscopes and Embedded FPGA Debugging tools.
* MATLAB signal processing and simulation
* FPGA: Mentor Graphics HDL Designer, Mentor Graphics ModelSim/Questa, Synopsis Synplicity, Xilinx ISE, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus.
* FPGA: UVM, OVM, SystemVerilog, SystemC.
* FPGA: Bring\-up of advanced FPGA products like SoC, MPSoC, RFSoC, ACAP, etc.
* General: Microsoft Office, DOORs (Requirement Specification and Tractability), Revision Control (GIT, etc.), JIRA, Confluence, Linux.
* Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodology and tools (Cameo, etc.)
* Programming in C, C\+\+, Python, TCL.
* Working knowledge of Circuit Card design: Schematic Entry, PCB/PWB Layout/Route.
* Active TS/SCI Clearance.
* MSEE or PhD, Computer Engineering or related field.
* Oversight of a team of senior FW Engineers. Responsibilities to include:
* + Partnering with programs to ensure they are correctly staffed, engineering processes are being followed, and proposal efforts are supported.
	+ Tracking performance of a Clifton Electrical Engineering FW group including staffing, training, onboarding, employee development, engagement and proactive retention
	+ Regular review of metrics to drive year\-over\-year performance improvement
	+ Serving as FW functional representative for site specific design reviews and review/approval of proposals and Basis of Estimates (BOEs) as needed
	+ Providing technical evaluation and oversight of program execution and leading/participating in technical issue resolution teams when required
	+ Ensuring knowledge transfer and mentoring of less experienced engineers occurs within the overall department
	+ Effective communicator with proven ability to deliver and sustain measurable results


In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $153,000\-$284,000\. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company\-paid holidays. **We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  

ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR) is seeking a System Engineer to join our Voice Communication System (VCS) team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) at the William J. Hughes Technical Center for Advanced Aerospace (WJHTCAA) in Egg Harbor Township, NJ.
  
  

VCS is the FAA’s effort to replace outdated analog Time Division Multiplexing (TDM) voice switches with modern, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) enabled systems across Air Traffic Control (ATC) facilities nationwide.
  
  

The candidate will work within a system engineering team to collaboratively support the VCS program. The team will collectively be responsible for overseeing integration and deployment of network management software; interfacing with 3rd party data collection stream(s); establishing workflows to automate deployment, configuration, and monitoring of hardware/software systems; configuration, remote management, and troubleshooting of test/lab equipment, including root cause analysis; working with software and hardware development teams for requirements, integration, testing activities.
  
  

Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  
* Be a US Citizen, have a US Green Card, or a Non\-immigrant Work Authorization (VISA).
* Has resided in the US for three (3\) consecutive years.
* The company is unable to sponsor candidates at this time.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.


Relocation Requirement
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to Egg Harbor Township, NJ.
  
  

Education \& Experience Requirement
  
All non\-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate.
  
* Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Information System Electrical Engineering/Computer Science or in another technical field, such as Physics, Aerospace, Chemistry, or Mathematics.
* Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is highly desirable.
* Two (2\) to four (4\) years of related work experience.


Required Skills
  
* Knowledge/experience in:
* Operating Systems (RHEL, Windows).
* Scripting languages (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Perl, Python).
* Experience in routing and networking technologies.
* Ability to:
* Work independently, as well as a team, in an agile environment.
* Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
* Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.
* Implement and apply best\-practice system engineering concepts.


Preferred Skills
  
* Knowledge/experience in:
* Network analysis tools (Wireshark, Stablenet).
* System monitoring tools (Zabbix, SNMP).
* Log aggregation and reporting (ELK/Opensearch, Splunk).
* System security management and intrusion detection tools (IdM, SSL, IPSec/VPN, SELinux, AIDE).
* Telecommunications protocols (SIP/RTP, ED\-137\).
* Virtualization (ESXi, KVM, Red Hat Virtualization).
* Data replication and storage (DBRD, NAS/SAN).


Essential Daily Job Duties
  
* Hands\-on integration of software and hardware components including software installation and configuration, network configuration, and telecommunications hardware integration.
* Implements and validates IT system solutions for networking, computing, and our propriety communications equipment including conceptional, functional, and physical views.
* Creates and reviews technical documentation supporting production build (e.g., rack layouts, cable plans, system layouts, system configuration, build of materials, build plans/instructions).
* Collaborates with internal teams (e.g., program management, hardware \& software development, solution architects, test engineering, field engineering, production) for total project success.
* Supports system production team to troubleshoot and solve production issues.
* Analyzes site and contract information to determine, recommend, and plan layout for type of computers and peripheral equipment, or modifications to existing equipment and systems that will provide capability for proposed project or work load, efficient operation, and effective use of allotted space.
* Ensures adherence to industry standards, regulations, and best practices.
* May participate in/develop:
* Test procedures to verify system functionally and perform system debug
* Factory acceptance tests, site acceptance tests, failure location and analysis.
* Remote system monitoring, maintenance, and tier 2 on call support.
* On\-site installations, integration, testing and maintenance activities.


Work Environment
  
* Full\-time position with a standard flexible work schedule; occasional nights or weekend may be required.
* Occasional travel (\~ 5 \- 10%).
* Cubicle environment.

new_jobs.description:

----------------------------


**What We're Doing**  

As a part of the Lockheed Martin community, we take on challenges and find solutions using creativity and collaboration. If you’re looking to be a part of a passionate team solving these complex problems, then Rotary and Mission Systems is the place for you.

 **The Work**
  

Lockheed Martin's Rotary \& Mission Systems is seeking a full\-time Software Engineer for our Platform Services team. In this role, you will:

* Support multiple Mission Integrated Command \& Control (MIC2\) Line of Business (LOB) programs.
* Perform software and systems development tasks (design, code, test, integration) for a full spectrum of Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) solutions.
* Develop new applications and integrate COTS and GOTS software to construct a complete solution.
* Travel between LM sites as well as customer sites.

 **Who We Are**


Lockheed Martin is a global aerospace, defense, and security company dedicated to advancing scientific discovery and harnessing innovation to make the world a safer place. Our RMS business in Mount Laurel, NJ is a hub of talented engineers, scientists, and professionals committed to shaping the future of defense technology. We value collaboration, excellence, and integrity in everything we do. As a part of our team, you will work alongside like\-minded individuals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.  

  

Learn more about Integrated Air Missile Defense

 **Why Join Us**
  

**Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life**
  

Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.


\#rmshotmiljobs

------------------------


* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Information Systems
* Understanding of systems analysis, design, requirements development, integration and test methodologies
* Understanding of higher\-level programming languages, such as Java, C\+\+
* Understanding of scripting languages, such as bash, python.
* Ability to develop test scripts (bash, csh, python) and software test drivers (C/C\+\+ and Java) to exercise middleware service test procedures.
* Ability to identify and isolate system defects during integration and test activities.
* Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD Security clearance.
* Candidate must be able to support periodic travel.
**Desired Skills**
------------------


* Understanding of cloud concepts: virtualization technologies, IaaS, PaaS, and cloud delivery models.

**Job Description**


LS Technologies, a Tetra Tech Company, is seeking an Electrical Engineer with technical expertise to support the test, evaluation, and analysis of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Air Traffic Control Communication Systems.

**Job Duties \& Responsibilities \- Essential Job Functions may include, but are not limited to, the following**

* Provides engineering expertise in the application of state\-of\-the\-art technology to meet mission requirements.
* Planning, developing and executing Operational Test Cases which validate Operational Suitability of Air traffic Control Communications Systems and evaluation of Air to Ground
* Protocol Converter contractor test plans procedures and reports.
* Develops and executes procedures for measurement of Internet Protocol (IP), analog and discrete signals such as: IP to analog or discrete signal conversion delay, voice delay, idle channel noise, impulse noise, AGC, intermodulation distortion, and encoding/decoding of EUROCAE ED\-137 messaging.
* Primary duty is support of technical performance testing for the Air\-to\-Ground Protocol Converter (Converts EUROCAE ED\-137C VOIP audio and signaling to analog voice and discrete control signals for FAA Radios) and Ground\-to\-Ground Protocol Converters (Converts EUROCAE ED\-137C VOIP audio and signaling to telecommunications trunk audio and signaling for interfacing between FAA ED\-137 compliant VOIP Voice Communication legacy telecommunication trunks).

* Knowledge of IPv4 networking principles.

new_jobs.description:
**About Sandia**
----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting\-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:


* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co\-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten\-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part\-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World\-changing technologies. Life\-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

  

  

* These benefits vary by job classification.
**What Your Job Will Be Like**
------------------------------

  

Sandia Department 5424 Electrical Flight Systems in the 5420 Strike Systems group is seeking an R\&D S\&E Systems Engineer to complement the Engineering team and help lead concept development efforts for new missile and weapon systems. Opportunities include leading multidisciplinary teams to rapidly identify operational needs for strike and defense applications, translate those needs into mission and technology\-informed requirements, and guide the concept maturation. The work would involve interfacing with potential sponsors, services, COCOMs, and OGAs to understand and manage vehicle designs, vehicle and kill chain technology, and mission CONOPs to help them carry out their missions. The result of your work would be the identification of mission\-relevant R\&D, well\-defined requirements for new systems, and support to government investment decisions. The 5420 Strike Systems portfolio includes the Conventional Prompt Strike (CPS) deployed conventional weapon, the Submarine Launched Cruise Missile \- Nuclear (SLCM\-N) Nuclear tipped cruise missile, and an exciting array of R\&D proposals and programs.


On any given day, you may be called on to:


* Develop, advise, and manage requirements for hypersonic, ballistic, and cruise missiles both in the R\&D and Weapon Development space.
* Lead concept studies: shape the scope, develop success criteria, and direct technical approach; coordinate multidisciplinary teams.
* Engage with COCOMS, services, and the IC to understand gaps and identify potential solutions.
* Translate operational needs into requirements: define L0/L1 requirements, interfaces, constraints, and known unknowns.
* Work with peer Systems Engineers and SMEs across many Engineering disciplines
* Communicate results to sponsors and decision makers, both technical and non\-technical. This includes concise technical briefs, recommendations, and proposals (quads, one\-pagers, transition plans).

Due to the nature of the work, this candidate must be able to work onsite.


**Salary Range**
----------------

  

$117,500 \- $235,700


* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.


**Qualifications We Require**
-----------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5\) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q\-level security clearance and potentially SCI access.
**Qualifications We Desire**
----------------------------

  

The ideal Systems Engineer candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:


* Graduate degree in Engineering or a highly related field.
* Experience working with Nuclear Security Enterprise (NSE) laboratories and plants including Pantex, Kansas City National Security Campus (KCNSC), Lawrence Livermore Laboratory (LLNL) and Kansas City National Security Campus/New Mexico Operations (KCNSC/NMO)
* Experience working on Engineering design, qualification, production, or related modeling/simulation projects
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:


* Solid experience with Systems Engineering
* Experience working leading multi\-disciplinary teams with SMEs to develop requirements and concepts
* Experience working with COCOMS, services, and OGAs
* Experience with taking high\-level needs and deriving requirements, solutions, and a technical approach for those solutions
* Ability to communicate technical results to high\-level decision makers
* Ability to engage with potential funding sponsors and write proposals
* Ability to hold a Q and SCI clearances
* Current clearance holder
**About Our Team**
------------------

  

The Electrical Flight Systems Department 05424 provides integrated flight systems in the Strike Systems group within the Integrated Military Systems Program at Sandia. Mechanical and Avionics flight technologies are developed, integrated, and tested to provide flight solutions for missiles, launch systems, and hypersonic flight platforms. Typically, these systems support the DOD including Army, Navy, Air Force, and other Agencies. Center 5400 has successfully developed hypersonic systems for the nation and is extending our role on the national stage for both developmental and fieldable systems. Our programs cover a broad spectrum of applications;

new_jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer (Hardware & Firmware Design)
new_jobs.description:
**THIS IS AN ONSITE POSITION**

 **Summary**

* Parabit Systems, Inc., a leader in security, access control, and self\-service technology solutions, is seeking a highly motivated and hands\-on Embedded Systems Engineer to design and develop innovative products from concept through production. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong combination of hardware design, embedded firmware development, and system integration expertise who thrives in a fast\-paced product development environment.
* The successful candidate will be responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and support of embedded electronic systems deployed in real\-world applications across multiple industries. This position requires a practical engineer who can move seamlessly between hardware design, firmware development, prototype validation, manufacturing support, and field troubleshooting while maintaining a strong focus on quality, reliability, cybersecurity, and product performance.
* You will work closely with software developers, mechanical engineers, quality assurance, manufacturing, and service teams to deliver robust, reliable, and scalable products that meet customer and regulatory requirements.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of embedded hardware and firmware platforms for security, access control, sensing, and self\-service products.
* Define system architecture, hardware interfaces, communication protocols, microcontroller configurations, power distribution, signal conditioning, and overall embedded platform design.
* Design and develop embedded firmware using C/C\+\+ for microcontroller\-based systems, including control logic, communications, diagnostics, and device management functionality.
* Create electrical schematics, select components, perform engineering analysis , derating analyses, and conduct design reviews to ensure reliability, performance, and manufacturability.
* Provide instruction and guidance on necessary PCB layout requirements.
* Develop, test, and validate hardware and firmware designs throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Conduct hardware bring\-up debugging, and root\-cause analysis of system\-level issues.
* Review PCB layouts with emphasis on signal integrity, grounding, EMI/EMC mitigation, thermal management, power integrity, and design\-for\-manufacturing best practices.
* Implement secure coding principles and follow cybersecurity requirements in accordance with applicable standards, including NIST, FIPS, and ISO guidelines.
* Coordinate prototype builds, engineering validation testing, design verification, and product qualification activities.
* Support regulatory testing and compliance efforts, including FCC, CE, UL, EMC/EMI, RoHS, and related industry requirements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation .
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful product development, production launch, deployment, and ongoing product support.
* Evaluate new technologies, components, communication standards, and development tools to support future product initiatives.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in embedded systems design and firmware development.
* Proven experience developing products from concept through production release.
* Strong hands\-on experience in electronic circuit design, hardware integration, and board\-level troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in embedded firmware development using C and C\+\+.
* Experience with Python and Visual Basic is desirable.
* Strong understanding of microcontroller architectures and peripherals including GPIO, ADCs, DACs, SPI, IC, UART.
* Experience working with PIC and/or STM32 ARM Cortex microcontrollers preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics, PCB layouts, bills of materials (BOMs), datasheets, timing diagrams, and interface specifications.
* Experience using advanced testing equipment; oscilloscopes, analyzers, etc.
* Strong understanding of embedded networking and communication protocols, including:
	+ TCP/IP
	+ UDP
	+ Ethernet
	+ RS\-232/RS\-485
	+ Bluetooth
	+ NFC
	+ USB
	+ OSDP
	+ Z\-Wave
* Experience with Altium Designer, KiCad, or other advanced EDA tools.
* Familiarity with EMC/EMI design practices, safety and other regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience integrating embedded systems with cloud\-based platforms, IoT frameworks, or remote device management solutions is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases for diagnostics, configuration management, reporting, or device monitoring is a plus.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results in a fast\-paced development environment.

 **Why Join Parabit Systems?**

* At Parabit Systems, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our engineers work on cutting\-edge technologies that support critical security, self\-service, and automation solutions deployed worldwide. We offer a collaborative environment where talented professionals have the opportunity to lead challenging projects, influence product direction, and make a meaningful impact on the success of our business and our customers.
* Parabit Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 **To Apply**

* Submit your resume to Recruiting@Parabit.com. We look forward to learning how your skills and experience can contribute to the continued growth and innovation of Parabit Systems.

new_jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Job Title:** Scientist, Systems Engineering
