**Job Description:**  

The L3Harris space superiority and imaging systems engineering department is seeking a systems engineer to join our team and support programs that we have recently won. * Candidate with an active Top Secret/SCI clearance is highly desirable.

  

**Preferred Additional Skills:**  

* Holds an active Secret or Top Secret/SCI clearance.
* Technical Subject Matter Expertise in optical, electro\-optical, electrical, mechanical, electromechanical, or equivalent engineering discipline.
* Relevant experience with the design, manufacture, integration, test and sell\-off of space\-based EO/IR subsystems.

Systems Engineer / Senior Systems Engineer

**Location:** Rome, NY

**Travel:** Up to 30% (CONUS; occasional OCONUS opportunities)

**Security Clearance:** Must be eligible to obtain and maintain the U.S. Government security clearance required for the position. Current U.S. Department of War Secret clearance preferred.

**Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. CoreVault Solutions does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

About CoreVault Solutions

CoreVault Solutions is a growing defense technology company delivering mission\-critical software and integrated operational capabilities for the U.S. Department of War and other government customers.

Our work spans command and control systems, air domain awareness, unmanned systems integration, geospatial visualization, tactical networking, sensor integration, cloud infrastructure, and operational decision support. We build and deploy complete mission systems that support real\-world operations in defense, public safety, and critical infrastructure environments.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and seeing their work deployed in operational environments.

Position Summary

CoreVault Solutions is seeking a Systems Engineer or Senior Systems Engineer to support the design, integration, deployment, and sustainment of mission\-critical systems for Department of War and other government customers.

This position works across software, hardware, networking, cloud infrastructure, sensors, tactical communications, and operational systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across technical disciplines, troubleshooting complex systems, supporting field deployments, and collaborating directly with software engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, customers, and mission partners.

Candidates may be considered at the Systems Engineer or Senior Systems Engineer level based on experience, technical capability, and qualifications.

Responsibilities

* Design, integrate, configure, test, deploy, and sustain complex mission systems.
* Integrate software applications with servers, networks, sensors, radios, tactical systems, and other external systems.
* Configure and maintain Linux and Windows servers, virtual machines, containers, and associated infrastructure.
* Support Kubernetes, Helm, containerized applications, and cloud or on\-premises deployment environments.
* Configure and troubleshoot system networking, connectivity, ports, services, certificates, and interfaces.
* Support integration of sensors, unmanned systems, tactical radios, TAK\-based systems, and other operational technologies.
* Perform system integration, verification, troubleshooting, and acceptance testing.
* Support system hardening, STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity activities in coordination with cybersecurity personnel.
* Develop and maintain system architecture, configuration, installation, test, troubleshooting, and sustainment documentation.
* Participate in site surveys, equipment staging, system installation, demonstrations, exercises, training events, and operational deployments.
* Troubleshoot issues across hardware, software, networking, operating systems, and external interfaces.
* Work directly with customers and technical partners to identify requirements and resolve operational issues.
* Support configuration management and accountability of government and company equipment.
* Assist with equipment receiving, inventory, purchasing coordination, and asset tracking as required.
* Occasionally support QuickBooks\-based purchasing or inventory activities and implementation/use of government\-approved inventory or asset\-management systems.
* Support other engineering and program activities as required in a small, rapidly growing technical organization.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 3\+ years of relevant experience for Systems Engineer consideration; greater depth and demonstrated technical leadership expected for Senior Systems Engineer consideration.
* Experience integrating and troubleshooting complex technical systems.
* Working knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, DNS, ports, and network services.
* Experience with Linux and/or Windows server environments.
* Ability to troubleshoot across multiple technical domains rather than focusing on a single component.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.
* Ability and willingness to travel to customer and operational locations.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain the U.S. Government security clearance required for the position.

Preferred Qualifications

* Current U.S. Department of War Secret or higher security clearance.
* Experience supporting Department of War or other federal government systems.
* Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker/OCI, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, GovCloud, or other cloud environments.
* Experience with tactical networking, TAK/ATAK, sensors, radar, RF systems, ADS\-B, UAS, or air domain awareness systems.
* Experience with STIGs, ACAS, RMF, or other government cybersecurity requirements.
* Experience supporting field deployments, military exercises, demonstrations, or operational systems.
* Experience with configuration management, technical documentation, inventory, or government property accountability.

Benefits

CoreVault Solutions offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and floating holidays

new_jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.  

We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/30/2026\.  



  

Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. See more information on our benefits here: U.S. Employee Benefits \| Accenture

new_jobs.title: Senior Power System Simulation & Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?



Transform the everyday with us!



Siemens is seeking a Senior Protection, Automation \& Real\-Time Simulation Engineer to support the development and growth of advanced power system solutions for utility, industrial, microgrid, renewable energy, and data center applications.

**Job Title: Controls Engineer**

**Experience : 3\+yrs**  
**Visa: Only USC**

**Hybrid position in Michigan**

**Job Summary**

Controls Hardware Designer is responsible for architecting, designing, and validating electrical control systems for automated machinery and industrial processes. This role focuses on panel layouts, power distribution, and integrating programmable controllers, safety systems, and industrial communication networks

Core Responsibilities

**Control Panel Design: Create comprehensive electrical schematics and physical layout blueprints for industrial control panels and enclosures.**

**Power Distribution: Design low\-to\-medium voltage power distribution systems, ensuring correct sizing for circuit breakers, fuses, transformers, and contactors.**

**Component Integration: Select and integrate Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), servo systems, and industrial sensors.**

**Safety System Design: Architect failsafe safety circuits incorporating safety relays, light curtains, E\-stops, and interlocks to protect factory operators.**

**Network Architecture: Design industrial network topologies utilizing protocols like EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus, and EtherCAT.**

**Field Wiring \& Routing: Specify cable types, conduit sizing, and terminal block arrangements for field wiring between control panels and machinery.**

**Testing \& Commissioning: Perform factory acceptance testing (FAT) and provide occasional on\-site support for equipment commissioning and troubleshooting.**

**Required Technical Skills**

**Industrial CAD Software: High proficiency in specialized electrical design tools, specifically EPLAN Electric P8 or AutoCAD Electrical.**

**Regulatory Codes: Deep working knowledge of industrial safety and electrical standards, notably NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 79, and UL 508A (or IEC 60204 for European markets).**

**Motor Control: Mastery of motor control circuits, including direct\-on\-line starters, soft starters, and VFD configurations.**

**Short Circuit Calculations: Ability to calculate short\-circuit current ratings (SCCR) and perform voltage drop calculations.**

**Soft Skills \& Environment**

**On\-Site Adaptability: Comfort working in active manufacturing environments, assembly floors, or construction zones during project deployment.**

**Collaboration: Ability to collaborate closely with Controls/PLC Programmers, Mechanical Engineers, and electrical technicians.**

**Vendor Management: Experience communicating with component suppliers and panel fabrication shops to ensure parts meet specifications.**

**Education \& Experience Qualifications**

**Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.**

**Familiarity with GM GCCH and Ford GVOSS standards.**

**Experience: 3\+ years of experience designing electrical control systems specifically for industrial automation, robotics, or system integration.**

Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R\-EGI Program**

  


**Position Overview**


IS4S is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test software for the R\-EGI program. R\-EGI brings together GPS/GNSS, inertial sensors, and other navigation capabilities to support resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) for military aircraft.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable developing C/C\+\+ software on embedded Linux systems, bringing up software on hardware, and solving problems at the boundary between software, sensors, and avionics. The engineer will work closely with systems, navigation, hardware, and test teams through integration and qualification.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ software for navigation processing, device interfaces, middleware, and system control.
* Develop and debug software on embedded Linux platforms, including interactions with device drivers, operating system services, and hardware interfaces.
* Integrate GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, and other navigation inputs; work with navigation engineers to implement and evaluate sensor\-fusion and estimation functions.
* Diagnose system\-level issues involving software timing, sensor data, electrical interfaces, and hardware behavior.
* Support hardware bring\-up and software integration in laboratory and system integration lab environments.
* Develop automated tests, diagnostic tools, and scripts that improve software integration, regression testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including evaluation of performance when GPS is degraded or unavailable.
* Translate system and interface requirements into software designs, test procedures, and verification evidence.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect resolution, and software releases.
* Support technical reviews and program milestones, including PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification activities.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help the team resolve complex embedded software issues.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 8 or more years of embedded software engineering experience.
* Strong C and C\+\+ proficiency for embedded or real\-time applications.
* Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on embedded Linux systems.
* Experience working with hardware interfaces, device drivers, or low\-level software and diagnosing hardware/software integration issues.
* Experience using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or debuggers to troubleshoot embedded systems.
* Experience with software requirements, interface definitions, verification, and configuration management.
* Experience with Git, cross\-compilation toolchains, and automated builds.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with military aviation PNT systems, GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, inertial navigation systems, or integrated GPS/INS solutions.
* Experience with navigation estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, or operation in GPS\-degraded and GPS\-denied environments.
* Experience with aircraft avionics interfaces such as MIL\-STD\-1553 or ARINC 429\.
* Experience developing and integrating systems that use modern embedded processing platforms, such as the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+ MPSoC.
* Experience with real\-time Linux, VxWorks, INTEGRITY, or another real\-time operating system.
* Experience with software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system integration labs.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis, or diagnostic tools.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, interface diagrams, and hardware documentation.
* Experience supporting formal software qualification or airworthiness activities.
* Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.

Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits


Dynamic and collaborative work environment


Employee ownership

Group term life insurance

new_jobs.title: Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Automation Engineer provides technical and application support for Triad Technologies’ automation and motion control products and solutions. This position works closely with the Engineering team, Sales, Operations, suppliers, and customers to understand application requirements and develop effective technical solutions.  


The Automation Engineer supports product selection, system design, programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, documentation, and training. While the role includes customer interaction and occasional field support, the primary focus is providing technical expertise and engineering support as part of Triad’s Engineering team. This is a full\-time, Monday–Friday position.  


Provide technical and application support for automation and motion control products, systems, and solutions.  
Work with Engineering, Sales, and customers to understand application requirements and recommend appropriate products and system solutions.  
Assist with application planning, system architecture, product selection, hardware and software specifications, and network layouts.  
Support the development of technical solutions and quotations based on customer requirements and industry standards.  
Provide programming, configuration, commissioning, startup, and troubleshooting support for PLCs, motion controllers, HMIs, and industrial networks.  
Assist with the design, implementation, and improvement of electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum, and controls systems used in industrial automation applications.  
Provide technical support to Sales, Assembly, Field Service Technicians, and other internal teams throughout the design, installation, commissioning, and service process.  
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including electrical schematics, circuit diagrams, mechanical layouts, and system documentation.  
Utilize SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and other engineering and technical software as required.  
Perform engineering calculations, component sizing, and application analysis to support system and equipment specifications.  
Assist with customer and internal training related to automation, motion control, programming, and software.  
Support installation, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting activities as needed.  
Maintain current knowledge of automation, motion control, controls, networking, and related technologies.  
Other duties as assigned.  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required for the Automation Engineer title. Candidates with an associate degree or two\-year technical degree in automation, electrical engineering technology, mechanical engineering technology, controls, or a related field may be considered for an Automation Specialist title.  
Candidates with relevant technical education, internship, co\-op, or hands\-on industry experience will be considered. Relevant experience may include industrial automation, controls, motion control, electrical systems, robotics, machine design, or system integration.  
Working knowledge of automation and motion control products, systems, and applications.  
Familiarity with PLCs, motion controllers, HMIs, industrial networks, and related automation technologies.  
Experience with PLC or motion controller programming and troubleshooting is preferred.  
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, circuit diagrams, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.  
Experience with Microsoft Office required. Experience with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar engineering software is preferred.  
Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
Ability to learn and support multiple motion control and programming platforms.  
Ability to work effectively with customers, coworkers, suppliers, and business partners.  
Ability and willingness to provide technical support outside of normal business hours when needed.  
Must have a valid driver’s license and good driving record.  
Must be willing and able to travel to customer locations, including occasional overnight travel, as needed.

$121744\.58\-$210984\.64
  
### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you want to work on cutting\-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a **Senior Anti\-Tamper Engineer specializing in microelectronics**, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division, DoD Anti\-Tamper (AT) Executive Agent Field Program Office (AFLCMC/WAG\-AT) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.  

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active U.S. Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI.**  

WAG\-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.  

In this role, you will:  

* Assess microelectronics, integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips used in military equipment
* Using experience with lab equipment, assess and exploit circuity, processors, and memory chips and implement methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Collaborate with Service labs and industry partners in assessing current and future weapons systems’ susceptibilities and vulnerabilities to an adversary’s exploitation; evaluate and develop friendly forces lab exploitation capabilities of US weapons systems’ electronic circuitry
* Using expertise in DoD, AF and common engineering and scientific principles, criteria, and procedures; improve planned and existing weapon system manufacture, operations, re\-manufacture and de\-militarization operations and oversight
* Interface with DoD Anti\-Tamper Evaluation Teams to evaluate current designs and identify vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to foreign and adversary exploitation
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Develop plans to assess security features of Government Off\-The\-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off\-The Shelf (COTS) components for CPI susceptibility/vulnerability to exploitation and reverse engineering
* Assist efforts to improve US weapons system anti\-tamper/anti\-exploitation design, development, manufacturing, training, and sustainment
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long\-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:  

* An active DoW Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Program (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* A Bachelor’s Degree in engineering from an ABET accredited program plus 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
	+ OR a Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a Bachelor’s in engineering from an ABET accredited program and a minimum of 8 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum of 3 years of SAP and/or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* The ability to travel up to 10%.

  

Additional desired experience and skills:


* A Bachelor’s in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from an ABET accredited program
* DoW Anti\-Tamper and program protection planning knowledge and experience
* Familiar with electrical and electronic circuits, Institute for Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) standard communication circuits, electro\-mechanical interface design, and software control of electronic circuits

  

If you are interested in supporting and working with our Air Force and other military branches and a dedicated Serco team, then submit your application now for immediate consideration. It only takes a few minutes!

  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  

  

To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/what\-we\-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco\-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800\-628\-6458, option 1\. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.

**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.

new_jobs.description:
Electrical / Automation Engineer (Experienced Professional)
**Build a Career That Matters with One of the World’s Most Respected Employers!**


\- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \-


**THE OPPORTUNITY**


*This opportunity is in Ardmore, OK. Our Michelin Plant produces high\-quality, long\-lasting passenger and light\-truck tires for companies like Ford, Toyota, Costco and Discount tires. Our pioneering spirit and teamwork allowed us to be the first Uniroyal\-Goodrich plant to produce the Michelin premium brand tires. Our community of 1,400 employees take pride in their purpose of connecting their tires to the customer. Ardmore is a small city in southern Oklahoma, where you can enjoy the natural beauty, hiking, fishing, and outdoor sports at the scenic Lake Murray State Park. Our campus features amenities including a company gym, trademark store, and health center. We are driven to inspire our team to achieve both long\-term career and personal goals. Caring for our people, community, customers, and company are at the center of who we are.*

  

  

Michelin has an immediate opening for an **Electrical / Automation Engineer** to lead, design, and implement electrical and automation solutions to improve our performance in safety, quality, productivity, delivery, cost, and innovation. Michelin’s purpose is to support everyone’s right to move freely to find their better way forward. Innovation and performance open mobility opportunities to people who were limited geographically or economically before. Entry level training is provided by Michelin and will include formal classes and on\-the\-job mentoring under an experienced area expert. If respect for people, teamwork and trust are some values you live by you should consider joining us, the Worldwide leader in Tires!


Michelin is a global tire manufacturing company in the middle of an exciting digital transformation, with a vision of our Factory of the Future using advanced robotic technology and data\-driven engineering solutions. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Automation Engineer to join our Manufacturing Engineering team in Ardmore, OK. This engineer will play a crucial role in designing and implementing automation solutions that drive efficiency and productivity across our manufacturing operations. You will be responsible for leading projects from conception to completion, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to develop innovative solutions that leverage advanced technologies such as smart material handling, robotics, AGV, ASRS, vision systems, machine learning and artificial intelligence.

  

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**


* Conduct pre\-studies, prototypes, and pilots to capture business requirements and determine the best solutions in terms of costs/benefits, deadlines, risks, and functional capabilities.
* Design, build, and lead implementation projects to improve plant performance by replacing outdated systems, improving existing equipment, or adding new innovations to make progress.
* Implement and monitor actions necessary to mitigate risks (calculations, simulations, tests, etc.)
* Implement best practices for automation design and development, including worldwide sharing of best practices.
* Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers, vendors and contractors.

Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


The **Senior AI Platform Engineer** will stand up and operate a bare\-metal container platform, support a feasibility assessment of all platform technologies, and drive the transition towards infrastructure\-as\-code managed provisioning using Terraform and Ansible. This individual will work in a bare\-metal\-first environment while actively reducing reliance on manual installs over time, and will support core platform services and OCONUS bootstrap activities.

  

**Other Responsibilities Include:**


* Deploy, configure, and operate large language models (LLMs), and integrate approved frontier AI models and services into enterprise environments
* Optimize model inference and deployment configurations to improve response times, throughput, and GPU/memory utilization while maintaining output quality
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain model\-serving environments, including model updates, API connectivity, and supporting infrastructure
* Transition platform provisioning from manual/bare\-metal installs toward a fully IaC\-managed model
* Install, configure, and operate bare\-metal OpenShift (or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes distribution) clusters
* Design and implement infrastructure\-as\-code provisioning using Terraform and Ansible for platform and VM orchestration
* Support the objective feasibility assessment of OpenShift versus Spectro Cloud, documenting licensing tradeoffs, operability, and long\-term sustainability considerations
* Deploy and support core platform services including authoritative DNS (e.g., PowerDNS)
* Implement and enforce STIGs and cybersecurity compliance requirements on platform infrastructure
* Monitor platform health, performance, and capacity using observability tools; manage platform logging and alerting
* Support OCONUS hardware bootstrap activities including physical hardware installation and configuration
* Document platform architecture, configuration decisions, and operational procedures
##### **Qualifications**

* Minimum of 12 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 10 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 7 years with Ph.D.
* Experience with platform/systems/integration engineering
* Hands\-on Kubernetes\-based container platform experience
* US Citizenship
* Active DoD Secret clearance
* DoD 8570/8140 compliant certification
* Practical experience deploying and operating AI models, with a foundational understanding of inference and performance tuning
* Hands\-on experience deploying and administering OpenShift (or another enterprise Kubernetes distribution) on bare metal
* Infrastructure\-as\-code proficiency, specifically Terraform and Ansible, for provisioning and configuration management
* Working knowledge of virtualization/cloud orchestration platforms (Spectro Cloud, VMware, or equivalent)
* Understanding of container platform architecture: networking (CNI), storage (CSI), cluster security, and lifecycle management
* Ability to document platform architecture, licensing tradeoffs, and operational considerations
* Strong Linux administration skills (RHEL)
* Must have regular/recurring physical access to a DISA SIPR\-accredited facility
* Working understanding of agentic platform modeling/hosting/services

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent writing and grammatical skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* Experience with GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for platform configuration management
* Experience bootstrapping platforms in disconnected or OCONUS environments including physical hardware installation

new_jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers \[air\-cooled and water\-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.
  

  

Key job responsibilities (optional but highly recommended)  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
  

  

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
  

  

Develop BMS \& EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  

  

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
  

  

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  

  

Participate in AWS global on\-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in\-service data centers.
  

  

Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.
  

  

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  

  

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
  

  

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  

  

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  

  

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
  

  

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in\-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.
  

  

A day in the life  

As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).
  

  

About the team  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  

  

Why AWS
  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  

  

Diverse Experiences
  

  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Work/Life Balance
  

  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  

  

Inclusive Team Culture

new_jobs.description:
Position Description: ANPC is a global supplier of precision approach guidance and area surveillance solutions aimed at improving the safety and capacity of civil and military aviation for customers on all seven continents. Our transponder\-based solutions are designed to serve airfields where others cannot. We are a team of extraordinary professionals working together to perform an important mission to uniquely serve airports with terrain, obstacles and other challenges that no other business can provide.  

  

**Job Summary**
As the Systems Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of talented engineers in the design, development, and integration of mission\-critical systems for the Aerospace industry. This role bridges strategic technical leadership and people management, driving our product development lifecycle from initial concept to formal certification.  

You will be responsible for empowering your team, establishing robust engineering methodologies, and ensuring our hardware and software systems are high\-performing, safe, and fully certifiable.  

We are recruiting for candidates willing to live and work in the Hood River, Oregon area. This is not a remote eligible position. **Essential Job Functions*** Lead, mentor, and grow a high\-performing team of systems engineers. Allocate resources, manage workloads, and foster a collaborative, continuous\-improvement culture.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of robust requirements using ANPC’s management processes for safety\-critical systems. Define internal systems engineering processes and optimize workflows.
* Guide comprehensive system safety assessments to determine safety assurance levels (DALs). Ensure all team deliverables align with strict aerospace safety objectives and regulatory standards.
* Build the strategy for integrated software and hardware architectures. Lead high\-level system partitioning, interface definitions, and complex use\-case development across programs.
* Oversee top\-down and bottom\-up traceability from requirements to final verification. Review and approve system verification test plans, execution strategies, and documentation.
* As the primary technical liaison between systems engineering and other multi\-disciplinary engineering functions, ensure system and high\-level requirements are properly allocated and aligned.
* Provide direct support and leadership during formal certification activities, acting as a key point of contact for regulatory compliance.
* Partner with other engineering managers to help them craft well\-formed low\-level requirements appropriate for their discipline.
* Partner with customer\-facing executives to solidify big, audacious, and sometimes ambiguous statements of fact about the future state of our products.

* At least 7\+ years of professional systems engineering experience in the aerospace or defense sector, with a minimum of 2\+ years in a formal leadership, supervisory, or management role.
* Proven professional experience navigating product certifications; FAA certification experience is highly preferred.

 **Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics*** Deep understanding of the systems engineering V\-model lifecycle and safety\-critical system development.
* Proven ability to oversee the partitioning of complex hardware and software architectures.

* Practical experience managing programs to specific software/hardware/safety development guidelines, specifically:

new_jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Lockheed Martin Rotary \& Mission Systems seeks a highly skilled Field Systems Engineer to sustain a large‑scale, ground‑based, software‑defined radio‑frequency (RF) system located overseas. The installation consists of parabolic‑dish antennas, high‑power amplifiers, and a cloud‑hosted application stack that integrates RF, hardware, software, network, and IT subsystems.


The engineer will focus on the sustainment of the integrated mission‑application software and the physical transmit/receive RF paths that deliver mission capabilities. Required expertise includes Linux‑based mission‑software operation and familiarity with RF test equipment. The role is embedded with government operators, providing day‑to‑day technical support, preventive and corrective maintenance, and ensuring operational availability.

**Work Environment**

* Working at height inside large antenna structures is frequently required.
* Shift work or offset hours may be needed to de‑conflict activities or align with CONUS time zones.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **Operation Support**
	+ Oversee system operation by government operators and document subsystem availability per the Mission Essential Subsystem List (MESL).
	+ Implement RF‑link health and application‑availability monitoring methods.
	+ Generate periodic status reports.
* **Technical Oversight**
	+ Provide on‑site subject‑matter expertise for both mission‑application software and RF/antenna hardware.
	+ Collaborate with the factory on O\&M manuals, incorporating field lessons and driving continuous‑improvement updates.
* **Preventive Maintenance**
	+ Receive and integrate scheduled mission‑software deployments.
	+ Execute regression testing for new releases or routine patches to maintain mission‑capability availability.
* **Corrective Maintenance**
	+ Detect, isolate, and recover from faults across software and hardware domains.
	+ Perform cross‑domain troubleshooting, document defects, and complete root‑cause corrective‑action reports.
* **System Modifications**
	+ Act as system integrator for upgrades and modifications.
	+ Work with the factory on Modification Test Plans, execute test procedures, and supply data for Modification Test Reports.
* **Software As‑Built Configuration Management**
	+ Track deployed software versions, including subcontractor firmware.
	+ Synchronize configuration changes with the factory GitLab repository.
* **Hardware As‑Built Configuration Management**
	+ Record hardware replacements in the defect‑report and maintenance‑management system.
	+ Verify as‑built hardware baselines against drawings and schematics, especially during remove/replace or new‑install activities.
	+ Communicate redlines to the factory for baseline updates.
* **Reporting**
	+ Produce daily reports, mission logs, regression‑test data, and defect reports.
	+ Deliver data to satisfy customer CDRLs, O\&M dashboards, internal status tracking, and cross‑functional technical collaboration.
* **Business Rhythms**
	+ Support regular business‑rhythm forums to enable planning, status tracking, and rapid issue resolution across LM, subcontractors, and government stakeholders.
**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* BS in Engineering STEM field
* Security Clearance required Prior to Start: Top Secret
* 5 years of Systems engineering integration and test for end\-to\-end hardware/software integrated systems
* T\-shaped professional with deep expertise in one of the disciplines listed under Desired Skills as well as cross\-disciplinary foundation across others
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to generate clear technical briefings and reports for senior leadership or government stakeholders.
* Extended deployment in OCONUS location
**Desired Skills**
------------------



Experience in one or several of the disciplines below

* RF and antenna systems
* Software defined radio and signal processing
* Cloud\-based infrastructure including virtualized and containerized environments
* Hardware engineering including drawings, schematics and bill of materials
* Software engineering including integration of complex software systems
* Cyber security systems architecture
* Sustainment engineering and training
* Reliability Maintainability and Availability engineering
* Mission planning and command and control
* Tools – Atlassian JIRA/Confluence, Gitlab
* Information System – Linux, Bash, OpenShift
* Equipment \- oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and optical link testers
**Pay Information**


Full\-Time Salary Range: $95900\.00 \- $178100\.00

**About Us**

  

Cleaveland/Price specializes in the design and manufacture of high voltage disconnect switches and switch automation products. The products that we offer are unique in design, and some include patented features. Products have been developed and tested in accordance with IEEE, ANSI, and NEMA standards for high voltage equipment. They are primarily used by investor\-owned and public electric utilities and large industrial operations in substation, distribution, transmission, and generation applications.




All company operations take place in a modern 218,300 sq. ft. multi\-site facility situated on 20 acres east of Trafford, PA. The facility houses virtually all resources for product realization, including engineering, supply chain, parts fabrication, electro\-mechanical assembly, and testing. Fabrication capabilities include laser and plasma cutting, CNC machining, CNC punching, and automated bending and forming. The company also utilizes specialized processes, such as MIG and TIG welding, friction welding, silver and tin electroplating, and silver brazing.




Cleaveland/Price’s employee\-focused culture plays an important role in being recognized by the Pittsburgh Post\-Gazette as being a Top Workplace in the Pittsburgh region. The company is driven by the caring people that we employ: the heart and soul of the Cleaveland/Price product line.

  




**Your Goal**

  

As a member of the Electronic Design group, you will be responsible for providing hardware\-based solutions for electronic products covering the complete product lifecycle. This will include working on new product offerings, identifying and correcting design issues in existing products, finding solutions for part obsolescence, or creating test systems for the manufacturing process.

  




**Your Responsibilities**

  

With minimal direction, you will:

* Develop, simulate, prototype, and test analog and digital circuitry
* Design printed circuit board using best practices and works with contract manufacturer to ensure manufacturability
* Work with mechanical designers or engineers to development packaging solutions and create drawings to include relevant mechanical assembly details
* Utilize standard electronics laboratory equipment to test and troubleshoot new and existing designs
* Work with external laboratories to complete regulatory compliance testing
* Support development collaboration, support design reviews, and follow internal engineering control processes
* Investigate of technical problems and the creation of procedures, processes, and corrective actions to avoid recurrences
* Provide guidance to less experienced engineers and facilitate training as needed
* Complete other tasks as assigned
  

**Your Background**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field from an ABET accredited program
* Experience with analog and digital circuit design
* Experience with circuit design and layout software, such as Altium
* Experience with circuit simulation software

* Knowledge of three\-phase power systems preferred

Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal.

**Job Title:** Senior Perception Engineer \| Sensors, Firmware \& Drivers

**Department:** Software

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Location:** Houston, TX

**Travel:** 10%

**Who We Are**
==============


Persona AI is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material\-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff.


We are backed by leading strategic and financial investors and engaged with global industrial leaders across Korea, Japan, the United States, and Singapore. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale.

**Why Join Persona AI?**
========================

* We offer competitive compensation, a performance\-based bonus, 99% employer covered medical benefits, early\-stage equity, competitive PTO, and a company\-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd.
* You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction.
* Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning.

**About the Role**
==================


As a Senior Perception Engineer focused on Sensors, Firmware \& Drivers, you'll own everything between a photon hitting a sensor and the algorithm that acts on it. You'll bring up new imaging and depth sensors from first register read to first light, and write the V4L2 drivers and zero\-copy pipelines that move their data on NVIDIA Jetson. You'll also build the time synchronization that keeps cameras, lidar, IMU, and joint state aligned.


This is a hands\-on role. You'll review sensor boards and harnesses with EE, work through errata with silicon vendors, and debug with a scope in hand. You'll qualify hardware for the real world: welding arcs, heat, vibration, and heavy EMI from industrial equipment. You'll also build the calibration and validation infrastructure that proves it all works.


If you enjoy first light on new hardware, care about microseconds, and want to be the team's go\-to authority on what the sensor stack can deliver, this role is for you.

**What You Will Be Doing**
==========================

* Bring up new imaging and depth sensors end to end: I2C/SPI enumeration, register maps, GMSL2/GMSL3 and FPD\-Link serializer/deserializer configuration, CSI\-2 lane mapping, and first light on target hardware.
* Write and maintain V4L2 / MIPI CSI\-2 camera drivers and device tree overlays for NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Orin, Thor), including kernel work against the Jetson Linux BSP.
* Build low\-latency, zero\-copy sensor ingest and pre\-processing pipelines in NVIDIA Holoscan, GStreamer, and CUDA \| ISP tuning, debayer, rectification, format conversion with a hard budget on glass\-to\-algorithm latency.
* Own multi\-sensor time synchronization: PTP/gPTP, hardware trigger distribution, exposure\-to\-timestamp accounting, and drift characterization across cameras, lidar, IMU, and robot joint state.
* Partner with EE on schematic and layout review for sensor boards, GMSL coax/harness design, power sequencing, and connector selection; debug with a scope, logic analyzer, and thermal camera in hand.
* Characterize and qualify sensors for the real environment: welding\-arc dynamic range, IR interference, vibration, ingress, temperature soak, and EMI from high\-current equipment.
* Build the calibration and validation infrastructure \| intrinsics/extrinsics, HDR and exposure behavior, automated bench tests, CI on real hardware.
* Work directly with vendors and silicon partners on errata, firmware revisions, and early access to new parts.
* Support the perception and autonomy teams as the authority on what the sensor stack can and cannot deliver.

**What We Are Looking For:**
============================

* 5\+ years building embedded sensor, firmware, or driver systems in robotics, autonomous vehicles, aerospace, or comparable hardware\-heavy domains.
* Strong C/C\+\+ and Python; comfortable in the Linux kernel.
* Bonus: Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms, Jetson Linux BSP, device tree, kernel module development, flashing and board support work.
* Demonstrated camera bring\-up experience: MIPI CSI\-2, V4L2, GMSL2/GMSL3 (Maxim/ADI) or FPD\-Link, I2C/SPI sensor configuration.
* Experience shipping software that runs on hardware in the field, with the instincts about failure modes that comes from having done it.

**Bonus Skills:**
=================

* NVIDIA Holoscan SDK, DeepStream, or CUDA/GPU\-accelerated streaming pipelines.
* Time synchronization across heterogeneous sensors (PTP, hardware trigger design).
* ISP tuning, HDR imaging, or low\-level camera sensor characterization.
* Lidar, radar, ToF, or event\-camera integration.

**The Role**  

The Compute Systems Software team is a dynamic and fast\-paced team that designs, develops, and maintains the foundational embedded software platform for SDV solutions, including drivers, operating systems, BSPs, and software stacks. We are developing a world\-class GM experience for our customers and driving real change at one of the most iconic automakers on the planet. Our team delivers platform solutions for high\-end SoCs that enable infotainment, ADAS, and other high\-compute applications. We offer challenging positions for passionate professionals looking to advance their careers and be part of an organization focused on innovation, speed, and business value.
  

The Display Software team is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to work on display solutions for high\-compute System\-on\-Chip (SoC) platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in embedded systems design and development, particularly with Linux\-based display systems, device drivers, and display hardware. The candidate will work with engineering teams across software services, hardware teams, and SoC vendors to build and manage a shared vehicle compute platform.

Distinguished Technologist \- Principal Architect, Platform Security and Firmware Systems
**Description \-**

HP is seeking a senior technical leader to serve as a lead architect for hardware rooted Platform Root of Trust for HP's commercial PC platform. In this role, you will be responsible for envisioning, defining, and driving the architecture of hardware, firmware, software, and cloud\-integrated security capabilities that protect HP commercial PCs from current and emerging threats. You will also work across the hardware and security architecture teams, collaborate with HP's Security Research Labs, Firmware (BIOS) team, our security business that creates and deploys industry leading enterprise security and manageability solutions, product management, manufacturing, supply chain, customer enablement, and field organizations to create cohesive system solutions that deliver unique customer value.


This position requires deep expertise in embedded systems, platform firmware, hardware, security, device manageability, and PC system architecture. The role also requires the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into customer\-relevant value propositions and to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.  



  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as principal architect for HP Endpoint Security Controller roadmap, associated hardware and firmware based capabilities, cryptographic identity, attestation, secure communication, event logging, and future controller generations.
* Define and evolve HP Sure Start architecture and related firmware resilience capabilities, including hardware\-enforced firmware authenticity, recovery, update, and protection mechanisms.
* Drive secure BIOS and firmware configuration management strategies, including HP Sure Admin ecosystem capabilities, key management, zero\-touch provisioning, customer deployment models, and integration with enterprise management tools.
* Lead cross\-functional architecture definition across hardware, BIOS, embedded controller firmware, diagnostics, cloud services, client software, manageability tools, product management, and customer\-facing teams.
* Anticipate emerging threats and technology shifts, including quantum\-safe cryptography, platform attestation, supply\-chain security, physical tamper resistance, peripheral authentication, and new non\-volatile memory architectures.
* Partner with silicon vendors, operating\-system providers, standards organizations, internal and external security research teams, and internal product teams to influence and align platform security direction.
* Support customer briefings, field escalations, competitive positioning, technical marketing, training events, and executive communications related to HP commercial PC platform security.
* Create specifications, proof\-of\-concepts, validation tools, scripts, demonstrations, and reference implementations that accelerate adoption of new security capabilities.
Mentor engineers and technical leaders by sharing architectural context, reviewing designs, developing talent, and helping teams make practical tradeoffs among security, cost, schedule, customer experience, and portfolio impact.  
* 

  

**Education \& Experience Recommended**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Extensive experience in PC, embedded, firmware, hardware, or platform system architecture, preferably in commercial client systems or security\-sensitive devices.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions that span hardware, firmware, software, cloud services, manufacturing, and customer deployment environments.
* Deep technical understanding of BIOS/UEFI, embedded controllers, secure boot, firmware update and recovery flows, cryptographic signing, PKI based device identity, attestation, and secure configuration management.
* Experience defining product requirements, writing technical specifications, driving proof\-of\-concepts, and influencing roadmap decisions across multiple engineering teams.
* Ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to executive, engineering, customer, sales, and field audiences.
Proven ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization and to resolve ambiguity across competing business, technical, and customer priorities.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Experience with hardware based roots of trust, platform certificates, DICE/SPDM concepts, supply\-chain assurance, quantum\-safe cryptography, secure element or embedded security controller identity, and compliance or certification frameworks.
* Experience with enterprise endpoint manageability platforms such as Intune, SCCM, device\-management consoles, or cloud\-based key management services.
* Hands\-on capability with scripting or development tools such as PowerShell, C\#, Python, Java, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, or similar environments.
* Experience with customer\-facing technical briefings, sales enablement, competitive analysis, standards participation, patent development, or external security ecosystem collaboration.
Familiarity with commercial PC platform architecture, silicon vendor security technologies, Windows platform security, docking, peripheral security, battery authentication, telemetry, and right\-to\-repair considerations.  
* 

  

**Critical Technical Domains**
------------------------------

  

* HP Endpoint Security Controller architecture, roadmap definition, cryptographic identity, attestation evidence, enhanced logging, and next\-generation hardware requirements.
* HP Sure Start and firmware resilience, including hardware\-enforced firmware authenticity, recovery, update protection, and quantum\-safe firmware protection.
* HP Sure Admin and secure BIOS settings management, including key management, zero\-touch provisioning, smart card or YubiKey authentication concept

new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Peraton supports the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) mission to deliver timely, reliable care and benefits to America's Veterans by engineering, operating, and modernizing a nationwide data center portfolio. Our team runs enterprise and regional data centers, telecommunications spaces, and secure network connections that host the systems Veterans depend on — from claims processing and pharmacy fulfillment to appointment scheduling and benefits delivery. We provide full\-lifecycle data center and cloud engineering, 24×7×365 operations and monitoring, DCIM platform administration, analytics, and facility infrastructure reporting. If you want your engineering, operations, or analytics work to matter to someone, this is where it does.


**Position Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as senior/escalation\-level engineer for compute, storage, and systems services across data center facilities.
* Lead complex troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation for high\-impact incidents.
* Design and execute maintenance windows, upgrades, and technology refresh activities.
* Mentor mid\-level engineers; contribute runbooks, standards, and automation improvements.
* Coordinate vendor engagements for warranty, break/fix, and firmware/OS upgrades.

\#VAIEO


##### **Qualifications**


**Requirements**


* Currently possess or be able to obtain VA Public Trust — **High Risk (BI High) / Tier 4** background investigation.
* **4 years** of data center systems engineering experience, with demonstrated senior\-level troubleshooting capability.
* Supervisory experience
* Shiftwork may be required

**Desired Skills, Tools \& Certifications**


* **Tools:** Data center monitoring and management tools including Nlyte Asset Optimizer / Energy Optimizer (DCIM), ServiceNow (ITSM/CMDB), SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG, PuTTY, Wireshark, PowerShell, Python, Power BI, MS Visio, and SharePoint. plus VMware vSphere, Ansible / PowerShell / Python for automation.
* **Processes:** ITIL v4 service management, SAFe Agile / Scrum for iterative delivery, NIST 800\-53 / RMF, ISO 27001, TIA\-942, ASHRAE TC 9\.9, VA CRISP alignment, NFPA 70/70E, and OSHA safety practices.; TIA\-942\.
* **Certifications (desirable):** CompTIA Server\+ / Network\+ / Security\+, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server / Azure Administrator, Red Hat RHCSA/RHCE, VMware VCP\-DCV, ServiceNow CSA, Nlyte Certified Administrator, CDCP., ITIL v4 Foundation (Practitioner/Managing Professional a plus), SAFe Practitioner or SAFe DevOps

**Work location:** Austin, TX


##### **Details**


**Target Salary Range:** $80,000 \- $128,000\. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. The Electro Optical Infrared Systems (EOIS) line of business within DRS has locations in Dallas and Austin, TX, Melbourne, FL, and Cypress, CA. EOIS develops, manufactures, and supports infrared and electro\-optical solutions for soldiers, ground vehicles and airborne platforms. *

	+ Masters Degree is a plus

	+ Must be diligent, hardworking, and quick to learn

	+ Good communicator with data analysis, documentation, and presentation skills
	+ Mature, professional, positive, and possess a “can\-do” attitude
	+ Detail\-oriented

	+ Experience being lead design engineer and driving new technologies and tools.

* Experience designing circuit card assemblies
* Experience with schematic capture tools (Cadence, Mentor, Altium, other)
* Strong documentation and communication skills
* Experience with integration and test (validation and verification) of circuit card assemblies in new products
* Familiar with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, digital multimeters, and similar lab test and debug equipment
* Proven capability executing complex designs in a timely manner
* Experience with electrical design tools including Cadence Allegro or similar PCB design tools
* EO IR Sensor / Video Camera development experience highly preferred
* Firmware and Softcore Processor design experience is a plus
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

Develop and Implement Hardware and Firmware, including Firmware, for Bone Growth \& Tissue Regeneration Devices. * Ability to implement code on Windows and Linux platforms.

* Experience with SEMCAD or SIM4Life simulation software.

* Ability to design and layout circuit boards.

* 2\-3 years of industry experience.
* Additional Experience, Skills, Knowledge, and/or Abilities:
* Knowledge of C\+\+ and C.

* Familiar with cloud\-based servers.

new_jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
